sections: distribution
Six Zhangjiajie sites represent different management histories
张家界六地点代表不同管理历史

Between 2020 and 2023 the study collected sixty free-living Chinese giant salamander samples within the Hunan Zhangjiajie reserve: Wumuyu eight, Yuanzi eleven, Jinbianxi ten, Xixiping eight, Xiangshi twelve and Liangshuikou eleven. Most DNA sampling used skin swabs; some large animals supplied small caudal-fin clips, and animals were released on-site. Wumuyu and Yuanzi were historically natural cave sites with minimal translocation involvement; Jinbianxi had long-term reinforcement; the other three had recent reintroductions. Free-living collection does not establish indigenous ancestry. The discussion suggests davidianus/sligoi lineages but does not certify each animal against contemporary accepted species, so these data remain on the Andrias genus page.

2020 至 2023 年研究在湖南张家界保护区采六十份野外生活中国大鲵样本：乌木峪八、园子十一、金鞭溪十、西溪坪八、响石十二、凉水口十一。多数 DNA 采样用皮肤拭子，部分大个体取小尾鳍条，动物原地释放。乌木峪、园子为历史天然洞穴地点，转移介入少；金鞭溪长期增补，其余三处近期重引入。野外采集不确立本土祖源。讨论提出 davidianus／sligoi 支系可能性，但未按现行有效种逐只认证，因此数据保留在 Andrias 属页。
evolution
A farm-bred genome sample supported marker discovery
养殖个体基因组样本用于发现标记

Muscle from one farm-bred individual, voucher JWS2021322, supplied the genomic sequencing sample; it is distinct from the sixty-site-sample diversity panel. Approximately 410 gigabases of raw reads produced a shallow, highly fragmented assembly, reported as about eightfold genome coverage. The assembled scaffold total was about 2.89 gigabases, with scaffold N50 of 744 bases. The authors used this draft to discover microsatellite markers rather than present a complete chromosome-level genome. Assembled sequence length is not a validated total genome size, and genomic results cannot be assigned independently to every sampled lineage.
一个养殖个体 JWS2021322 的肌肉提供基因组测序样本，与六十份地点样本的多样性组分开。约 410 Gb 原始读段得到浅层、高度碎片化组装，报告约八倍基因组覆盖。组装 scaffold 总长约 2.89 Gb，scaffold N50 为 744 碱基。作者用该草图发现微卫星标记，不是提供完整染色体级基因组。组装序列长度不是已验证总基因组大小，基因组结果不能独立归给每个所采支系。
evolution
Nineteen selected markers reflect a staged screening procedure
十九个选定标记来自分阶段筛选

Of two hundred randomly selected primer pairs, 116 amplified bands and seventy-one produced specific single bands in two initial animals. Testing ten animals then identified twenty-six polymorphic pairs; seven low-polymorphism pairs were discarded, leaving nineteen for the sixty-animal comparison. Selecting polymorphic loci conditions the resulting diversity estimates; this is not random genome-wide variation. The validation section says retained loci had PIC above 0.25, but the later sixty-animal results report Y152 below 0.25. These statements concern different stages and samples and are retained rather than forced into a single invariant threshold.
二百组随机选引物中 116 扩增出条带，七十一在最初两只动物中产生特异单条带。再测十只，确定二十六组有多态；排除七组低多态，留十九用于六十动物比较。选择多态位点使多样性估计受到筛选条件影响，不是随机全基因组变异。验证段称保留位点 PIC 大于 0.25，后续六十动物结果却报 Y152 低于 0.25。这些属于不同阶段、样本，保留差别而不强行写为恒定阈值。
evolution
Heterozygosity and differentiation describe sampled loci
杂合度与分化描述所采位点

Across the nineteen markers the study reports 107 alleles, with mean expected heterozygosity 0.565 and observed heterozygosity 0.773. These are marker statistics, not counts of animals or measures of survival. Observed exceeded expected heterozygosity in all six site summaries, and most loci departed from Hardy–Weinberg expectations. Yuanzi versus Wumuyu had the largest reported genetic distance, 0.144, and Fst, 0.065; Xixiping versus Xiangshi had the smallest, 0.004 and 0.013. Those comparisons do not measure migration rates or prove a taxonomic boundary. The authors’ suggested shortage of breeders is a possible explanation rather than a directly counted breeding population.

十九标记共报告 107 等位基因，平均预期杂合度 0.565、观察杂合度 0.773。这是标记统计，不是动物数或存活测量。六地点汇总均为观察值高于预期，多数位点偏离 Hardy–Weinberg 预期。园子对乌木峪所报遗传距离最大 0.144、Fst 最大 0.065；西溪坪对响石最小，分别 0.004、0.013。比较不测迁移率或证明分类界限。作者提出繁殖个体不足是可能解释，不是直接清点繁殖种群。
evolution
Three inferred genetic groups are not three named species
三个推断遗传组不是三个命名物种

STRUCTURE tested K from two to six, with the reported delta-K criterion favouring three groups. Wumuyu and Yuanzi mainly belonged to different groups; recent reintroduction sites resembled Yuanzi, while Jinbianxi showed a distinctive third pattern. UPGMA and population-level principal-coordinate analyses broadly agreed. Three model groups do not establish three species, three known parental sources or individual pedigrees; K = 1 was not among the tested hypotheses. The discussion interprets Jinbianxi as possibly mixing river-drainage lineages and calls for family samples and more markers to evaluate hybridization.
STRUCTURE 测 K 二至六，所报 delta-K 准则支持三组。乌木峪、园子主要归不同组，近期重引入地点近园子，金鞭溪呈不同第三模式。UPGMA 与种群级主坐标分析大致一致。三个模型组不确立三个物种、三个已知亲本来源或个体谱系；所测假说不含 K = 1。讨论解释金鞭溪可能混合不同河流支系，并要求家系样本、更多标记评估杂交。
conservation
Translocation history motivates further genetic assessment
转移历史提示进一步遗传评估

The paper cites more than one thousand animals released into Jinbianxi since 2000, with limited attention to genetic sources in earlier efforts. This historical release count is not a present census or a measured survival rate. The genetic patterns support assessing source lineages before future management decisions, but the study does not measure the success of a relocation protocol, establish a causal decline trend or certify natural hybridization. Wider marker panels, family data and explicit contemporary species identification remain necessary for the proposed interpretations.
论文记金鞭溪自 2000 年以来放归超过一千只，较早工作对遗传来源关注有限。历史放归数不是当前普查或已测存活率。遗传模式支持在未来管理决定前评估来源支系，但研究不测转移方案成功、不建立因果下降趋势，也不认证自然杂交。解释仍需更广标记组、家系数据及明确现行物种鉴定。

name: Bolitoglossa
sections: evolution
Ten sampled species reveal different repeat landscapes
十个所采种显示不同重复景观

The 2024 study compared ten Bolitoglossa species with two Chiropterotriton and four Thorius, using one liver-DNA specimen per species. The Bolitoglossa sample is a selected part of the accepted genus. Detected repeat abundance ranged from 49.7% in yucatana to 60.2% in chinanteca in Table 1; these sampled-read proportions include uncategorized repeats and likely miss sequences degraded beyond recognition. LTRs were the most abundant classified order, but the mix of ERV and Gypsy differed among species. These are genomic comparisons, not measurements of feeding ecology, habitat quality or survival.

2024 年研究比较十个 Bolitoglossa、两个 Chiropterotriton、四个 Thorius，每种一个肝 DNA 标本。Bolitoglossa 样本是有效属所选部分。表一可检出重复丰度由 yucatana 49.7% 至 chinanteca 60.2%；所抽读段比例含未分类重复，并可能遗漏退化至无法识别序列。LTR 为最丰富的已分类目，但 ERV、Gypsy 构成在种间不同。这是基因组比较，不测摄食生态、生境质量或存活。
evolution
Larger and smaller genome groups have relative divergence histories
较大与较小基因组组有相对分化历史

The authors group macrinii, flaviventris, mexicana, platydactyla, stuarti and yucatana by higher-distance ERV peaks, and chinanteca, rufescens, occidentalis and veracrucis by lower-distance peaks. These are repeat-consensus divergences, not absolute ages. The Methods call rufescens the smallest-genome Bolitoglossa chosen for assembly, whereas Table 1 lists a smaller C-value for veracrucis. The Discussion also overgeneralizes all Bolitoglossa genomes as exceeding forty gigabases. The species pages retain table units and these conflicts rather than certifying the incorrect minimum or converting picograms directly into gigabases.

作者将 macrinii、flaviventris、mexicana、platydactyla、stuarti、yucatana 归较高距离 ERV 峰组，chinanteca、rufescens、occidentalis、veracrucis 归较低距离峰组。它们是相对重复共识序列分化，不是绝对年龄。方法称用于组装的 rufescens 为最小基因组 Bolitoglossa，但表一列 veracrucis 更小 C 值；讨论又概括所有 Bolitoglossa 基因组超过四十 Gb。物种页保留表单位与冲突，不认证错误最小值，也不把皮克直接换成 Gb。

name: Chiropterotriton
sections: evolution
Two species provide a narrow genomic comparison
两个种提供有限基因组比较

Only dimidiatus and priscus represent Chiropterotriton in the sixteen-species study, each with one sequenced liver specimen. Table 1 reports 62.9% and 45.3% detectable repeats respectively, including uncategorized sequences. Their genome C-value estimates, 30.3 and 32.9 picograms, came from a separate densitometric evidence stream. The comparison does not establish a genus-wide distribution or population-level difference, and its sampled-read repeat percentages are likely below true repetitive content.
十六种研究仅以 dimidiatus、priscus 代表 Chiropterotriton，各一个肝测序标本。表一分别报 62.9%、45.3% 可检出重复，含未分类序列。基因组 C 值估计 30.3、32.9 皮克来自另行密度测定证据。比较不建立全属分布或种群层面差异，所抽读段重复比例也可能低于真实重复含量。
evolution
Different repeat histories do not prove silencing or deletion
不同重复历史不证明沉默或删除

Dimidiatus had a stronger sampled Gypsy contribution and lower ERV contribution than priscus, with lower-distance ERV peaks and reads interpreted as recent expansion. Priscus retained an older high-distance pattern resembling larger Bolitoglossa. Without neutral mutation-rate calibration or deletion-rate measurements, the authors could not date these events absolutely or distinguish more effective silencing from deletion. A lower inferred expansion peak is not a direct measurement of gene regulation or transposition rate.
dimidiatus 所采 Gypsy 比重比 priscus 高、ERV 比重低，有较低距离 ERV 峰及解释为近期扩张的读段。priscus 保留近较大 Bolitoglossa 的较旧高距离模式。没有中性突变率校准或删除率测量，作者不能绝对定年或区分较有效沉默与删除。较低推断扩张峰不是直接测基因调控或转座率。

name: Thorius
sections: evolution
Four miniature-salamander species have different DNA landscapes
四个微型蝾螈种具有不同 DNA 景观

The study sampled lunaris, narisovalis, spilogaster and tlaxiacus, with one liver-DNA specimen each. Their Table 1 C-values span 22.9–28.9 picograms, and detectable repeat proportions span 65.6–74.8%. These are selected species and sampled-read estimates, not a complete Thorius survey. Uncategorized repeats exceed Class I elements in lunaris and spilogaster; they are not thereby identified as a particular TE superfamily. Small animal body size should not be substituted for the paper’s measured DNA content.
研究采 lunaris、narisovalis、spilogaster、tlaxiacus，各一个肝 DNA 标本。表一 C 值跨 22.9–28.9 皮克，可检出重复比例跨 65.6–74.8%。这是所选种及所抽读段估计，不是完整 Thorius 调查。lunaris、spilogaster 未分类重复多于第一类元件，但并非因此识别为某个转座超家族。小动物体型不能代替论文测定 DNA 含量。
evolution
Tlaxiacus differs from the three smaller-genome samples
tlaxiacus 不同于三个较小基因组样本

Within the four-species sample, tlaxiacus had the largest C-value and an ERV divergence peak around nine, while the other three had peaks below four and more low-distance evidence interpreted as ongoing expansion. The comparison concerns relative sequence divergence; absolute timing was unavailable. Across all sixteen species, repeat diversity and detectable repeat abundance were negatively associated with genome size after phylogenetic adjustment, but not every separate repeat class retained statistical support. Those cross-species associations do not demonstrate within-species growth, a single causal mechanism or universal differences among all Thorius.
四种样本内 tlaxiacus 的 C 值最大，ERV 分化峰约九，另三种峰在四以下，并有更多解释为持续扩张的低距离证据。比较涉及相对序列分化，没有绝对时间。跨全部十六种，重复多样性及可检出重复丰度与基因组大小在系统校正后负关联，但每个单独重复类并非都保留统计支持。种间关联不证明种内生长、单一因果机制或所有 Thorius 的普遍差异。

sections: taxonomy
A species-group comparison covers only part of the genus
种组比较只覆盖全属一部分

The 2025 paper describes lulai and compares it with twenty other species assigned to the pernix group. Its reviewed characters include skin texture, sex-specific snout–vent length, live/preserved colours, external digits and advertisement-call structure. These comparisons do not cover every accepted Brachycephalus species. Lulai is absent from the pinned accepted-species list and remains a separate source concept, without an invented catalogue ID or transfer of its measurements to auroguttatus or quiririensis. The four-locus analysis supports a clade containing those three names but does not resolve relationships among them. Shared colour or a close phylogenetic placement alone is not a synonymy decision.

2025 年论文描述 lulai，并与 pernix 组另外二十种比较。所审性状含皮肤质地、分性别吻肛长、活体与保存颜色、外部手足指及求偶鸣声结构。这些比较不覆盖所有有效 Brachycephalus。lulai 不在固定有效种名册内，保留为独立来源概念，不编造目录 ID，也不把其测量转给 auroguttatus、quiririensis。四位点分析支持含这三个名称的支，但不解决三者内部关系。共享颜色或系统关系相近本身不是同物异名决定。
behavior
Specimens, recordings, notes and pulses require separate units
标本、录音、音符与脉冲需要分开单位

Table 2 retains the number of animals observed for each character; for acoustic characters, N counts animals with one or more recorded and analysed calls. The denominators differ across sex, skin, colour and acoustic variables. The note-centred approach treats a sequence as the call, while some older call-centred accounts treat one note as a call. Isolated notes, note groups, pulses and attenuated notes cannot be pooled as one duration or count. Mariaeterezae lacks available call data in this comparison. Limited samples and nonstandardized colour descriptions constrain diagnoses, and observed acoustic maxima do not establish invariant limits across the genus.
表二保留每个性状所查动物数；声学性状 N 计有一个或多个鸣声被记录分析的动物。分母随性别、皮肤、颜色及声学变量不同。以音符为中心的方法把序列作鸣声，某些旧以鸣声为中心描述则将单音符作鸣声。单音符、音符组、脉冲及减弱音符不能合并成一个时长或数量。此次比较没有 mariaeterezae 可用鸣声数据。有限样本与非标准色彩描述限制诊断，已观察声学最大值不建立全属不变界限。
conservation
Proposed refuge and recovery scores remain dated scenarios
拟建保护区及恢复评分仍是有日期情景

The study reassesses twenty comparison species with spatial criteria and proposes a 6,600-hectare Serra do Quiriri refuge intended to protect lulai, auroguttatus, quiririensis and Melanophryniscus biancae alongside habitat. This is a proposal, not evidence of an established reserve or completed intervention. Record-based and potential-habitat AOO, EOO and threat-defined locations have different meanings. The authors’ 2025 categories and Green Status scenarios are not freshly verified official listings or population counts. Numeric inconsistencies and superscript footnotes in Table 8 are preserved in the source ledger. Quiririensis was heard in disturbed vegetation in 2004, but the authors report being unable to revisit after 2010 to confirm persistence; neither continued presence nor extinction is certified.

研究用空间准则重新评估二十个比较种，提议 6,600 公顷 Serra do Quiriri 保护区，拟保护 lulai、auroguttatus、quiririensis、Melanophryniscus biancae 及生境。这是提议，不是保护区已建立或干预已完成证据。基于记录与潜在生境的 AOO、EOO 及威胁定义地点含义不同。作者 2025 年等级及绿色状态情景不是刚验证的官方名录或种群数。表八数值冲突、上标脚注保留在来源台账。2004 年受扰植被曾听到 quiririensis，但作者称 2010 年后无法回访确认持续存在，因此未认证当前存在或灭绝。

sections: taxonomy
An eDNA assay retains its unresolved species boundary
环境 DNA 检测保留未解决种界

The 2024 study developed an RPA lateral-flow assay using farm-bred animals labelled Andrias davidianus and mitochondrial sequences. The authors explicitly say it cannot identify cryptic species within that historical Chinese giant salamander scope. A positive strip therefore cannot distinguish the currently accepted Chinese Andrias species or establish native ancestry. The paper also discusses jiangxiensis while using subspecies language; this is retained as source terminology, not adopted as a new accepted rank. The study supports a broad detection method, not a complete species identification or genetic-suitability check before releases.
2024 年研究用标为 Andrias davidianus 的养殖动物及线粒体序列开发 RPA 侧向层析检测。作者明确说它不能识别该历史中国大鲵范围内隐存种，因此阳性条不能区分现行中国 Andrias 有效种或确立本土祖源。论文讨论 jiangxiensis 时又用亚种措辞，保留为来源术语，不采纳为新的有效等级。研究支持较广检测方法，不是完整种鉴定或放归前遗传适配检查。
evolution
Specificity and detection limits depend on the tested panel
特异性与检测限依赖所测组

Five primer/probe sets amplified target DNA, but W5 also produced a weak blank-control signal and was excluded. W1–W4 were negative against the tested non-target caudates, not every amphibian lineage. With the initial strip dilution, W1 and W2 detected down to ten nanograms per millilitre, W3 to 0.1, and W4 only to 1,000. Changing the product dilution improved the reported W4 threshold to two. These are diluted template-DNA concentrations, not animal density, eDNA copies per litre of river water or a universal field limit. Amplification at 37 degrees Celsius for ten minutes is one protocol stage, not the entire collection/extraction workflow.

五组引物／探针均扩增目标 DNA，但 W5 也产生弱空白对照信号而被排除。W1–W4 对所测非目标有尾类阴性，不是对所有两栖支系均验证。初始检测条稀释下，W1、W2 检至十 ng/mL，W3 至 0.1，W4 仅至 1,000；改变产物稀释后，所报 W4 阈值改善到二。这是稀释模板 DNA 浓度，不是动物密度、河水每升环境 DNA 拷贝或通用野外极限。37 摄氏度十分钟扩增是协议一步，不是整个采水、提取流程。
ecology
Aquarium trials and rapid extraction have defined scope
水箱试验与快速提取有明确范围

Mock environmental water came from a forty-litre aquarium housing one 0.5-kilogram farm-bred salamander, with three processed water replicates and filtered distilled-water controls. The authors compared conventional CTAB, rapid CTAB and Chelex extraction. Initial strip performance varied by extraction and primer set; changing product dilution improved weak or failed signals. The aquarium mass is not a wild body-size distribution, and replicate filters from one tank are not three independent salamander populations. The rapid Chelex protocol still required heated incubations and centrifugation; portability does not mean an equipment-free ten-minute survey.
模拟环境水来自容有一只 0.5 千克养殖大鲵的四十升水箱，处理三份水重复并设过滤蒸馏水对照。作者比较常规 CTAB、快速 CTAB 与 Chelex 提取。初始检测条表现随提取及引物组不同，改产物稀释改善弱或失败信号。水箱动物重量不是野外体型分布，同一水箱重复滤样也不是三个独立大鲵种群。快速 Chelex 协议仍需加热孵育、离心；便携不意味着无设备十分钟调查。
distribution
Three positive sites include a farm-outlet control
三个阳性地点含养殖场出水对照

Field sampling in Huangshan, Anhui, ran from 28 May to 1 June 2023 at four sites in Xin’an River headwaters. At each site, water from the focal point and positions one hundred metres upstream and downstream was pooled before one-litre replicate filtration. All four retained primer sets gave positive signals at RAARI, Ruanxi Mountain and Fuxi Town; Tangkou Town samples were negative. RAARI was deliberately sampled at a breeding-farm outlet as a positive control. Pooling does not locate an animal at each individual sampling point, and farm discharge cannot be counted as an independently confirmed wild population.
野外采样于 2023 年五月二十八日至六月一日在安徽黄山新安江源流四地点进行。各地点把目标点及上下游各一百米位置的水合并，再作一升重复过滤。四组保留引物在 RAARI、阮溪山、富溪镇均有阳性，汤口镇样本阴性。RAARI 特意采养殖场出水作阳性对照。池化不能把动物定位到每个取样点，养殖排水也不能算独立确认野生种群。
conservation
Signals inform follow-up monitoring rather than recovery proof
信号提示后续监测而非恢复证明

The authors suggest that pollution and dense settlement might explain the Tangkou non-detection, but they did not experimentally establish that cause or demonstrate local extinction. Negative water tests can reflect low DNA concentration, sampling or assay performance; positive DNA does not provide a count of living adults, reproduction or survival. The paper recommends careful contamination control and further reaction optimization, having itself excluded a false-positive primer set. Its anticipated conservation benefit is a proposal for monitoring, not a measured population recovery, validated release programme or new official status assessment.
作者提出污染、密集居民可能解释汤口未检出，但没有实验确立原因或证明当地灭绝。水样阴性可涉及 DNA 浓度低、采样或检测表现，阳性 DNA 不提供存活成体数、繁殖或存活率。论文建议谨慎污染控制及进一步反应优化，研究自身也排除一组假阳性引物。预期保护益处是监测提议，不是已测种群恢复、已验证放归计划或新官方等级评估。

sections: morphology
New types and older comparison traits have separate evidence roles
新模式与旧比较性状证据用途不同

The 2023 study describes laojunshanensis from six July 2019 types at Mt. Laojun: five adult males and one adult female. It separately measured eight pleskei and eight ventripunctata, while using earlier descriptions for many other comparisons. Size-corrected morphology and four-locus phylogeny support the new lineage, but cited fold, vocal-sac and male nuptial-spine characters are not new population samples for every species. Marsh/pond occurrence and a July–August breeding-season inference belong to laojunshanensis alone; no tadpoles or direct spawning were documented. The linked pages keep these evidence units separate.
2023 年研究以老君山 2019 年七月六个模式描述 laojunshanensis：五成年雄、一成年雌；另外测八个 pleskei、八个 ventripunctata，许多其他比较用较早描述。体型校正形态与四位点系统树支持新支系，但被引褶、声囊及雄婚棘不是每种新的种群样本。沼泽、池塘记录及七八月繁殖季推测仅属于 laojunshanensis，没有蝌蚪或直接产卵记录。链接页分开这些证据单位。
evolution
Four subgenus lineages are a source-bound framework
四个亚属支系是来源限定框架

The combined analysis used three mitochondrial markers and nuclear RAG-1 with older reference sequences, some missing loci. The authors recognize four major lineages and propose Minipaa for minica, alongside Nanorana, Paa and Chaparana allocations. Internal relationships among Minipaa, Paa and Nanorana were unresolved. Low 16S distances coexist with named species and morphological differences; a single three-percent threshold would not reproduce this framework. Marker distances, tree branches and cited older genomic work are not interchangeable with divergence dates, population gene-flow estimates or independent certification of a taxonomic rank.

合并分析用三线粒体标记、核 RAG-1 及较早参考序列，其中有缺失位点。作者认四大支系，为 minica 提议 Minipaa，并列 Nanorana、Paa、Chaparana 分配。Minipaa、Paa、Nanorana 内部关系未解决。低 16S 距离与命名种、形态差异并存，单一百分之三阈值不能复现该框架。标记距离、分支及被引旧基因组工作不能替代分化日期、种群基因流估计或独立认证分类等级。
taxonomy
Allopaa history is preserved alongside the accepted hazarensis page
Allopaa 历史与有效 hazarensis 页面并列保留

A Pakistan reference labelled Allopaa hazarensis was recovered inside Nanorana near Chaparana. The authors propose placing Allopaa in synonymy because earlier generic diagnostic traits recur among Nanorana species. The fixed catalogue already uses Nanorana hazarensis, but the reader preserves the source’s historical combination and reference-voucher scope. A proposal to merge genera does not erase morphological variation, establish all record identities or provide a newly surveyed hazarensis distribution. Canonical species identifiers and their tree paths retain the pinned catalogue structure.

标 Allopaa hazarensis 的巴基斯坦参考恢复在 Nanorana 内、近 Chaparana。作者因旧属诊断性状也见于 Nanorana，提议 Allopaa 同物异名。固定目录已用 Nanorana hazarensis，但读本保留来源历史组合及参考凭证范围。合并属提议不消除形态变异、不确立全部记录身份，也不提供新调查 hazarensis 分布。规范种标识及树路径保留固定目录结构。
taxonomy
Uncertain vouchers and conflicting assignments stay unresolved
不确定凭证及冲突分配保留未解决状态

The source’s nominal arunachalensis sequence falls near Ingerana, conditional on correct voucher identification. Its Discussion describes type-locality vouchers, while Table 1 lists ZSIS-M40 with a Cona, Tibet locality; that disagreement prevents uncritical transfer of sequence or morphology claims to the fixed Odorrana arunachalensis page. The paper also questions a Bhutan photograph-only identification. For xuelinensis, Discussion suggests Paa but Table 7 marks Chaparana. Annandalii, feae, gammii and mokokchungensis lacked sequence placement in the study. These dated uncertainties do not certify current absence of data, a new synonymy or a complete genus concept reconciliation.

来源名义 arunachalensis 序列落近 Ingerana，但以凭证鉴定正确为条件。讨论称模式地凭证，表一却将 ZSIS-M40 地点列西藏错那；分歧阻止把序列或形态陈述无审查地转给固定 Odorrana arunachalensis 页。论文还质疑仅凭照片的 Bhutan 鉴定。xuelinensis 讨论建议 Paa，表七标 Chaparana；annandalii、feae、gammii、mokokchungensis 在研究内缺序列位置。有日期不确定性不认证当前缺资料、新同物异名或全属概念完整协调。

name: Nanohyla
sourceConcept: 2023 ten-name reference phylogeny and new albopunctata type/field observations, not complete genus biology
readScope: All extracted letter, taxonomic-account and nomenclatural paragraphs read; original supplementary specimens/recordings/statistical tables not independently analysed

sections: evolution
The sampled genus is supported while deeper relationships remain weak
所采属有支持但更深关系仍弱

The 2023 study combined mitochondrial 12S–16S and nuclear BDNF with earlier references for sixty-five specimens, recovering Nanohyla as monophyletic. It placed the new albopunctata lineage sister to marmorata, and recovered perparva–petrigena and pulchella–hongiaoensis sister pairs. Strong support for these pairs does not make every deeper branch secure: Group II had weak Bayesian support, and relationships among Microhyla, Nanohyla and Glyphoglossus were poorly resolved. Published genus names and marker distances are not substitutes for divergence dates, whole-genome relationships or complete species-concept reconciliation.

2023 年研究将线粒体 12S–16S、核 BDNF 与较早参考合并共六十五标本，恢复 Nanohyla 单系。新 albopunctata 支为 marmorata 姐妹，并恢复 perparva–petrigena、pulchella–hongiaoensis 姐妹对。对强支持不使所有深分支可靠：第二组贝叶斯支持弱，Microhyla、Nanohyla、Glyphoglossus 内关系分辨差。出版属名及标记距离不能替代分化日期、完整基因组关系或种概念完整协调。
morphology
Type observations and source conflicts require specimen-level context
模式观察与来源冲突需要标本级背景

The new-species evidence comes from three adult male albopunctata types; females were not recorded. Reduced first finger, grooved discs, head spots and colour patterns belong to that type account and should not be applied to every Nanohyla. The text conflicts internally over holotype versus series size, palmar-tubercle shapes, head proportions and toe webbing. The linked pages preserve these disagreements and distinguish living from ethanol-preserved colour. White head spots and comparative head or foot ratios are source-bound evidence, not a complete invariant identification key for all populations.
新种证据来自三个成年雄 albopunctata 模式，没有雌记录。退化第一指、有沟指趾盘、头斑及颜色属于该模式记述，不能应用到每个 Nanohyla。正文在正模与系列体长、掌瘤形状、头比例及趾蹼上内部冲突。链接页保留分歧，区分活体与乙醇保存颜色。白头斑及比较头足比例是来源限定证据，不是全种群完整不变鉴定检索表。
ecology
One lowland calling site does not define the genus life history
一个低地鸣叫点不定义全属生活史

Albopunctata was found at comparatively low elevations in Song Hinh forest, with January males calling at a small temporary pool on a forest road. The authors report local breeding activity but lack diet, predator and detailed developmental information. These observations do not establish a shared pool-breeding mode, elevation tolerance or January season for the entire genus. The paper’s acoustic comparison also confuses calls per series with pulses per call in part of the text; units remain distinct on the species pages. Its provisional Data Deficient suggestion and regional conservation appeal are dated research judgments, not freshly checked official categories or measured management outcomes.
albopunctata 见于 Song Hinh 林较低海拔，一月雄在林路临时小池边鸣叫。作者记当地繁殖活动，但缺食性、捕食者及详细发育资料。观察不确立全属共享池繁殖方式、海拔耐受或一月繁殖季。论文声学比较部分又混淆每序列鸣声与每鸣声脉冲，物种页分开单位。暂建议 DD 及区域保护倡议是有日期研究判断，不是刚查官方等级或已测管理结果。

PMC12579332 XML Materials and methods paragraph 1; Holotype, Paratypes, Diagnosis and Sexual dimorphism paragraphs 1

sections: taxonomy
Mitochondrial partitions and taxonomic ranks are separate decisions
线粒体划分与分类等级是分别作出的判断

The 2025 Wumeng study recovered a lineage within dafangensis using a 1094-base-pair 16S–CO1 alignment, while CO1 ASAP favoured species separation. The authors nevertheless proposed subspecies rank. Their cited mantzorum–xinduqiao comparison also links low mitochondrial distances with a subspecies interpretation. These selected examples show why a marker partition alone does not certify a rank for every Amolops lineage. The species pages retain the dated names, sample scopes and proposed rank without manufacturing new accepted species identifiers.
2025 年乌蒙山研究用 1094 碱基对的 16S–CO1 比对，将该支系恢复于 dafangensis 内，但 CO1 ASAP 支持物种分离；作者仍提议亚种等级。所引 mantzorum–xinduqiao 比较也将低线粒体差异与亚种解释联系起来。这些所选例子说明标记划分本身不足以认证每个湍蛙支系的等级。物种页保留有年代名称、样本范围及拟议等级，不虚构新的接受物种标识。
morphology
Voucher counts and collection dates must remain traceable
凭证数量与采集日期需保持可追溯

The Wumeng diagnosis rests on three male types and one female type, whereas methods describe six sampled animals, four retained and two released. Those denominators have different meanings. Methods and the type account disagree on collection years and months, so the linked dafangensis page records the conflict. A small type series and its variable live coloration cannot supply population-wide body limits, a complete genus identification key or a tested universal sex difference.
乌蒙山诊断依据三雄模式与一雌模式，方法却描述六只取样动物，其中四只保留、两只释放；这些分母含义不同。方法与模式记述的采集年月不同，因此链接的 dafangensis 页记录冲突。小模式系列及活体颜色变异不能提供种群整体体型极限、完整属鉴定检索表或经过检验的普遍性别差异。
reproduction
Local breeding signs and a mountain-barrier hypothesis
地方繁殖迹象与山地屏障假说

July nuptial pads, stream records in two counties and sympatry with two other frog species concern the described Wumeng population. No amplexus or tadpoles were observed. Early breeding and restricted gene flow across the Wumeng Mountains are author interpretations, not directly measured reproductive timing or gene flow. These records do not establish diet, complete larval development, all-species breeding seasons or the ecological requirements of the genus.
七月婚垫、两县溪流记录及与另两种蛙同域，涉及所描述的乌蒙山种群；未见抱对或蝌蚪。繁殖早期与乌蒙山限制基因流属于作者解释，不是直接测定的繁殖时序或基因流。这些记录不能确立食性、完整幼体发育、全部物种繁殖季或全属生态需求。

sections: morphology
New types and literature comparisons form different samples
新模式与文献比较构成不同样本

The 2026 paper describes deocaensis using one male and four female types; fourteen other applebyi-group species are compared using published literature. The linked accepted-species pages retain these cited traits without calling them newly measured Deo Ca animals. The deocaensis name has no exact accepted-species match in the pinned catalogue, so its type measurements and five drafted bilingual sections remain in a pending scope record. This prevents a new description from silently changing the fixed species denominator.
2026 年论文以一雄四雌模式描述 deocaensis，另外十四个 applebyi 组物种用出版文献比较。链接的接受物种页保留被引性状，不称为 Deo Ca 新测动物。deocaensis 名称在固定目录内没有确切接受物种匹配，因此模式测量及五节双语草稿保留于待映射记录。新描述由此不会悄然改变固定物种分母。
evolution
Short-marker support is bounded by the included references
短标记支持受纳入参考限制

The reported 16S dataset comprises 112 new and reference sequences across 534 positions, with four newly collected samples. The deocaensis lineage was placed within the applebyi group with reported Bayesian/ML support 1.00/98. The closest reported compared distance was 6.34% to macrops. Neither high support nor this distance establishes a universal threshold, complete genomic isolation or a divergence date. The paper’s association of genetic separation with coastal conditions remains an interpretation rather than an experimental causal result.
所报 16S 数据含 112 条新旧序列、534 位点，其中四个新采样本。deocaensis 支系被置于 applebyi 组，所报贝叶斯／最大似然支持 1.00/98，最近比较距离是与 macrops 的 6.34%。高支持及该距离均不确立通用阈值、完整基因组隔离或分化日期。论文将遗传分离与沿海条件相联系，仍属解释，不是实验因果结果。
ecology
Coastal observations and earlier mountain records remain separate
沿海观察与较早山地记录分别保留

The newly described population was observed along a rocky stream at 50–150 m in coastal secondary evergreen forest. Macrops and duyenae elevation and proximity comparisons come from earlier mountain records. Recorded air temperature and humidity describe observation sites, not physiological limits. Adjacent survey nondetections do not prove absence; sympatry with other frogs does not establish food or competition. No complete genus diet, breeding calendar or larval biology follows from this localized survey.
新描述种群见于海拔 50–150 米沿海次生常绿林石质溪流；macrops、duyenae 的海拔及距离比较来自较早山地记录。气温、湿度描述观察地点，不是生理界限。相邻调查未检出不能证明缺失，与其他蛙同域不能确立食物或竞争。地方调查不能提供全属完整食性、繁殖日历或幼体生物学。

sections: taxonomy
A proposed subgenus distinguishes names from candidate lineages
拟议亚属区分名称与候选支系

The 2025 study proposes Cryptomantis, with prolatus as its type species and two supported species-group clades. It includes nine described names, counting newly described paganus, plus five unconfirmed candidate lineages. The study explicitly lacks identified morphological synapomorphies; variable folds alone do not diagnose the entire clade. The links select eight fixed accepted species within those groups. Paganus lacks an exact pinned name and remains in a separate pending record. Neither candidates nor a proposed rank silently change catalogue identities.
2025 年研究提议 Cryptomantis，以 prolatus 为模式种，含两个有支持的物种组支系；九个描述名称包括新描述 paganus，另有五个未确认候选支系。研究明确缺少已识别形态共有衍征，变化的褶本身不能诊断整支。链接选择这两组内八个固定接受物种。paganus 无确切固定名称，保留于独立待映射记录。候选或拟议等级均不悄然改变目录身份。
evolution
Type-associated references refine a limited molecular framework
与模式相关的参考改善有限分子框架

The study adds a burtoniorum holotype sequence and topotypic references for several names to distinguish earlier broad labels from narrower lineages. It targets 16S, 12S, COI and nuclear RAG1 using Sanger and nanopore amplicon methods. Its candidate thresholds vary, and some vouchers lack adequate morphology. High bootstrap support is not proof of reproductive isolation or a universal rank criterion. Mountain and river isolation remains a proposed explanation, not a directly measured gene-flow barrier.
研究加入 burtoniorum 正模序列及若干名称的模式地参考，以区别早前宽泛标签与较窄支系；用 Sanger、纳米孔扩增子方法处理 16S、12S、COI 及核 RAG1。候选阈值有差别，部分凭证形态不足。高自举支持不是繁殖隔离证明或通用等级标准。山地、河流隔离仍是提出的解释，不是直接测定的基因流屏障。
ecology
The new cloud-forest account has unresolved specimen limits
新云雾林记述具有未解决的标本限制

The paganus account describes two Ecuadorian cloud-forest localities, night-time litter and vegetation observations, and a gravid female. It does not establish observed egg deposition, full development, diet or genus-wide ecological requirements. Repeated paratype numbers across sex/age categories and differing holotype observation/collection dates remain unresolved in the pending source record. The authors’ Near Threatened proposal is dated interpretation; encounter frequency is not a census and protected-area presence is not a demographic test.
paganus 记述描述厄瓜多尔两个云雾林地点、夜间落叶与植被观察及怀卵雌性；没有确立产卵观察、完整发育、食性或全属生态需求。副模编号在性别／年龄类别间重复，以及正模观察／采集日期不同，均在待映射来源记录中保留未解决。作者近危建议是有年代的解释；遇见频率不是普查，保护地内存在不是种群动态检验。

name: Boulenophrys
sourceConcept: 2025 hengshanensis type-based revision, unmatched gutu description and selected congener comparisons
readScope: Sampling, molecular/morphological results, selected taxonomic type/diagnostic/comparison/ecology paragraphs and all Discussion paragraphs read; no independent supplementary or original-sequence reanalysis

scope.en: One local taxonomic revision and explicitly bounded comparator statements; not complete genus biology or independently certified identity for every historical specimen.
scope.zh: 一次地方分类修订及明确受限的比较陈述，不是全属完整生物学或每件历史标本身份的独立认证。

sectionLocators: PMC12466624 XML sec3dot2 paragraphs 1,4; sec3dot3 paragraphs 4–6; sec4 paragraph 1
PMC12466624 XML sec3dot3 paragraphs 7,15,24,34–38; sec3dot2 paragraph 3
PMC12466624 XML sec3dot3 paragraphs 16,40; sec4 paragraphs 3–4
sections: taxonomy
Historical types and sequence labels require separate reconciliation
历史模式与序列标签需要分别协调

The Hengshan revision distinguishes two local lineages by comparison with historical, unsequenced hengshanensis types. Nine newly collected specimens were associated with that revised name; fifteen and the previously hengshanensis-labelled 2021 molecular material were assigned to newly described gutu. Gutu has no exact pinned accepted-species match and remains pending. Two unmatched comparison spellings also remain unmapped. The named accepted-species pages preserve the fixed catalogue structure and the paper’s limited reassessment rather than claiming every old record has been reidentified.
衡山修订与未测序的历史 hengshanensis 模式比较，区分两个地方支系；九件新采标本关联于修订名称，十五件及早前 2021 年标 hengshanensis 的分子材料被分配给新描述 gutu。gutu 无确切固定接受物种匹配，保留待映射；两个未匹配比较拼写也未映射。接受名称物种页保留固定目录结构与论文有限重新评估，不声称每个旧记录都已重新鉴定。
morphology
Type samples and single comparator characters have different depth
模式样本与单个比较性状详实程度不同

The revised hengshanensis diagnosis reports nine male measurements and one female, while the gutu diagnosis uses seven males and eight females. The paper additionally compares many congeners using size, teeth, heel posture or toe fringes. Such selected statements support narrow morphology sections, not full biological readers. The reported PCA combined variance conflicts with the sum of the two printed component percentages, so no corrected combined value is presented as certified. Source characters and denominator limits remain visible in the linked pages.
修订 hengshanensis 诊断列九雄测量与一雌，gutu 诊断用七雄、八雌；论文还以体型、齿、踵姿势或趾缘比较许多同属种。这些所选陈述支持有限形态章节，不构成完整生物学读本。所报 PCA 合并方差与两个所印主成分百分比之和不同，因此不把修正合并值呈为已认证。链接页保留来源性状及分母限制。
reproduction
Partial sympatry and calling seasons suggest an untested barrier
部分同域及鸣叫季提示未检验的屏障

Both local lineages were reported near streams and overlapped around 700–1100 m. The ecology and discussion sections differ in the starting months assigned to their calling seasons. The authors suggest seasonal separation as one possible prezygotic factor; calls alone do not directly measure mating barriers, complete reproductive timing or gene flow. No genus-wide diet, larval chronology or conservation category follows from this local revision, and the authors recommend further life-history and population work.
两个地方支系均报告于溪边，约 700–1100 米重叠。生态与讨论段给的鸣叫季开始月份不同。作者提议季节分离可能是合子前因素之一；仅有鸣声不能直接测量交配屏障、完整繁殖时序或基因流。地方修订不能提供全属食性、幼体时序或保护等级；作者建议进一步自然史及种群研究。

scope.zh: 原始广义 Noblella 概念及所选固定子页；未认证全部凭证身份或当前全属生物学综合。

name: Phyllonastes
sourceConcept: 2024 northern Noblella clade and arutam types, alongside pinned Phyllonastes combinations
sectionLocators: PMC11453160 XML sec5 paragraph 1; sec11 paragraphs 1–2; sec15 paragraph 2
PMC11453160 XML sec8 paragraph 1; sec12 paragraphs 6–10,14; sec14 paragraphs 1–3
PMC11453160 XML sec14 paragraphs 3–5; sec15 paragraph 4
sections: taxonomy
Original northern-clade names retain their historical genus
原始北方支系名称保留历史属名

The arutam study uses Noblella sensu lato and recovers separate northern and southern clades. Several northern names, including arutam, use Phyllonastes in the pinned catalogue. The selected links preserve original source combinations beside those fixed names. References labelled myrmecoides occur in both distant clades and require voucher/type revision; they are not pooled into one biological account. This reading route does not independently certify every generic transfer or historically reported individual.
arutam 研究使用广义 Noblella，并恢复分开的南北支系。若干北方名称（含 arutam）在固定目录使用 Phyllonastes。所选链接在固定名称旁保留原始来源组合。标 myrmecoides 的参考出现在两个远缘支系，需要凭证／模式修订，不合并为一个生物学记述。阅读路线不能独立认证每个属级转移或历史报告个体。
morphology
Detailed new types differ from selected older comparisons
详细新模式不同于所选旧比较

Arutam has fourteen types, eight males and six females, and one cleared male supplies the osteological description. The paper compares other names through selected external and skeletal characters, using original type concepts for problematic lochites and myrmecoides labels. New arutam measurements and the single-male finger/toe phalangeal counts do not become measurements for every linked species. Cartilage was omitted and weak ossification retained; comparative detail remains uneven across species.
arutam 有十四件模式：八雄六雌；一个透明染色雄性提供骨骼描述。论文用所选外部、骨骼性状比较其他名称，对有问题的 lochites、myrmecoides 标签使用原始模式概念。新的 arutam 测量及单雄指趾骨计数不能成为每个链接物种的测量。软骨省略及弱骨化限制保留，各种比较详实程度仍不一致。
ecology
One local stomach and risk proposal do not describe the genus
一个地方胃样本与风险建议不能描述全属

Arutam was recorded in Río Blanco leaf litter, mostly at night, with three morning observations and no heard calls. One stomach held thirteen invertebrate prey items. Its EOO, AOO and one threat-defined locality underpin the authors’ dated Critically Endangered proposal, rather than a newly verified official category. These local observations establish neither a genus-wide ant preference nor complete activity, developmental or conservation patterns.
arutam 记录于 Río Blanco 落叶，多数夜间观察，另有三次晨间记录，未听到鸣声。一个胃有十三个无脊椎猎物项目。其分布范围、占据面积及一个按威胁定义地点，支持作者有年代的极危建议，不是新核实官方等级。这些地方观察既不确立全属蚂蚁偏好，也不提供完整活动、发育或保护模式。

name: Noblella
sourceConcept: 2024 broad Noblella framework, including the southern reference clade
sectionLocators: PMC11453160 XML sec11 paragraph 1; sec15 paragraphs 1–2
PMC11453160 XML sec5 paragraph 1; sec15 paragraphs 2–3
sections: evolution
The southern reference clade is one study framework
南方参考支系属于一次研究框架

The 2024 16S analysis places losamigos, madreselva, pygmaea and thiuni in a southern clade with Psychrophrynella references, separate from northern names historically called Noblella. The matrix comprises eighty-two new and reference individuals over 1104 base pairs. This supports a bounded reference placement, not complete nuclear-genome history or an independent modern revision of the genus. The source spelling pygmea remains recorded alongside the fixed pygmaea name.
2024 年 16S 分析将 losamigos、madreselva、pygmaea、thiuni 置于与 Psychrophrynella 参考一起的南方支系，区别于历史也称 Noblella 的北方名称。矩阵含八十二个新旧参考个体、1104 碱基对。这支持有限参考定位，不是完整核基因组历史或独立当代属修订。来源拼写 pygmea 与固定名称 pygmaea 并列记录。
taxonomy
Uncertain broad labels prevent automatic trait transfer
不确定宽泛标签阻止性状自动转移

The source places myrmecoides-labelled specimens in both northern and southern clades and recommends revision of those vouchers and the species type series. The arutam single-male skeletal description and local diet belong to the newly described northern population, not automatically to southern Noblella species. Selected child pages therefore carry only their documented reference-placement scopes. Similar small bodies do not certify homologous skeletal reductions, identical life histories or complete identities across historical labels.
来源将标 myrmecoides 的标本置于南北两个支系，建议修订这些凭证及物种模式系列。arutam 单雄骨骼描述及地方食性属于新描述北方种群，不自动转给南方 Noblella 物种。因此所选子页仅保留已记录参考定位范围。相似小体型不能认证同源骨骼减少、相同生活史或历史标签间完整身份。

name: Leptobrachella
sourceConcept: 2025 kungfu description and broad congener comparisons; kungfu absent pinned accepted-species list
readScope: Phylogenetic methods/results, types, diagnosis, variation, ecology/conservation, all five comparisons and all three Discussion paragraphs read; supplements, raw sequences and comparator types not independently reanalysed

scope.en: Selected source comparisons, not complete genus biology, validated global key or current official risk assessment.
scope.zh: 所选来源比较，不是全属完整生物学、经验证全球检索表或当前官方风险评估。

sectionLocators: PMC12627998 XML sec17 paragraphs 1–5; sec9–10
PMC12627998 XML SECID0EZEAC paragraph 1; SECID0E23BG paragraph 1; SECID0EGHCI paragraph 1
PMC12627998 XML sec9 and sec16; sec17 paragraphs 4–5
sections: morphology
A broad comparison is not a new sample for every species
广泛比较不是每个物种的新样本

The kungfu paper describes six male types but compares many congeners through selected glands, fringes, webbing, skin and sex-specific sizes. The linked fixed species pages retain those exact comparator scopes, including female serasanae contrasted with male kungfu rather than relabelling that female value as male. Kungfu has no exact pinned accepted-species match; its own diagnosis remains pending. These short comparisons do not constitute complete species biology or a globally validated identification key.
kungfu 论文描述六雄模式，却用所选腺体、缘、蹼、皮肤及分性别体长比较许多同属种。链接固定物种页保留确切比较范围，包括将雌 serasanae 与雄 kungfu 比较，而不把该雌值重标雄值。kungfu 无确切固定接受物种匹配，其自身诊断保留待映射。简短比较不是完整物种生物学或经全球验证检索表。
evolution
Strong support in a short mitochondrial dataset has limits
短线粒体数据中的强支持有其限制

The matrix is 512 base pairs of 16S and includes 110 new and reference samples, six newly collected kungfu males and two outgroups. The new lineage is reported sister to yunkaiensis with bootstrap 99, posterior probability 1.00 and mean p-distance 4.9%. These values support the paper’s combined argument, not whole-genome isolation, a dated dispersal history or a universal species threshold. The unusual printed PSRF convergence statement is retained in source limits rather than certified as a reproduced diagnostic procedure.
矩阵为 512 碱基对 16S，含 110 个新旧参考样本、六个新采 kungfu 雄及两个外群。新支系所报与 yunkaiensis 为姐妹，自举 99、后验 1.00、平均 p 距离 4.9%。数值支持论文综合论证，不是全基因组隔离、有日期扩散史或通用种阈值。原文不寻常 PSRF 收敛说法保留于来源限制，不认证为已复现诊断流程。
taxonomy
Conflicts stay visible rather than becoming a corrected key
冲突保持可见而不成为修正检索表

The paper’s type-point and ecology elevations disagree, and two comparator traits disagree with the separately read deocaensis description. The pallida and applebyi pages explicitly retain both source statements and link both source keys; no invented variation or corrected universal character resolves them. Calling-season and Data Deficient statements for kungfu remain author observations and a dated proposal. Further type, range and life-history evidence is needed before these comparisons can support complete biological readers.
论文模式点与生态海拔不同，两个比较性状与另行已读 deocaensis 描述不同。pallida、applebyi 页明确保留两种来源陈述，并链接两个来源键；不虚构变异或修正普遍性状来解决它们。kungfu 鸣叫季及资料缺乏说法保留为作者观察及有年代建议。在这些比较可支持完整生物学读本前，仍需更多模式、分布及生活史证据。

name: Centrolene
sourceConcept: Two La Enramada descriptions, selected comparator names and revised condor-labelled references
readScope: Fieldwork, phylogenetic results, selected diagnosis/comparison/type/colour/natural-history paragraphs and all discussion read; no independent supplementary sequences or unavailable acoustic recordings

scope.en: Selected type and reference scopes; not complete genus biology, accepted identity of every historic voucher or current official risk categories.
scope.zh: 所选模式及参考范围，不是全属完整生物学、每个历史凭证的接受身份或当前官方风险等级。

sectionLocators: PMC10178282 XML sec6 paragraph 1; sec12 paragraphs 8–10,18,29–30,38,40; sec13 paragraph 1
PMC10178282 XML sec11 paragraphs 1–2; sec13 paragraphs 2–3
PMC10178282 XML sec12 paragraphs 10,30,40; sec13 paragraph 5
sections: taxonomy
Syntopic specimens can represent separate lineages
同地点标本可以代表不同支系

Three La Enramada males initially treated together were described as two species: two camposi types and one ericsmithi type. Their shared steep creek and overlapping observation site do not imply closest relationship. The paper separately reinterprets three condor-labelled or unnamed vouchers rather than merging all labels. Selected links retain original spellings altitudinale and antioquiense alongside fixed catalogue names, with no certification that every earlier broad identification is equivalent.
La Enramada 三雄最初一起处理，后来描述为两种：两件 camposi 模式及一件 ericsmithi 模式。共享陡溪及重叠观察点不意味着最近亲关系。论文另分别重新解释三件标 condor 或未命名凭证，不合并全部标签。所选链接在固定目录名称旁保留 altitudinale、antioquiense 原文拼写，不认证每个早前宽泛鉴定等同。
evolution
Marker distances and geography do not directly measure barriers
标记距离与地理不能直接测量屏障

Camposi is recovered sister to condor, while ericsmithi is sister to sabini plus an unnamed Ecuadorian reference. Low 12S and larger ND1 distances have different marker scopes, and printed standard errors are not standard deviations. The recent trans-Andean interpretation and suggested reproductive barriers are hypotheses from topology and geography, not directly dated dispersal or measured mating isolation. References reassigned at voucher level remain traceable, not universal concept corrections.
camposi 被恢复为 condor 姐妹，ericsmithi 则为 sabini 与未命名厄瓜多尔参考之姐妹。较低 12S 与较大 ND1 距离标记范围不同，所印标准误不是标准差。近期跨安第斯解释及拟议繁殖屏障是从拓扑、地理提出的假说，不是直接定年扩散或测定交配隔离。凭证级重新分配保留追溯，不是普遍概念修正。
reproduction
Calls and later nondetections leave substantial unknowns
鸣声与后续未检出留下大量未知

Both new species called during March 2015 surveys, but no recordings were taken; advertisement properties, eggs, parental care, fighting and tadpoles remain unknown. The two-male and one-male descriptions cannot supply female or population-wide biology. Surveys in 2019 and 2022 did not collect more individuals, supporting limited knowledge rather than proof of extinction. The authors’ 2023 Data Deficient proposal is retained with its date, and no whole-genus conservation or complete breeding calendar is inferred.
两新种于 2015 年三月调查鸣叫，但未录音，鸣声参数、卵、亲代照护、争斗、蝌蚪仍未知。两雄及一雄描述不能提供雌性或种群整体生物学。2019、2022 年调查未再采到，支持了解有限而不是灭绝证明。作者 2023 年资料缺乏建议保留日期，不推断全属保护状态或完整繁殖日历。

name: Hynobius
sourceConcept: 2023 Fujian bambusicolus types, local egg/larval/acoustic observations and southern-Chinese mitochondrial comparisons
readScope: Field sampling, molecular methods/results, morphometry/results, egg/larval/acoustic methods, nomenclatural account and Discussion read; Table4 and selected Table3 scope; no raw audio, model, genome or original specimens independently analysed

scope.en: Named local samples and cited reference comparisons; no complete genus biology, current official population assessment or independent historical voucher reconciliation.
scope.zh: 命名地方样本及所引参考比较，不是全属完整生物学、当前官方种群评估或独立历史凭证协调。

sectionLocators: PMC10215769 XML sec2dot1 paragraph1; sec2dot5 paragraphs1–4; Table4; sec16 paragraphs5–8
PMC10215769 XML sec2dot6–7 paragraphs1; sec16 paragraphs8,12–13; sec4 paragraphs3–4
PMC10215769 XML sec2dot4 paragraphs1–4; sec3dot1 paragraphs1–3; Table3 caption; sec4 paragraph2
sections: morphology
Released adults and immature types are separate evidence units
释放成体与未成熟模式是不同证据单位

The Fujian account measured two wild adults and four immature vouchers. Table4 calls the types juveniles, whereas nomenclature calls them subadults; total length includes the tail and is separate from snout–vent length. The adult photograph-based 3D model is manually reconstructed rather than a CT specimen. These scopes cannot supply age-complete morphology or a whole-genus skeletal key, and the small adult series should not become a population-wide size range.
福建记述测两野生成体及四未成熟凭证。表四称模式幼体，命名段称亚成体；全长含尾，与吻肛长分开。成年照片参考三维模型为手工重建，不是 CT 标本。这些范围不能提供全部年龄形态或全属骨骼检索表，小成体系列不应成为种群整体体长范围。
reproduction
Local egg sacs and captive milestones leave denominator limits
地方卵袋与人工发育留下分母限制

Wild egg sacs, laboratory larvae kept at 26 °C and a single provoked sound are distinct observations. Eight pairs of sacs in methods become eight sacs in discussion; the late developmental labels also differ. Cannibalism under bloodworm feeding and tail-raising after disturbance are captive observations, not proof of natural prey preference or defensive effectiveness. Population numbers and CR interpretation remain inferred rather than counted, and exact breeding-site details are not reproduced.
野外卵袋、26摄氏度饲养幼体及一次诱发声音是不同观察。方法八对卵袋在讨论成为八袋，较晚发育标签也不同。喂摇蚊幼虫时同类相食及受扰抬尾属于人工观察，不证明天然猎物偏好或防御有效性。种群数及极危解释仍为推断而非计数，不复制精确繁殖地细节。
evolution
Different mitochondrial trees do not supply one resolved history
不同线粒体树不提供单一已解决历史

The paper compares 16S, Cytb and COI separately and in a concatenation; reference sample denominators, lengths and support differ. COI supports amjiensis as a close relative, while other placements are weaker or different. The Results and Table3 reverse highest/lowest wording for the same 0.098 model-based comparison. The linked species pages retain such contradictions and distinguish substitutions per site from per-year rates, raw p-distances or nuclear-genome evidence. A cited southern-lineage age is not a newly estimated bambusicolus divergence date.
论文分别及合并比较16S、Cytb、COI，参考分母、长度及支持不同。COI支持 amjiensis 为近亲，其他定位较弱或不同。结果与表三对同一0.098模型比较的最高／最低措辞相反。链接物种页保留这些矛盾，区分每位点替换与每年速率、原始p距离或核基因组证据。所引南方支系年龄不是新估计 bambusicolus 分化日期。

name: Duttaphrynus
sourceConcept: Source-labelled melanostictus Chinese population organ-size comparison; no genus-wide sampling
readScope: All measurement/data-analysis/results/discussion/conclusion paragraphs read; Tables1/5 fully read; raw individual data and source voucher identity not independently analysed

scope.en: One source-labelled species and five geographic samples, not full genus physiology or certified identity of every historic voucher.
scope.zh: 一个来源标名物种及五个地理样本，不是全属生理学或每件历史凭证身份认证。

PMC10451166 XML sec3dot1–2; sec4 paragraphs1–7; sec5 paragraph1
sections: morphology
Measurement types differ within the selected organ study
所选器官研究内的测量类型不同

The melanostictus study includes 153 animals across five Chinese sites, with 147 brain measurements and one site excluded from testis analysis because it had only one male. Preserved dry organ mass, photographed tract length and geometric brain-volume estimates have different units and processing histories. Relative organ sizes are regression residuals, not simple organ/body percentages. The linked page retains those denominators and the source’s identification rather than presenting the measurements as genus-wide anatomical limits.
melanostictus 研究含中国五地153只动物、147个脑测量，一地因只有一雄排除睾丸分析。保存后器官干重、照片消化道长度、几何脑体积估计具有不同单位及处理历史。相对器官大小是回归残差，不是简单器官／身体百分比。链接页保留分母及来源鉴定，不将测量呈为全属解剖界限。
evolution
Geographic association does not certify an adaptive mechanism
地理关联不能认证适应机制

The paper reports differences among populations in nine relative organ measures, but significant altitude/latitude associations only for testes. It discusses reproductive investment, oxygen supply, digestion and brain-cost hypotheses without directly measuring mating success, metabolism, food assimilation or learning. A few geographic samples do not establish natural-selection mechanisms, all species’ life histories or complete taxonomic equivalence of the source-labelled melanostictus populations.
论文报告九个相对器官量在种群间有差别，但仅睾丸与海拔／纬度显著关联。讨论繁殖投入、供氧、消化及脑成本假说，却未直接测量交配成功、代谢、食物同化或学习。少数地理样本不能确立自然选择机制、全部物种生活史或来源标 melanostictus 种群完整分类等同性。

Reference labels and small distances do not resolve every species concept

The paper reuses listed Dryophytes mitogenomes and earlier RAD reads for suweonensis, immaculatus and flaviventris to reconstruct mitochondrial fragments. A reported maximum COX1 comparison of 1.9% between suweonensis and flaviventris is not a universal threshold or a reason to merge names. Clade-level candidates are not measured adaptations of every species
支系级候选不是每个物种的测定适应

sections: evolution
Accession-bounded references support a sampled mitochondrial clade
序列号限定参考支持所采线粒体支系

Table1 contributes multiple reused Boana-labelled mitochondrial references, and the source reports their sampled monophyly. The selected child links identify the recorded accessions and limit the claim to this dataset. These are not newly collected populations, a complete nuclear-genome phylogeny or all-species range evidence. Reference inclusion supplies no new calls, diet, reproductive timing or developmental measurements for each species.
表一贡献多条重用的 Boana 标名线粒体参考，来源报告所采单系。所选子链接记录序列号，并把陈述限制于该数据集；不是新采种群、完整核基因组系统树或全部种分布证据。纳入参考不提供每种新的鸣声、食性、繁殖时间或发育测量。
taxonomy
Affinity labels stay separate from accepted species identities
近似鉴定标签与接受物种身份分开

Two Table1 entries are labelled Boana aff. courtoisae and Boana aff. lanciformis. The affinity qualifiers indicate unresolved reference identities and are not silently converted into accepted courtoisae or lanciformis child records. Likewise, repeated site-labelled references elsewhere in the table do not represent forty distinct new species. The source’s broader family framework is retained as dated context rather than certified as the pinned modern classification.
表一两项标 Boana aff. courtoisae、Boana aff. lanciformis。近似限定表示参考身份未解决，不悄然转换为接受 courtoisae 或 lanciformis 子记录。同样，表内其他重复地点参考不代表四十个不同新物种。来源较广科级框架保留为有年代背景，不认证为固定当代分类。

name: Raorchestes
sourceConcept: 2023 Western Ghats single-male skull sample, bamboo Ochlandrae clade and cited life histories
readScope: All Sampling/CT/Analysis/Results/Discussion and Conclusions paragraphs read; original meshes, coordinates, supplementary voucher table and cited primary natural-history works not independently analysed

sections: morphology
Single-male scans describe comparative external skull shape
单雄扫描描述比较外部头骨形状

The study scans one adult male from each of fifty-five bush-frog lineages/species and uses thirty-six external skull landmarks. Its bamboo-associated clade occupies a relatively broad, flattened skull region of morphospace with differences in jaw-joint position and several bones. This is preserved comparative anatomy, not population-wide frequencies or female/larval development. The five selected species pages retain their lineage context and clearly separate new skull data from cited breeding or diet observations.
研究对五十五个灌丛蛙支系／物种各扫描一成年雄，用三十六个外部头骨标志点。竹栖支系占据相对宽扁头骨形态空间，颌关节位置及若干骨不同。这是保存材料比较解剖，不是种群整体频率或雌／幼体发育。五个所选物种页保留支系背景，并清楚区分新头骨数据与被引繁殖、食性观察。
evolution
One clade and different tests constrain adaptive claims
一个支系与不同检验限制适应陈述

After phylogenetic correction, habitat was not significantly associated with skull shape, while cranial size had a small significant association. A separate comparative analysis detects a rate shift recovered in ninety-six of one hundred randomized trees. These findings have different hypotheses and denominators; the rate statistic is not causal certainty for bamboo adaptation. The study acknowledges only one transition into bamboo breeding, so independent replicate origins are lacking in this dataset.
系统关系校正后，生境与头骨形状不显著关联，头骨大小则有较小显著关联。另一个比较分析检出速率转变，在一百随机树中九十六恢复。结果检验假说及分母不同，速率统计不是竹栖适应因果确定性。研究承认仅一个转入竹内繁殖事件，因此该数据缺独立重复起源。
reproduction
Bamboo life-history functions are cited or proposed
竹内生活史功能是引用或提议

Bamboo-internode breeding and egg guarding are cited life-history context. Flat skulls could help passage or block intruders, but the study did not manipulate skulls or measure defence success. The chalazodes semi-slug meal comes from earlier work; its proposed pre-breeding nutritional benefit and extension to other bamboo frogs remain untested. No complete genus diet, clutch distribution, care duration or developmental chronology follows from this skull study.
竹节内繁殖与守卵是引用生活史背景。扁头可能助通过或阻入侵者，但研究未操纵头骨或测防御成功。chalazodes 半蛞蝓餐来自较早工作，所提繁殖前营养益处及推广至其他竹栖蛙仍未检验。头骨研究不能提供全属完整食性、窝卵分布、照护时长或发育时序。

sourceConcept: 2023 twelve-species Ethiopian Highlands Ptychadena clade, not the whole genus
readScope: Ptychadena amharensis: XML abstract, Methods 2.1–2.5, Results 3.1–3.3 including Table1 and figure captions, Discussion 4.1–4.3 read; supplementary tables, original sequence reads, deposited assemblies and analysis pipelines not independently reanalysed; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

scope.en: A sampled twelve-species highland clade; mitochondrial biogeographic models and nuclear population comparisons, not a complete genus synthesis.
scope.zh: 一个取样十二物种高地支系；线粒体生物地理模型及核种群比较，不是全属完整综述。

sectionLocators: PMC10434514 XML Methods2.1–2.3; Table1; Results3.1–3.2
PMC10434514 XML Methods2.4–2.5; Results3.3; Discussion4.1–4.2
PMC10434514 XML Results3.2; Discussion4.3
sections: evolution
A highland clade sampled with two genomic compartments
由两类基因组数据取样的高地支系

The study analyses 294 focal mitochondrial specimens across twelve Ethiopian Highlands species and a 135-individual nuclear-SNP subset. Its three named clades are cooperi, erlangeri and neumanni. These names describe relationships within the selected highland lineage, rather than divisions covering the entire genus. All mitochondrial control regions remained incompletely assembled. Nuclear comparisons partly agree with mitochondrial population structure, including three versus four clusters in cooperi and no matching nuclear geography for the two neumanni mitochondrial groups. Species pages retain their different sample sizes and marker-specific findings.

研究分析埃塞俄比亚高地十二物种的 294 个线粒体标本及 135 个体核 SNP 子集。三个命名支系为 cooperi、erlangeri、neumanni；这些名称描述所选高地谱系内关系，不是覆盖全属的划分。全部线粒体控制区仍未完整组装。核比较与线粒体种群结构部分一致，包括 cooperi 的三个核与四个线粒体组，以及 neumanni 的两个线粒体组没有对应核地理结构。物种页保留各自不同样本数及标记结果。
distribution
Cross-rift history is a reconstruction with uncertainty
跨裂谷历史是有不确定性的重建

The mitochondrial clock estimates the highland clade ancestor near 11.7 million years ago, with a reported interval of 8.827–15.494 million years; the selected ancestral-area model favours the eastern side with probability 69%. Dispersal estimates differ among lineages, and the neumanni clade has alternative east- and west-origin scenarios. These are fossil-calibrated mitochondrial and biogeographic model results, not directly observed migrations or dated nuclear species splits. The authors acknowledge that gene divergence can predate population or species divergence. Geological and climatic mechanisms remain interpretations of the reconstructed pattern.
线粒体分子钟估计高地支系祖先约在 1170 万年前，所报区间为 882.7–1549.4 万年前；所选祖先区域模型以 69% 概率偏向东侧。不同谱系的扩散估计不同，neumanni 支系有东起与西起两种情景。这是化石校准线粒体及生物地理模型结果，不是直接观察的迁徙或定年的核物种分裂。作者承认基因分化可早于种群或物种分化；地质与气候机制仍是对重建模式的解释。
conservation
Revised names matter when interpreting dated range assessments
解释有日期的范围评估时须考虑修订名称

The 2023 authors call for reassessments because older species concepts and distribution maps can combine lineages now separated. They identify restricted eastern ranges for several species, yet population size, fragmentation and decline still require measurements. The selected twelve reading links cover the focal highland species, not all Ptychadena or every locality in their ranges. Dated Red List references in the paper are not independently verified current categories, and sampled nucleotide diversity or undetected structure alone does not quantify extinction risk.
2023 年作者要求重评，因为旧物种概念及分布图可能合并如今已分开的谱系。他们指出若干物种东侧范围有限，但种群数量、破碎化与下降仍需测量。所选十二条阅读链接覆盖目标高地物种，不是全部 Ptychadena，也不是其范围内每个地点。论文有日期的红色名录引用不是独立核实的当前类别，取样核苷酸多样性或未检出结构本身不能量化灭绝风险。

sections: evolution
Missing loci and unresolved relationships constrain the tree
缺失位点与未解决关系限制系统树

The combined phylogeny uses three mitochondrial and three nuclear fragments, with different marker coverage among Table2 species. Only lengquanensis (Methods spelling), raoi and silvaenaias supplied the nine newly sequenced nuclear fragments. Pollicaris and verrucosus were excluded. Gracilloides groups with clades I and II, but their branching order remains unresolved, prompting three alternative hypotheses. Nineteen selected links match fixed COL26.8 accepted names; silvaenaias and inexpectatus retain unassigned source rows rather than being silently transferred to other accepted pages.

结合树使用三个线粒体及三个核片段，表 2 各物种标记覆盖不同。只有 lengquanensis（方法拼法）、raoi、silvaenaias 提供九个新核片段；pollicaris、verrucosus 未纳入。Gracilloides 与 I、II 支系聚组，但分枝顺序未解决，因此分析三个替代假说。十九条所选链接匹配固定 COL26.8 接受名称；silvaenaias、inexpectatus 保留未归属来源行，不默默转入其他接受物种页。
distribution
Two island-colonization events depend on historical models
两个入岛事件依赖历史模型

BSSVS and selected DIVALIKE+j analyses favour mainland origin with one event for the eiffingeri–berylliniris–wangi ancestor and another for the idiootocus lineage. The discussion gives approximate dates of five and one million years ago, while acknowledging uncertainty from unresolved topology. Pure DIVALIKE instead reconstructs widespread ancestors and vicariance. Model choice therefore materially changes the history inferred; AICc weights of 0.59 or 0.63 for the selected model are comparative fit weights, not probabilities that an observed ocean crossing occurred.

BSSVS 及所选 DIVALIKE+j 分析偏向大陆起源，一个事件针对 eiffingeri–berylliniris–wangi 祖先，另一个针对 idiootocus 谱系。讨论给出约五百万和一百万年前，同时承认未解决拓扑造成不确定性。纯 DIVALIKE 则重建广分布祖先及隔离分化。因此模型选择实质改变推断历史；所选模型 0.59 或 0.63 的 AICc 权重是相对拟合权重，不是观察到跨海事件的概率。
evolution
Different diversification tests support different strengths of inference
不同分化检验支持不同强度推断

The lineage-through-time curve and survival model B suggest a slight slowdown; model B has AIC91.32 and beta1.53. The separate constant-rate gamma test gives −1.01 with p=0.31, so it does not reject a constant rate, although the A-versus-B survival-model comparison gives p=0.02. These tests are not interchangeable. Proposed filling of geographical or ecological space is an explanation requiring further evidence, not measured habitat saturation, a species-specific extinction rate or a prediction of future decline.
谱系随时间曲线及生存模型 B 提示轻微减速，B 的 AIC 为 91.32、beta 为 1.53。独立恒定速率 gamma 检验为 −1.01、p=0.31，因此不拒绝恒定速率，尽管生存模型 A 与 B 比较为 p=0.02。这些检验不能互换。拟议的地理或生态空间填满是尚需证据的解释，不是已测生境饱和、某物种灭绝率或未来下降预测。

sections: evolution
Pumilio evidence supports an ancestral loss hypothesis
Pumilio 证据支持祖先丢失假说

The study combines dendrobatid bait-capture nondetection with a pooled pumilio eye transcriptome and searches of pumilio and imitator genomes. Eleven pumilio population eye samples were pooled into one expression assembly. Genomic gaps and possible assembly errors remain limitations, and absent recognizable gene or pseudogene does not resolve deletion versus degradation beyond recognition. These findings support an ancestral SWS2-loss hypothesis; they are not complete genomic surveys of every Oophaga species.

被引颜色行为不是新视蛋白实验

sections: evolution
Imitator is a genomic comparison, not an eye-expression sample
Imitator 为基因组比较而非眼表达样本

The imitator assembly includes LWS and MECP2 but no recognized SWS2 between them; whole-assembly searches likewise fail to find the gene or recognizable pseudogene. Positive controls detect known SWS2 in other frogs. Unlike pumilio, imitator does not provide the pooled-eye expression experiment here. sections: ecology
Two cold-acclimated species with unequal hypoxia exposure
两低温驯化物种的不等低氧暴露

The study compares six controls and six experimental frogs per species after cold acclimation. Experimental amurensis shared one10.3L container and spent ten days near0.1mg/L after a seven-day oxygen decline. Dybowskii occupied separate0.63L containers and reached a distress-defined endpoint near0.9–1.1mg/L much earlier. These different designs do not isolate a matched species effect or give wild lethal thresholds. New amurensis brain data are combined with earlier heart/liver data; the dybowskii three-organ measurements are new here.
研究在低温驯化后比较每物种六对照与六实验蛙。实验 amurensis 共用一个 10.3L 容器，七天耗氧后在约 0.1mg/L 再保持十天。Dybowskii 分别在 0.63L 容器，较早于约 0.9–1.1mg/L 达到按严重状态界定的终点。不同设计不能隔离匹配物种效应或给出野外致死阈值。新 amurensis 脑数据与较早心肝数据结合，dybowskii 三器官在此为新测。
ecology
Concentration patterns constrain the proposed pathway
浓度模式限制拟议途径

Lactate accumulation was greater in dybowskii despite shorter exposure; succinate similarity holds for liver and brain, not heart. Glycerol was present and increased in dybowskii but remained below hypoxic amurensis. The proposed alanine/glycerol/2,3-butanediol diversions may help explain lower lactate, yet tissue NMR concentrations do not measure flux or protection. Unknown reactions, alternative amino-acid transport and genomic or enzymatic confirmation remain unresolved. No uniform Rana tolerance trait follows from two sampled species.
尽管暴露较短，dybowskii 乳酸积累较大；琥珀酸相近适用于肝脑而非心。Dybowskii 甘油存在且升高，但低于低氧 amurensis。拟议丙氨酸／甘油／2,3-丁二醇转向或可解释较低乳酸，但组织 NMR 浓度未测流量或保护。未知反应、替代氨基酸运输及基因组或酶学确认仍未解决。不能由两取样物种得出统一 Rana 耐受性状。

sections: taxonomy
Maternal lineages and nuclear classes require different evidence
母系谱系与核归属类别需要不同证据

The paper finds B,D andU1 mitochondrial lineages among its Japanese samples and assigns four individuals of D to sligoi. Fourteen microsatellite loci classify a river assemblage containing F1, backcross and ambiguous hybrids; nuclear PCA separates japonicus from the Chinese group but substantially overlaps Chinese lineages. Maternal placement alone therefore does not certify unadmixed ancestry or settle every Chinese species boundary. U1 remains unnamed, and jiangxiensis enters as a deposited U2 reference rather than a newly discovered Japanese individual.
论文在日本样本检出 B、D、U1 线粒体谱系，将四个 D 个体归为 sligoi。十四微卫星位点划分含 F1、回交与模糊杂交的河流组合；核 PCA 分开 japonicus 与中国组，但中国谱系相当重叠。因此母系位置不能独自认证无混合祖先或解决全部中国物种边界。U1 保持未命名，jiangxiensis 为存储 U2 参考，不是日本新发现个体。
morphology
Captive examples do not provide a universal identification key
圈养实例不能提供普遍鉴别检索

The four sligoi assignments combine historical import information with morphology and genetic evidence. A preserved female supplies detailed measurements, whereas live individuals were photographed and tape-measured without invasive detailed examination. Colour and head tubercles vary, and the authors question the accuracy of a historical illustration. These selected observations do not establish species-wide maxima, growth curves or a morphology-only key separating all Andrias. Female-specific marker controls support sex inference for two living males, not a male-only natural population.
四个 sligoi 归属结合历史输入信息、形态及遗传证据。一保存雌性提供详细测量，活个体则拍照、卷尺测量而不作有损详细检查。颜色与头疣有变异，作者质疑历史插图准确性。所选观察不能确立全物种最大值、生长曲线或分开全部 Andrias 的纯形态检索。雌特异标记对照支持两活雄性别推断，不是自然种群只有雄性。
conservation
A dated ex-situ proposal retains origin and outcome uncertainties
有日期迁地提议保留来源及结果不确定性

Two sligoi males were alive in captivity at the paper’s reporting time, while two other identified individuals had died. Their native Chinese origins are unknown; Japanese holdings cannot be counted as native range. The proposed sperm/germ-cell storage and search for females are future actions, not successful recovery outcomes. Calls for protecting genetic diversity and resolving taxonomy remain warranted within this source’s evidence, but no current stock count, official status update or extinction proof is independently established by these dated observations.
论文报告时两 sligoi 雄圈养存活，另两鉴定个体已死。其中国原生来源未知，日本持有地不能计为原生范围。所提精子／生殖细胞保存及寻找雌性为未来行动，不是成功恢复结果。保护遗传多样性与解决分类的呼吁有此来源内证据，但有日期观察未独立确立当前库存、官方等级更新或灭绝证明。

Cryptic summit diversity changes how old names are read

The paper describes imawari and upuigmae, formerly included under satelles, using preserved morphology and microCT comparisons linked to earlier molecular lineages. The imawari series contains five adult males, three adult females and one immature female; upuigmae is described from one adult female. A short rainy-season imawari visit found no females carrying eggs or juveniles, though one had a glutinous back patch. The upuigmae female also carried none when collected. These nondetections do not establish absence of back-brooding, developmental duration or a complete breeding calendar. A disturbed daytime upuigmae encounter is not a demonstrated diurnal lifestyle.
Imawari 系列含五成年雄、三成年雌及一未成熟雌；upuigmae 依据一成年雌描述。短期雨季 imawari 访察未见背负卵或幼体雌性，但一只背有黏斑；upuigmae 雌采时亦未背负。这些未检出不能确立无背负繁殖、发育时长或完整繁殖日历。受扰白天 upuigmae 遭遇不是已证明昼行生活。

Small summit occurrence motivates a dated CR proposal
小顶峰出现范围促成有日期 CR 建议

The authors propose CR for the two new species under B1/B2a,b, citing a single known location, small range and projected fire/climate threats. The melanostictus study samples116males and37females across five Chinese sites, with female-only or male-only samples at several sites and one Pingbian male excluded from modelling. Growth lines supply estimated ages, and age-adjusted models find a positive altitude association with size. A statistical pattern does not demonstrate the proposed mechanism
统计模式不能证明拟议机制

The authors interpret their result using Bergmann’s rule and propose cold-related growth, maturity and longevity mechanisms. Growth rate, age at first reproduction, energy reserves and survival were not directly measured. Skeletochronological sampled ages do not give maximum lifespan, and nonsignificant age differences do not prove identical demographic structures. Structured-light models separate external size measures

The gargarizans study scans244preserved adults from25sites and compares five river-reach groups. External mesh surface area, volume and limb proportions differ from one-dimensional length, internal anatomy or muscle mass. The cited minshanicus altitudinal comparison and andrewsi muscle example are earlier studies, not new scanned samples in this paper. Shape proxies and inconsistent directions limit adaptation claims
形状代理及不一致方向限制适应陈述

Surface-to-volume ratio has inverse-length units, while the reported logarithmic area/volume shape formula requires normalization before a scale-independent interpretation could be certified. The Results elevation-correlation wording conflicts with the Discussion direction of body size and relative area. Proposed temperature, oxygen, food and locomotion mechanisms were not experimentally tested. sections: occurrence
Mountain DNA and lowland observations need different interpretations

In the Tena study, variabilis has a single visual record and malkini two observations at one river site. In contrast, acerus, eriphus and mallii are mountain source taxa assigned from downstream water without a local visual observation. The source treats those mountain signals as false positives for living-organism presence at the monitored sites. Its unnamed Pristimantis sp. (INABIO 15591) remains outside the selected accepted-species links. Combining these histories does not turn molecular transport into a low-elevation range extension.
特纳研究中 variabilis 有一次目视记录，malkini 在一河段有两次观察。相反，acerus、eriphus、mallii 是从下游水样分配出的山地来源类群，监测地未有目视观察。来源将这些山地信号称为监测地点活体存在意义上的假阳性。未命名 Pristimantis sp.（INABIO 15591）不进入所选接受种链接。合并检出史不能把分子迁移变成低海拔分布扩张。
methods
Molecular identity and the location of a live frog are separate questions
分子身份与活蛙位置是不同问题

Short 16S matching, negative controls and a regional reference database support interpretation of the molecular units, but do not themselves locate the animals that shed DNA. Upstream transport is proposed, without tracing particular frogs or molecules. The inconsistent monitoring elevations in Study site and Discussion remain unresolved. Neither a negative water test nor a fitted visual detection probability certifies basin-wide absence, population size or an activity cycle for every Pristimantis.
短片段 16S 匹配、阴性对照及区域参考库支持分子单位解释，却不直接定位释放 DNA 的动物。上游迁移是提议，未追踪特定蛙或分子。地点节与讨论中不一致的监测海拔仍未解决。水样阴性或拟合目视检出概率均不能认证流域缺席、种群大小或全部 Pristimantis 的活动周期。

sections: ecology
A regional quadranus study separates reproductive endpoints
区域 quadranus 研究区分繁殖终点

The quadranus study samples 266 frogs at thirteen mountain sites, then uses different subsets for testes, sperm and ovarian output. Testis size, sperm dimensions, sperm counts and ovarian ova estimates are distinct endpoints. Females are larger in the sampled medians, but age/body-size regression is cross-sectional, not a longitudinal growth experiment. These observations cannot establish the same sexual dimorphism, reproductive investment or mating strategy throughout Nanorana.
Quadranus 研究在十三个山地点取样 266 只蛙，再对睾丸、精子及卵巢输出使用不同子集。睾丸大小、精子尺寸、精子数及卵巢卵估计是不同终点。取样中位数雌性较大，但年龄体型回归是横断面，不是纵向生长实验。观察不能确立全部 Nanorana 相同的性别差异、繁殖投入或交配策略。
methods
Adjusted associations and pairwise exceptions limit mechanistic claims
调整关联及成对例外限制机制陈述

Relative testes differ among populations, while sperm-count differences disappear after covariate adjustment. The weak latitude/count trend is nonsignificant, and nonsignificant count–length association does not prove an absent trade-off. Overall testis-asymmetry tests are nonsignificant despite an LSD exception at one sampled elevation. Larger or longer structures do not directly measure sperm competition, energy allocation, motility or fertilization success; those mechanisms remain hypotheses.
相对睾丸有种群差异，精子数差异在协变量调整后消失。纬度计数趋势弱且不显著，数长关联不显著不能证明无权衡。整体睾丸不对称检验不显著，但一个取样海拔有 LSD 例外。较大或较长结构未直接测量精子竞争、能量分配、运动能力或受精成功，机制仍为提议。
ecology
Environmental correlations support questions for further monitoring
环境相关支持进一步监测问题

The Results models explain 34.7% of relative-testis variation, 31.5% of sperm-size variation and 10% of female output variation; the Discussion uses different sperm percentages and predictor lists. Their inconsistency remains explicit without the original model tables. Climate and topography associations do not certify genetic adaptation, a genus-wide reproductive threshold or a future climate forecast. Habitat-specific management is recommended, not demonstrated recovery, and the paper’s 2025 status wording is not a new official assessment.
结果模型解释相对睾丸变异 34.7%、精子大小 31.5%、雌性输出 10%；讨论使用不同精子百分比及预测因子列表。未有原模型表时明确保留不一致。气候地形关联不能认证遗传适应、全属繁殖阈值或未来气候预测。生境专属管理是建议，不是已证实恢复；论文 2025 状态措辞不是新官方评估。

sections: ecology
Tank-spawned clutches and breeding-adult ages have distinct samples
缸内产卵与繁殖成年年龄具有不同样本

The andrewsi study samples 1,824 reproductive-adult records from seventeen populations over 2007–2013, with ages estimated for 1,563. Clutch work uses ten populations and actual spawning in local pond-water tanks; egg diameter excludes the jelly capsule. Its Methods’ 208 amplectant-toad count is not independently certified here as 208 pairs or complete analysed clutches. These observations do not establish juvenile demography, full geographic distribution or reproductive success across Bufo.
Andrewsi 研究在 2007–2013 年十七种群取样 1,824 个繁殖成年记录，为 1,563 个估龄。卵窝工作使用十个种群及地方池水缸实际产卵，卵径不含胶膜。方法中的 208 个抱对蟾蜍计数未在此独立认证为 208 对或完整分析卵窝。观察不能确立幼体人口学、完整地理分布或全部 Bufo 繁殖成功。
methods
Season length and lifetime activity are estimates under assumptions
季长与终生活动量是在假设下的估计

Growth-season days are defined from daily mean temperature above an unpublished 6 °C activity threshold. Multiplying those annual days by estimated age creates a lifetime-activity proxy, not a tracked lifetime. The youngest and oldest captured reproductive adults are proxies for first reproduction and longevity rather than known life histories. Larger eggs with fewer eggs in shorter seasons are observational associations, while offspring advantage, food limitation and predation remain proposed explanations.
生长季天数来自日均温高于未发表的 6 摄氏度活动阈值。年天数乘估计年龄形成终生活动代理，不是追踪生命历程。最年轻、最老捕获繁殖成年体作为初繁、寿命代理，不是已知生活史。短季较大且较少卵为观察关联，后代优势、食物限制及捕食仍是拟议解释。
ecology
Conflicting summaries prevent a single unqualified growth narrative
冲突概要阻止无条件单一生长叙述

Results and Discussion describe lower mean age in long-season populations, whereas the final Conclusion says larger mean age. Growth-direction summaries also differ, and the clutch-size growth-season F statistic differs between text and Table 1. The selected reader retains those conflicts without a guessed correction or independently reproduced significance. A von Bertalanffy cross-sectional fit does not establish measured individual growth or genetic adaptation; the authors call for common-garden comparisons.
结果及讨论描述长季种群较低平均年龄，最后结论却称较大平均年龄。生长方向概要也不同，窝卵数季长 F 统计正文与表 1 不同。所选读者页保留冲突，不猜测修正或视显著性为独立复现。Von Bertalanffy 横断面拟合未确立测得个体生长或遗传适应，作者提出同园比较。

sections: ecology
Reproduction and juvenile habitats retain source-row denominators
繁殖及幼体生境保留来源行分母

The retained Ololygon subset contains 29 source-labelled workbook rows linked to 29 distinct accepted species pages. At the row level, 0 are coded direct-developing, 0 terrestrial-ovipositing, and juvenile habitat flags mark 29 aquatic, 0 terrestrial and 0 semiterrestrial entries. These are counts of source rows, not distinct accepted species prevalence or a complete genus census. Historical names sharing a destination retain separate trait statements. Terrestrial eggs do not automatically imply direct development; juvenile habitat is distinct from adult preference. The pages preserve multiple egg-site flags and original upstream reference indices without claiming independent observation of every trait.
所保留 Ololygon 子集包含 29 个来源名称工作簿行，链接 29 个不同接受种页面。按行计，0 个编码直接发育、0 个陆生产卵，幼体生境标记水生 29、陆生 0、半陆生 0 个条目。这是来源行计数，不是不同接受种比例或全属普查。共享目的地的历史名称保留分开性状陈述。陆生卵不自动意味直接发育，幼体生境区别于成体偏好。页面保留多个卵位点标记及原上游参考索引，不声称每个性状均独立观察。
methods
Inference flags and community associations have limited scope
推断标记及群落关联具有有限范围

In this source-row subset, 2 head-width entries and 2 tibia-length entries are explicitly inferred. Unflagged lengths are not independently certified measurements. Mixed means/maxima, missing explicit header units and inconsistent sex/stage labels prevent a uniform diagnostic size series. The full article models 766 communities and reports 36% explained variation in direct-development proportions; functional diversity is a proxy and the fitted associations do not establish competition, predation or physiological thresholds for each linked species. Across the full workbook, 463 rows now have retained reader destinations and one unresolved source spelling remains outside the routes; those 463 rows represent 457 distinct accepted destinations, not a revised biological census.

此来源行子集中，2 个头宽条目、2 个胫长条目明确为推断值。无标记长度不是独立认证测量。混合均值/最大值、表头无明确单位、性别/阶段标签不一致，阻止一致诊断体型系列。全文对 766 个群落建模，报告直接发育比例变异解释 36%；功能多样性为代理，拟合关联未确立每个链接种的竞争、捕食或生理阈值。全工作簿目前 463 行有保留阅读目的地，一个未解决来源拼写仍在路径外；463 行代表 457 个不同接受名目的地，不是修订生物学普查。
taxonomy
Historical combinations follow recorded catalogue links
历史组合跟随所记目录链接

29 historical-name rows in this selected subset reach their species pages through explicit exact-name usage-to-accepted links in frozen COL26.8 dataset 316115. Original workbook names and separate trait statements remain on those pages. The nomenclatural relation does not prove that the original authors examined correctly identified specimens or used an identical biological species concept. Neither a shared accepted destination nor a genus transfer justifies averaging source traits or extending them to every current member. The archived catalogue receipts provide each usage ID and accepted destination.
