sections: occurrence
Regional inventory routes separate field records from literature
区域名册路径区分野外记录与文献

The selected Bufo routes contain 3 source entries from the 2025 Tangjiahe inventory in northern Sichuan. The full list combines twenty species found during field surveys with five from literature, so its twenty-five rows are not twenty-five new field detections. Thirty-nine adult-search transects on rain-free nights during May–August 2024 do not represent year-round sampling or all genus members. The paper explicitly identifies historical Megophrys omeimontis and Oreolalax nanjiangensis as undetected in the current field survey; the species readers preserve those distinctions. Supplementary per-row evidence and vouchers have not been independently reconstructed.

所选 Bufo 路径含四川北部 2025 年唐家河名册 3 个来源条目。完整列表结合二十个野外调查种与五个文献种，二十五行不是二十五个新野外检测。2024 年五月至八月无雨夜的三十九条成年体搜索样线不代表全年取样或全属成员。论文明确将历史 Megophrys omeimontis 与 Oreolalax nanjiangensis 标为本次野外未检测；物种读本保留这些区别。逐行补充证据及凭证未独立重建。
ecology
Habitat ticks describe local assignments rather than universal preferences
生境勾号描述地方分配而非普遍偏好

Table 1 distinguishes arboreal, soil-cave, farmland, highland, turbulent-water, running-water and quiet-water assignments. Multiple ticks are retained on species pages rather than collapsed into one ecological type. Empty cells do not establish intolerance, and these broad labels do not quantify flow, oxygen, breeding stage or habitat quality. The region’s reserve, sampling and statistical elevation scopes differ; exact species endpoints from the figure have not been digitized. Records above 2,300 m are specifically reported for Scutiger pingwuensis and Batrachuperus tibetanus, not a physiological upper limit for every genus member.
表一区分树栖、土洞、农田、高地、湍流、流水、静水分配。逐种页面保留多个勾号，不压成一种生态类型。空格不确立不耐受，广义标签未量化流速、氧、繁殖阶段或生境质量。区域保护区、取样及统计海拔范围不同，图中精确逐种端点未数字化。二千三百米以上专门报告 Scutiger pingwuensis 与 Batrachuperus tibetanus，不是每个属成员的生理上限。
methods
Observed richness does not independently demonstrate conservation causality
观察丰富度不独立证明保护因果

Reported historical species-count increase has p 0.148 and linear elevation association p 0.412, while site diversity/evenness/dominance differences are nonsignificant. These results do not establish identical populations or prove that management caused recovery. Discussion and Conclusions nevertheless use stronger fragmentation, improved-biodiversity and large-population language; those claims require comparable historical effort, abundance records and a causal design beyond the displayed tests. Historical red-list/protection statements are dated source claims, and malformed CITES wording is not expanded into a guessed appendix. Recommendations for habitat restoration and disease monitoring are not completed conservation outcomes.
所报历史种数增加 p 0.148、线性海拔关联 p 0.412，地点多样性/均匀度/优势度差异不显著。结果不确立相同种群，亦不证明管理导致恢复。讨论、结论仍使用更强破碎化、改善多样性及大种群措辞；这些须可比历史努力、丰度记录及展示检验之外因果设计。历史红名录/保护陈述是有日期来源主张，不完整 CITES 措辞不扩写为猜测附录。生境恢复及疾病监测建议不是已完成保护结果。

区域名册路径区分野外记录与文献

The selected Microhyla routes contain 1 source entries from the 2025 Tangjiahe inventory in northern Sichuan. The full list combines twenty species found during field surveys with five from literature, so its twenty-five rows are not twenty-five new field detections. Thirty-nine adult-search transects on rain-free nights during May–August 2024 do not represent year-round sampling or all genus members. The paper explicitly identifies historical Megophrys omeimontis and Oreolalax nanjiangensis as undetected in the current field survey; the species readers preserve those distinctions. Supplementary per-row evidence and vouchers have not been independently reconstructed.

所选 Microhyla 路径含四川北部 2025 年唐家河名册 1 个来源条目。完整列表结合二十个野外调查种与五个文献种，二十五行不是二十五个新野外检测。2024 年五月至八月无雨夜的三十九条成年体搜索样线不代表全年取样或全属成员。论文明确将历史 Megophrys omeimontis 与 Oreolalax nanjiangensis 标为本次野外未检测；物种读本保留这些区别。逐行补充证据及凭证未独立重建。
ecology
Habitat ticks describe local assignments rather than universal preferences
生境勾号描述地方分配而非普遍偏好

Table 1 distinguishes arboreal, soil-cave, farmland, highland, turbulent-water, running-water and quiet-water assignments. Multiple ticks are retained on species pages rather than collapsed into one ecological type. Empty cells do not establish intolerance, and these broad labels do not quantify flow, oxygen, breeding stage or habitat quality. The region’s reserve, sampling and statistical elevation scopes differ; exact species endpoints from the figure have not been digitized. Records above 2,300 m are specifically reported for Scutiger pingwuensis and Batrachuperus tibetanus, not a physiological upper limit for every genus member.
表一区分树栖、土洞、农田、高地、湍流、流水、静水分配。逐种页面保留多个勾号，不压成一种生态类型。空格不确立不耐受，广义标签未量化流速、氧、繁殖阶段或生境质量。区域保护区、取样及统计海拔范围不同，图中精确逐种端点未数字化。二千三百米以上专门报告 Scutiger pingwuensis 与 Batrachuperus tibetanus，不是每个属成员的生理上限。
methods
Observed richness does not independently demonstrate conservation causality
观察丰富度不独立证明保护因果

Reported historical species-count increase has p 0.148 and linear elevation association p 0.412, while site diversity/evenness/dominance differences are nonsignificant. These results do not establish identical populations or prove that management caused recovery. Discussion and Conclusions nevertheless use stronger fragmentation, improved-biodiversity and large-population language; those claims require comparable historical effort, abundance records and a causal design beyond the displayed tests. Historical red-list/protection statements are dated source claims, and malformed CITES wording is not expanded into a guessed appendix. Recommendations for habitat restoration and disease monitoring are not completed conservation outcomes.
所报历史种数增加 p 0.148、线性海拔关联 p 0.412，地点多样性/均匀度/优势度差异不显著。结果不确立相同种群，亦不证明管理导致恢复。讨论、结论仍使用更强破碎化、改善多样性及大种群措辞；这些须可比历史努力、丰度记录及展示检验之外因果设计。历史红名录/保护陈述是有日期来源主张，不完整 CITES 措辞不扩写为猜测附录。生境恢复及疾病监测建议不是已完成保护结果。

生境勾号描述地方分配而非普遍偏好

Table 1 distinguishes arboreal, soil-cave, farmland, highland, turbulent-water, running-water and quiet-water assignments. Multiple ticks are retained on species pages rather than collapsed into one ecological type. Empty cells do not establish intolerance, and these broad labels do not quantify flow, oxygen, breeding stage or habitat quality. The region’s reserve, sampling and statistical elevation scopes differ; exact species endpoints from the figure have not been digitized. Records above 2,300 m are specifically reported for Scutiger pingwuensis and Batrachuperus tibetanus, not a physiological upper limit for every genus member.
表一区分树栖、土洞、农田、高地、湍流、流水、静水分配。逐种页面保留多个勾号，不压成一种生态类型。空格不确立不耐受，广义标签未量化流速、氧、繁殖阶段或生境质量。区域保护区、取样及统计海拔范围不同，图中精确逐种端点未数字化。二千三百米以上专门报告 Scutiger pingwuensis 与 Batrachuperus tibetanus，不是每个属成员的生理上限。
methods
Observed richness does not independently demonstrate conservation causality
观察丰富度不独立证明保护因果

Reported historical species-count increase has p 0.148 and linear elevation association p 0.412, while site diversity/evenness/dominance differences are nonsignificant. These results do not establish identical populations or prove that management caused recovery. Discussion and Conclusions nevertheless use stronger fragmentation, improved-biodiversity and large-population language; those claims require comparable historical effort, abundance records and a causal design beyond the displayed tests. Historical red-list/protection statements are dated source claims, and malformed CITES wording is not expanded into a guessed appendix. Recommendations for habitat restoration and disease monitoring are not completed conservation outcomes.
所报历史种数增加 p 0.148、线性海拔关联 p 0.412，地点多样性/均匀度/优势度差异不显著。结果不确立相同种群，亦不证明管理导致恢复。讨论、结论仍使用更强破碎化、改善多样性及大种群措辞；这些须可比历史努力、丰度记录及展示检验之外因果设计。历史红名录/保护陈述是有日期来源主张，不完整 CITES 措辞不扩写为猜测附录。生境恢复及疾病监测建议不是已完成保护结果。

The selected Allobates subset contains 2 nominal species rows and 17 cumulative records from the Fátima parish study in Pastaza, Ecuador, published in 2026 from September 2013–September 2018 monitoring. These are source-attributed records, not a current provincial census, independently certified distinct animals or per-area densities. Day/night visual and photographic encounters, quadrats, transects and pitfall traps span six local habitats. The 900–1,100 m site gradient does not establish each species’ complete elevation range, and later weather summaries do not establish physiological tolerance.
所选 Allobates 子集包含厄瓜多尔 Pastaza 的 Fátima 教区研究 2 个名义物种行及 17 个累计记录；2026 年发表，来自 2013 年九月至 2018 年九月监测。这是来源归属记录，不是当前全省普查、独立认证不同动物或每面积密度。昼夜目视/照片遇见、样方、样线、陷阱跨六类地方生境。九百至一千一百米地点梯度不确立每种完整海拔范围，较晚天气摘要不确立生理耐受。
ecology
Printed risk assignments and rank statements are distinct evidence
印出风险分配及排名陈述是不同证据

Species readers retain the individual status-column assignments and specific habitat rank statements where the Results provide them. These dated source categories are not newly verified current IUCN assessments or quantitative local extinction probabilities. Dominance in a forest or infrastructure sample does not prove universal habitat preference, a causal benefit of disturbance or population recovery. General threatened-genus wording for Atelopus and Hyloscirtus does not overwrite the LC entries for spumarius and phyllognathus in Table 2. No disease prevalence, breeding experiment or tested thermal mechanism was established by this inventory.
物种读本在结果有提供时保留个别状态列分配及具体生境排名。这些有日期来源类别不是新核实当前 IUCN 评估或定量地方灭绝概率。森林或设施样本中占优势不证明普遍生境偏好、扰动因果收益或种群恢复。Atelopus 与 Hyloscirtus 泛受威胁属措辞不覆盖表二 spumarius、phyllognathus 的 LC 条目。名册未确立疾病流行率、繁殖实验或已检验热机制。
methods
Coverage and inconsistent totals require bounded interpretation
覆盖及不一致总数要求有限解释

Global coverage 97.4% describes the sampled assemblage rather than the proportion of all provincial species found. High habitat coverage does not eliminate undetected rare species. The Methods’ next-record wording, per-habitat effort totals and Simpson-index interpretation remain unreconciled. Results enumerate seventy-five mixed taxon rows, while Discussion says eighty-five species; the printed conservation footer does not sum to the 614 total records. Those disagreements are retained without a guessed correction. Year-five diversity changes and Jaccard turnover are community observations, not causal climate responses or trends of every linked species.
总体覆盖 97.4% 描述所采群落，不是发现全省所有物种的比例。高生境覆盖不能消除未检测稀有种。方法下一记录措辞、逐生境努力总数及 Simpson 指数解释仍未解决。结果枚举七十五个混合类群行，讨论称八十五种；印出保育表尾不合计为 614 个总记录。保留差异，不猜测修正。第五年多样性变化与 Jaccard 更替是群落观察，不是因果气候响应或每个链接种趋势。

覆盖及不一致总数要求有限解释

Global coverage 97.4% describes the sampled assemblage rather than the proportion of all provincial species found. High habitat coverage does not eliminate undetected rare species. The Methods’ next-record wording, per-habitat effort totals and Simpson-index interpretation remain unreconciled. Results enumerate seventy-five mixed taxon rows, while Discussion says eighty-five species; the printed conservation footer does not sum to the 614 total records. Those disagreements are retained without a guessed correction. Year-five diversity changes and Jaccard turnover are community observations, not causal climate responses or trends of every linked species.
总体覆盖 97.4% 描述所采群落，不是发现全省所有物种的比例。高生境覆盖不能消除未检测稀有种。方法下一记录措辞、逐生境努力总数及 Simpson 指数解释仍未解决。结果枚举七十五个混合类群行，讨论称八十五种；印出保育表尾不合计为 614 个总记录。保留差异，不猜测修正。第五年多样性变化与 Jaccard 更替是群落观察，不是因果气候响应或每个链接种趋势。

sections: morphology
Paired developmental stages retain distinct source material
配对发育阶段保留不同来源材料

The selected Alsodes subset contains 14 species rows. 2 larval rows include study photographs, with the remaining rows based on literature images. Adults mix listed-material images, measurements from published figures and literature values; 1 rows record females and 1 leave sex unspecified. Those counts describe retained source rows rather than a population sex ratio. Thirty-two larval landmarks and ten adult linear measurements use different methods; stage pairing is by species, not by following the same individual through metamorphosis. Fixation correction and PCA-based adult imputation remain explicit, without claiming every cell as an observed measurement.
所选 Alsodes 子集含 14 个物种行。2 个幼体行包含研究照片，其余基于文献图像。成体混合所列材料图像、发表图测量及文献值；1 行记雌性、1 行性别未指定。计数描述保留来源行，不是种群性比。三十二幼体地标与十个成体线性测量采用不同方法；阶段按物种配对，不是追踪同一个体变态。明确固定纠正及成体 PCA 补缺，不声称每个单元格均观察测量。
ecology
Larval guild counts are separate from adult ecomorph counts
幼体功能群计数分开于成体生态型计数

For this selected subset, larval source codes count LE 4, LO 10, END 0 and ST 0; adult codes count SAX 0, SEMAQ 4, TER 7 and TOR 3. These mean lentic, lotic, endotrophic and semiterrestrial larvae, versus saxicolous, semi-aquatic, terrestrial and torrential adults. Counts describe only the retained rows, not complete genus ecology. Endotrophic tadpoles are distinct from direct development. Coarse water/land categories do not quantify flow tolerance, diet, breeding success or every life stage’s habitat.
此所选子集幼体来源码计 LE 4、LO 10、END 0、ST 0；成体码计 SAX 0、SEMAQ 4、TER 7、TOR 3。对应静水、流水、内营养、半陆生幼体，与岩栖、半水生、陆生、急流相关成体。计数仅描述保留行，不是完整全属生态。内营养蝌蚪区别于直接发育。广义水/陆类别未量化流速耐受、食性、繁殖成功或每阶段生境。
evolution
Shape decoupling is a bounded comparative hypothesis
形状解耦是有限比较假说

The whole sample shows weak but significant larval–adult shape association (Mantel r 0.16, p 0.003), with family-specific disparity patterns. This supports the authors’ adaptive-decoupling interpretation without demonstrating complete genetic independence or a causal developmental mechanism. Phylogenetic comparisons retain only 74 of 83 sampled species; PC1 ancestral reconstructions and geological dates are model estimates rather than newly observed fossils. Lower adult K still has reported p 0.001, and family sample-size/statistic inconsistencies remain unresolved. Size and convergence effects cannot be assigned as universal diagnostic properties of each linked species.
全样本幼体—成体形状关联弱但显著（Mantel r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度模式随科不同。这支持作者适应性解耦解释，不证明完全遗传独立或因果发育机制。系统发育比较只保留八十三取样种中七十四种，PC1 祖先重建及地质日期是模型估计，不是新观察化石。较低成体 K 仍有所报 p 0.001，科级样本数/统计不一致仍未解决。体型及趋同效应不能分配为每个链接种的普遍诊断属性。
morphology
A genus comparison within the sampled morphospace
所采形态空间内的属比较

Larval Results compare Alsodes with Eupsophus, whose selected tadpoles tend to have longer tails in the body/tail dimension. This is a relative pattern in the sampled morphospace, not a universal diagnostic tail ratio or a newly measured speed/feeding advantage. Lentic and lotic source assignments coexist among the selected Alsodes rows, and adult categories also vary. Neither a coarse stream category nor the family-level size effect demonstrates identical life histories across the genus.
幼体结果将 Alsodes 与 Eupsophus 比较，后者所选蝌蚪在身体/尾维度趋向较长尾。这是所采形态空间相对模式，不是普遍诊断尾比或新测速度/摄食优势。所选 Alsodes 行同时有静水、流水来源分配，成体类别亦不同。广义流水类别或科级体型效应均不证明全属相同生活史。

The selected Atelognathus subset contains 3 species rows. 2 larval rows include study photographs, with the remaining rows based on literature images. Those counts describe retained source rows rather than a population sex ratio. Thirty-two larval landmarks and ten adult linear measurements use different methods; stage pairing is by species, not by following the same individual through metamorphosis. Fixation correction and PCA-based adult imputation remain explicit, without claiming every cell as an observed measurement.
所选 Atelognathus 子集含 3 个物种行。2 个幼体行包含研究照片，其余基于文献图像。成体混合所列材料图像、发表图测量及文献值；0 行记雌性、2 行性别未指定。计数描述保留来源行，不是种群性比。三十二幼体地标与十个成体线性测量采用不同方法；阶段按物种配对，不是追踪同一个体变态。明确固定纠正及成体 PCA 补缺，不声称每个单元格均观察测量。
ecology
Larval guild counts are separate from adult ecomorph counts
幼体功能群计数分开于成体生态型计数

For this selected subset, larval source codes count LE 3, LO 0, END 0 and ST 0; adult codes count SAX 0, SEMAQ 1, TER 2 and TOR 0. These mean lentic, lotic, endotrophic and semiterrestrial larvae, versus saxicolous, semi-aquatic, terrestrial and torrential adults. Counts describe only the retained rows, not complete genus ecology. Endotrophic tadpoles are distinct from direct development. Coarse water/land categories do not quantify flow tolerance, diet, breeding success or every life stage’s habitat.
此所选子集幼体来源码计 LE 3、LO 0、END 0、ST 0；成体码计 SAX 0、SEMAQ 1、TER 2、TOR 0。对应静水、流水、内营养、半陆生幼体，与岩栖、半水生、陆生、急流相关成体。计数仅描述保留行，不是完整全属生态。内营养蝌蚪区别于直接发育。广义水/陆类别未量化流速耐受、食性、繁殖成功或每阶段生境。
evolution
Shape decoupling is a bounded comparative hypothesis
形状解耦是有限比较假说

The whole sample shows weak but significant larval–adult shape association (Mantel r 0.16, p 0.003), with family-specific disparity patterns. This supports the authors’ adaptive-decoupling interpretation without demonstrating complete genetic independence or a causal developmental mechanism. Phylogenetic comparisons retain only 74 of 83 sampled species; PC1 ancestral reconstructions and geological dates are model estimates rather than newly observed fossils. Lower adult K still has reported p 0.001, and family sample-size/statistic inconsistencies remain unresolved. Size and convergence effects cannot be assigned as universal diagnostic properties of each linked species.
全样本幼体—成体形状关联弱但显著（Mantel r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度模式随科不同。这支持作者适应性解耦解释，不证明完全遗传独立或因果发育机制。系统发育比较只保留八十三取样种中七十四种，PC1 祖先重建及地质日期是模型估计，不是新观察化石。较低成体 K 仍有所报 p 0.001，科级样本数/统计不一致仍未解决。体型及趋同效应不能分配为每个链接种的普遍诊断属性。

Results describe a relatively variable larval body/tail ratio in Cycloramphus compared with Thoropa. The sampled cycloramphid pattern emphasizes depressed bodies and low tail fins, while several retained rows are endotrophic and others semiterrestrial. Family-level flattening with increasing size is a static cross-species association, not a tracked developmental change for every Cycloramphus tadpole or a measured hydrodynamic mechanism.
结果描述 Cycloramphus 幼体身体/尾比相对 Thoropa 更可变。所采 Cycloramphidae 模式强调扁低身体及低尾鳍，保留行中部分内营养、其他半陆生。组合不应压成一种繁殖方式。随体型增大更扁的科级模式是静态跨种关联，不是追踪每个 Cycloramphus 蝌蚪发育变化或测得流体力学机制。

Paired developmental stages retain distinct source material

The selected Eupsophus subset contains 7 species rows. 3 larval rows include study photographs, with the remaining rows based on literature images. Adults mix listed-material images, measurements from published figures and literature values; 1 rows record females and 3 leave sex unspecified. Those counts describe retained source rows rather than a population sex ratio. Thirty-two larval landmarks and ten adult linear measurements use different methods; stage pairing is by species, not by following the same individual through metamorphosis. Fixation correction and PCA-based adult imputation remain explicit, without claiming every cell as an observed measurement.
所选 Eupsophus 子集含 7 个物种行。3 个幼体行包含研究照片，其余基于文献图像。成体混合所列材料图像、发表图测量及文献值；1 行记雌性、3 行性别未指定。计数描述保留来源行，不是种群性比。三十二幼体地标与十个成体线性测量采用不同方法；阶段按物种配对，不是追踪同一个体变态。明确固定纠正及成体 PCA 补缺，不声称每个单元格均观察测量。
ecology
Larval guild counts are separate from adult ecomorph counts
幼体功能群计数分开于成体生态型计数

For this selected subset, larval source codes count LE 0, LO 0, END 7 and ST 0; adult codes count SAX 0, SEMAQ 0, TER 7 and TOR 0. These mean lentic, lotic, endotrophic and semiterrestrial larvae, versus saxicolous, semi-aquatic, terrestrial and torrential adults. Counts describe only the retained rows, not complete genus ecology. Endotrophic tadpoles are distinct from direct development. Coarse water/land categories do not quantify flow tolerance, diet, breeding success or every life stage’s habitat.
此所选子集幼体来源码计 LE 0、LO 0、END 7、ST 0；成体码计 SAX 0、SEMAQ 0、TER 7、TOR 0。对应静水、流水、内营养、半陆生幼体，与岩栖、半水生、陆生、急流相关成体。计数仅描述保留行，不是完整全属生态。内营养蝌蚪区别于直接发育。广义水/陆类别未量化流速耐受、食性、繁殖成功或每阶段生境。
evolution
Shape decoupling is a bounded comparative hypothesis
形状解耦是有限比较假说

The whole sample shows weak but significant larval–adult shape association (Mantel r 0.16, p 0.003), with family-specific disparity patterns. This supports the authors’ adaptive-decoupling interpretation without demonstrating complete genetic independence or a causal developmental mechanism. Phylogenetic comparisons retain only 74 of 83 sampled species; PC1 ancestral reconstructions and geological dates are model estimates rather than newly observed fossils. Lower adult K still has reported p 0.001, and family sample-size/statistic inconsistencies remain unresolved. Size and convergence effects cannot be assigned as universal diagnostic properties of each linked species.
全样本幼体—成体形状关联弱但显著（Mantel r 0.16、p 0.003），差异度模式随科不同。这支持作者适应性解耦解释，不证明完全遗传独立或因果发育机制。系统发育比较只保留八十三取样种中七十四种，PC1 祖先重建及地质日期是模型估计，不是新观察化石。较低成体 K 仍有所报 p 0.001，科级样本数/统计不一致仍未解决。体型及趋同效应不能分配为每个链接种的普遍诊断属性。
morphology
A genus comparison within the sampled morphospace
所采形态空间内的属比较

The selected Eupsophus larvae are coded endotrophic and are scattered among mainly lotic hylodid larvae in the shape space. Their resemblance in body/tail proportions does not establish an identical feeding strategy or habitat. Results compare their relatively long tails with Alsodes; Discussion calls the overlap intriguing rather than experimentally demonstrating its cause. Endotrophic tadpoles remain a larval stage, so this category is not a direct-development diagnosis.
所选 Eupsophus 幼体编内营养，在形态空间散布于主要流水的 Hylodidae 幼体之间。身体/尾比例相似不确立相同摄食策略或生境。结果将其相对长尾与 Alsodes 比较，讨论把重叠视为值得关注，不是实验确立原因。内营养蝌蚪仍是幼体阶段，该类别不是直接发育诊断。

The Discussion includes Megaelosia in a comparison of giant hylodid tadpoles whose shape can resemble smaller relatives. The retained study subset contains goeldii rather than every accepted Megaelosia member. sections: ecology
Field temperature routes preserve locality and measurement type
野外温度路径保留地点及测量类型

The selected Pristimantis routes retain 4 species and 49 reported adult records from nocturnal sampling in Tolima, Colombia, during September–December 2018. Species pages separate each site/elevation and forest/open row, with body, substrate and air temperatures in degrees Celsius as mean ± standard deviation and observed range. Body temperature means dorsal skin at the encounter; nearby air is measured twenty centimetres above the frog. These are observed temperatures, not critical limits, preferred temperatures or a complete physiological niche for the genus. The study does not establish all-season exposure or independently marked unique individuals.
所选 Pristimantis 路径保留哥伦比亚 Tolima 2018 年九月至十二月夜间取样 4 种、49 个所报成年记录。逐种页分开每个地点/海拔及森林/开阔行，体温、基质、空气温度按摄氏度均值 ± 标准差及观察范围列出。体温指遇见时背部皮温，附近空气在蛙上方二十厘米测量。这是观察温度，不是临界限、偏好温度或全属完整生理生态位。研究未确立全年暴露或独立标记不同个体。
methods
Internal-temperature assumptions and canopy definitions remain bounded
内部温度假设及冠盖定义保持有限范围

A nine-animal/four-species repeated skin–cloacal comparison is used to assume that dorsal skin represents internal temperature; nonsignificant differences do not independently certify equivalence in every sampled species and environment. Six hourly ground loggers cover three elevations and two broad canopy categories, but are not positioned at every frog’s substrate. Forest canopy above sixty percent and open canopy up to forty percent exclude intermediate canopy conditions from those definitions. The pooled analyses adjust for body size without a phylogenetic model, so species composition and habitat choice limit claims about evolutionary causation.
研究以四种九个动物重复皮温—泄殖腔比较，假设背皮代表内部温度；差异不显著不独立认证每个取样种、环境等效。六个每小时地面记录仪覆盖三海拔、两广义冠盖类别，不在每只蛙基质处。森林冠盖高于百分之六十、开阔不高于百分之四十，中间冠盖不在这些定义内。汇总分析校正体型但无系统发育模型，物种组成、生境选择限制进化因果主张。
ecology
Associations and unresolved probabilities do not demonstrate tolerance
关联及未解决概率不证明耐受

The source finds stronger pooled body–substrate than body–air associations and proposes conductive heat exchange, but does not measure heat flux, water loss or species-specific temperature choice. Open/forest mean differences are significant at low/middle elevations and nonsignificant at the highest; habitat variance is also nonsignificant. Table 2 prints p < 0.000 and a low-open body–air p > 0.789 despite prose saying significance in all cases; those entries are not silently corrected. Discussion also calls selected same-elevation species temperatures similar although their printed means differ. Forest specialization and lower tolerance are proposed future tests rather than established warming vulnerability or conservation outcomes.
来源恢复更强汇总体温—基质而非体温—空气关联，并提出传导换热，但未测热通量、水分损失或逐种温度选择。开阔/森林均值差异低/中海拔显著、最高处不显著，生境方差亦不显著。表二印 p < 0.000 及低处开阔体温—空气 p > 0.789，正文却称全部显著；不默默修正条目。讨论亦称部分同海拔种温度相似，尽管印出均值不同。森林专化及较低耐受是拟议未来检验，不是已确立变暖脆弱性或保护结果。

sections: taxonomy
A captive family cannot stand for all giant-salamander lineages
单一圈养家系不能代表全部大鲵谱系

The linked study uses forty sixteen-month-old juveniles attributed by their breeder to a single local Andrias davidianus parental pair. A statement of no hybridization history is not independent genetic certification. Other named Andrias species in the Introduction are contextual citations, not experimentally sampled comparison groups. Readers should keep this family-level provenance separate from genus-wide morphology, wild lineage boundaries and conservation assessments.
关联研究使用四十只十六个月龄幼体，繁育者归于一对当地 Andrias davidianus 亲本。无杂交历史陈述不是独立遗传认证。引言其他大鲵属种是背景引用，不是实验取样比较组。读者应把此家系来源与全属形态、野生谱系界限及保护评估分开。
ecology
Light-dependent juvenile color is an observation with a disputed phase label
光依赖幼体颜色是相位标注有争议的观察

Four artificial light schedules produce fitted daily dorsal reflectance changes in captive juveniles. The period was fixed at twenty-four hours; darkness persistence supports an endogenous-component interpretation without independently estimating a free-running period. The initial Results paragraph places the delayed peak in LD8:16, whereas Table 1 and later comparisons place it in LD16:8. The species page retains both statements and the table values. This source does not establish adult, wild or other Andrias species rhythms.
四种人工光周期使圈养幼体背部反射率呈拟合日变化。周期固定二十四小时；暗中持续支持内源成分解释，但未独立估计自由运行周期。结果开头把延迟峰置于 LD8:16，表一及后续比较却置于 LD16:8。物种页保留两种陈述及表值。来源不确立成年、野生或其他大鲵属种节律。
methods
Follow measurements before proposed adaptive functions
先阅读测量，再阅读所提适应功能

The selected route distinguishes measured reflectance from hypotheses about pigment transport, hormones, UV protection, nocturnal energy savings and camouflage. Those mechanisms and benefits were not directly assayed. Abrupt laboratory transitions omit natural twilight and spectrum changes; the authors explicitly cannot distinguish evolutionary adaptation from artificial-light plasticity. Source paragraph and table locators accompany these limits in the species evidence, rather than assigning cited findings to every genus member.
所选路径把测得反射率与色素运输、激素、紫外防护、夜间节能及伪装假说区分。未直接测这些机制及收益。实验瞬时转换省略自然暮光和光谱变化；作者明确无法区分进化适应与人工光可塑性。这些边界在物种证据中附来源段落及表定位，不把引用结果分配给每个属成员。

sections: occurrence
Follow named sampled hosts and dated localities
沿已命名取样宿主及有日期地点阅读

The selected Aquiloeurycea routes are Aquiloeurycea galeanae, Aquiloeurycea scandens. They preserve source-specific Mexican localities from March2017–November2018 and morphological field identifications. The full study found salamanders at sixteen of twenty-six searched localities, including twenty-two searched caves. Those aggregate numbers are not a genus-specific abundance or occupancy estimate. Cave, forest and saxicolous sampling have different search settings, and historical locality nondetection does not prove local extinction. The unnamed Aquiloeurycea sample is not assigned to one of these accepted-name pages.

所选 Aquiloeurycea 路径为 Aquiloeurycea galeanae, Aquiloeurycea scandens，保留 2017 年三月至 2018 年十一月墨西哥来源地点及野外形态鉴定。全研究在二十六搜索地点的十六个遇到蝾螈，搜索地点含二十二洞穴。汇总数不是逐属丰度或占据估计。洞穴、森林及岩栖搜索条件不同，历史地点未检出不证明当地灭绝。未命名 Aquiloeurycea 样本不分配给这些接受名页。
ecology
Detected Bd, bacterial diversity and protection are different evidence
Bd 检出、细菌多样性及保护是不同证据

Species routes retain reported Bd fractions where the text provides them, and leave contradictory denominators unresolved. Diagnostic ITS copies cannot be equated directly to zoospores or a fatal threshold. Lack of visible disease at sampling does not demonstrate resistance or long-term survival. scope.en: Five selected named routes: japonicus fossil-assignment evidence and four modern reference-sequence roles.
scope.zh: 五个所选命名路径：japonicus 遗存分配证据及四种现代参考序列角色。

sections: morphology
Bone morphology narrows the genus but does not resolve every species
骨形态缩窄至属，却不解决每种身份

The Ehime bones have vertebral characters used by the authors for Cryptobranchidae and Andrias assignment. Their fragmentary maxilla/anterior-dentary preservation does not provide the cited characters needed to distinguish japonicus from davidianus sensu lato. The reported roughly40-degree vertebral angle and quoted19–37-degree reference interval also require a retained qualification. A short mitochondrial sequence supports the authors’ japonicus assignment for the analyzed vertebra; that result does not genetically identify every associated element or diagnose all living and fossil genus members.
爱媛骨有作者用于隐鳃鲵科及大鲵属分配的椎骨性状。上颌骨/齿骨前端保存不足，未提供所引区分 japonicus 与广义 davidianus 所需性状。所报约四十度椎骨角及引用十九至三十七度区间亦需保留限定。短线粒体序列支持作者把分析椎骨归 japonicus；不遗传鉴定全部伴生骨元素或诊断全部现生、化石属成员。
geochronology
A single calibrated bone age is a historical occurrence
单一骨校正年代是历史出现

One vertebra provides the reported4,140–3,587 calibrated yearsBP interval. It does not date the entire fissure deposit, the genus origin or a local extinction event. Museum inventory and the Introduction’s earlier element summary have different vertebral counts, and the analyzed OCM number is not supplied in the read Results. Selected species routes keep those limits together with reference-sequence accession roles; Chinese comparison entries are not new fossils of those species.
一椎骨提供所报距今 4,140–3,587 校正年 BP 区间。不定年整个裂隙堆积、属起源或当地灭绝事件。馆藏清单与引言较早元素摘要椎骨数不同，所读结果未给分析 OCM 编号。所选物种路径把这些限制与参考序列登录角色一并保留；中国比较项不是这些种的新化石。
methods
Authentication and causal history have separate evidence requirements
真实性与因果历史具有不同证据要求

The source reports a dedicated ancient-DNA laboratory, extraction/PCR negative controls and two consistent independent amplifications of a93 bp cytb fragment. These safeguards support the reported assay but are not independently reproduced genomic authentication. Human consumption, ritual use and human-caused local extirpation remain suggestions without cut marks or direct causal evidence. The linked japonicus page distinguishes measured age/sequence and preserved bone characters from these interpretations; no licensed image, translated article prose or invented PBDB concept is inserted.
来源报告专用古 DNA 实验室、提取/PCR 阴性对照及两次一致独立扩增九十三 bp cytb 片段。防护支持所報测定，但非独立复现基因组真实性验证。人类取食、仪式及人致当地消失仍是无切痕或直接因果证据的建议。关联 japonicus 页区分测得年代/序列、保留骨性状与解释；未插入许可图片、翻译原文或虚构 PBDB 概念。

scope.zh: 混合十四种爬行及两栖报告中所选 1 个两栖记述。

sections: occurrence
New locality knowledge is not demonstrated range expansion
新增地点知识不是实证范围扩张

The selected Agalychnis routes (Agalychnis spurrelli) retain individual encounters, vouchers and elevations from western Ecuador. The source’s provincial additions and distances between known records describe changes in documented knowledge, not observed colonization, continuous occupancy or a measured dispersal rate. Non-systematic searches do not establish absence at unvisited sites. Historical cited elevation ranges are distinct from lower or higher new records, and precise encounter elevations must not be substituted with camp elevations.
所选 Agalychnis 路径（Agalychnis spurrelli）保留厄瓜多尔西部个体遇见、凭证与海拔。来源新增省记录及已知记录间距描述知识变化，不是观察定殖、连续占据或测得扩散率。非系统搜索不确立未访点缺失。历史引用海拔范围与更低/更高新记录分开，精确遇见海拔不能换成营地海拔。
methods
Read individual observations before general ecological claims
先读个体观察，再读一般生态主张

The linked pages separate males, females, juveniles and sex-undetermined animals rather than using every length as an adult range. Perching near streams or puddles is not proof of egg placement, larval habitat or quantified habitat preference. Amplexus and vocalization remain particular reported events, without inferred recruitment or acoustic parameters. Methods’2014–2023 window differs from a2008 and a2024 account record; printed two-decimal lengths are not certified finer precision than the stated0.1 mm method. Cited identification descriptions and dated threat categories are not independently refreshed specimen diagnoses or risk assessments.

sections: occurrence
New locality knowledge is not demonstrated range expansion
新增地点知识不是实证范围扩张

The selected Engystomops routes (Engystomops montubio) retain individual encounters, vouchers and elevations from western Ecuador. The source’s provincial additions and distances between known records describe changes in documented knowledge, not observed colonization, continuous occupancy or a measured dispersal rate. Non-systematic searches do not establish absence at unvisited sites. Historical cited elevation ranges are distinct from lower or higher new records, and precise encounter elevations must not be substituted with camp elevations.

methods
Read individual observations before general ecological claims
先读个体观察，再读一般生态主张

The linked pages separate males, females, juveniles and sex-undetermined animals rather than using every length as an adult range. Perching near streams or puddles is not proof of egg placement, larval habitat or quantified habitat preference. Amplexus and vocalization remain particular reported events, without inferred recruitment or acoustic parameters. Methods’2014–2023 window differs from a2008 and a2024 account record; printed two-decimal lengths are not certified finer precision than the stated0.1 mm method. Cited identification descriptions and dated threat categories are not independently refreshed specimen diagnoses or risk assessments.

methods
Assay and sampling differences constrain comparison
检测与取样差异限制比较

This Rheobates subset contains 4 GC-MS animals and 0 UHPLC-HESI-MS/MS animals. GC-MS uses full skins from the2014 collection series and relative integrated signals; LC-MS uses separately processed dorsal/ventral skins from the2022 Panama or2024 Texas series and reports qualitative detection rather than alkaloid quantities. The methods differ in sensitivity, retention-time resolution and structural annotation, so their compound counts and signal outputs are not directly comparable. Most alkaloids lack standards for absolute measurement; GC-MS profiles were not mass-corrected and some co-eluting compounds could not be separated. Table1 reports individual ranges and medians, while text also gives pooled species totals; neither can be substituted for the other. Supplementary individual records and raw chromatograms have not been independently inspected here.

此 Rheobates 子集含 4 个 GC-MS 动物与 0 个 UHPLC-HESI-MS/MS 动物。GC-MS 用2014年采集系列全皮和相对积分信号；LC-MS 用2022年巴拿马或2024年得克萨斯系列分别处理的背腹皮肤，报告定性检出而非生物碱数量。方法的灵敏度、保留时间分辨率和结构注释不同，化合物计数及信号不能直接比较。多数生物碱缺绝对测量标准品；GC-MS 化学谱未按质量校正，部分共洗脱化合物不能分开。表一列个体范围与中位数，正文还给物种合并总数，两者不能互换。此处未独立检查逐个体补充记录和原始色谱。
evolution
Chemical detection does not establish a sequestration mechanism
化学检出不确立专门富集机制

The authors propose that dietary toxin exposure, resistance and delayed elimination may precede specialised transport/storage mechanisms of chemical sequestration. The sampled Rheobates records help compare chemical occurrence but do not measure elimination rates, trace each molecule to prey or reconstruct ancestral transport pathways. A skin detection alone cannot distinguish temporary passive retention from derived sequestration, and a non-detection cannot exclude every defence chemical. The proposed ancestral state and sequence remain hypotheses requiring tissue/time-series experiments and wider lineage sampling; they are not certified biological properties of every species in this genus.
作者提出食物毒素暴露、抗性及延迟清除可先于化学专门富集的特化运输/储存机制。被采 Rheobates 记录可帮助比较化学出现，但未测清除速度、逐分子追溯猎物来源或重建祖先运输通路。皮肤检出本身不能区分暂时被动保留与衍生富集；未检出不能排除所有防御化学物。所提祖先状态及顺序仍是需组织/时间序列实验和更广谱系取样的假说，不是全属每个种已认证的生物学性质。

methods
Compilation scope and uneven evidence
汇编范围与不均衡证据

The authors surveyed published regional literature from 1819–2025 across seven databases and monographs, excluding incomplete records, unpublished theses and meeting material, and parasites not identified to species. Database-specific query strings and search dates are not given in the inspected methods. Overall host totals and some account summaries disagree internally; no corrected host census is inferred here. Life-cycle studies cited in the discussion concern O. filiformis and O. pipiens, and cannot establish the infection route of each regional molineid. Habitat, host size, skin exposure and cospeciation are discussed as possible explanations alongside uneven collection and study effort, rather than demonstrated mechanisms for these genus members. Supplementary Table S1, original vouchers, cited papers and deposited sequences have not been independently reviewed here.

methods
Compilation scope and uneven evidence
汇编范围与不均衡证据

The authors surveyed published regional literature from 1819–2025 across seven databases and monographs, excluding incomplete records, unpublished theses and meeting material, and parasites not identified to species. Database-specific query strings and search dates are not given in the inspected methods. Overall host totals and some account summaries disagree internally; no corrected host census is inferred here. Life-cycle studies cited in the discussion concern O. filiformis and O. pipiens, and cannot establish the infection route of each regional molineid. Habitat, host size, skin exposure and cospeciation are discussed as possible explanations alongside uneven collection and study effort, rather than demonstrated mechanisms for these genus members. Supplementary Table S1, original vouchers, cited papers and deposited sequences have not been independently reviewed here.

sections: ecology
Selected host associations in a regional molineid checklist
区域毛圆线虫清单中的选定宿主关联

The 2025 bibliographic review provides named host entries linked here for Proceratophrys appendiculata. Across the selected names other than expressly broad complexes, it lists Schulzia travassosi. The regional literature covers Caribbean, Panamanian and Neotropical areas, with host-specific reported places retained in the linked species accounts. These entries were not animals newly sampled together and do not establish genus-wide prevalence, pathogenicity, host specificity, ancestral ecology or comparative susceptibility. Missing host records do not establish parasite absence.

2025 年文献综述提供了这里链接的宿主名称条目：Proceratophrys appendiculata。明确的广义复合群以外，这些选定名称关联的寄生虫包括 Schulzia travassosi。区域文献涉及加勒比、巴拿马和新热带地区，链接的物种条目逐一保留宿主各自的报告地点。这些动物未共同新采样，条目不能确立全属感染率、致病性、宿主专一性、祖先生态或比较易感性。缺少宿主记录不能证明没有寄生虫。

methods
Compilation scope and uneven evidence
汇编范围与不均衡证据

The authors surveyed published regional literature from 1819–2025 across seven databases and monographs, excluding incomplete records, unpublished theses and meeting material, and parasites not identified to species. Database-specific query strings and search dates are not given in the inspected methods. Overall host totals and some account summaries disagree internally; no corrected host census is inferred here. Life-cycle studies cited in the discussion concern O. filiformis and O. pipiens, and cannot establish the infection route of each regional molineid. Habitat, host size, skin exposure and cospeciation are discussed as possible explanations alongside uneven collection and study effort, rather than demonstrated mechanisms for these genus members. Supplementary Table S1, original vouchers, cited papers and deposited sequences have not been independently reviewed here.

作者从七个数据库及专著调查 1819–2025 年已发表的区域文献，排除不完整记录、未发表论文和会议材料，以及未鉴定到种的寄生虫。已核读的方法未给出各数据库检索式和检索日期。宿主总体数量与部分条目小结在来源内部不一致，这里不推造更正后的宿主普查。讨论引用的生活史研究针对 O. filiformis 和 O. pipiens，不能确立每种区域毛圆线虫的感染途径。生境、宿主体型、皮肤暴露及共同分化被作为可能解释讨论，同时考虑采集和研究投入不均；并非这些属成员已证明的机制。这里未独立核读补充表 S1、原始凭证、被引论文或提交的序列。

scope.en: Selected Allobates hand-gland evidence; not full genus sampling or experimentally established function
scope.zh: 选定 Allobates 手部腺体证据；非全属取样或实验确立的功能

sections: morphology
Hand-gland observations in selected members
选定成员的手部腺体观察

The histological study links these selected Allobates names: Allobates insperatus, Allobates femoralis, Allobates talamancae, Allobates tapajos, Allobates trilineatus. It examined preserved material rather than newly collecting these frogs. The Table2 adult-male scores linked here, in order of specialized mucous gland types I, II, III and IV, are Allobates insperatus: I–IV 1/0/0/0; Allobates femoralis: I–IV 0/0/0/0; Allobates talamancae: I–IV 1/0/0/0; Allobates tapajos: I–IV 1/0/0/0; Allobates trilineatus: I–IV 1/0/0/0. A 1 records presence and a 0 a scored absence in the evidence used; these are not population frequencies or a statement that ordinary skin glands are absent.  The selected entries do not establish a universal genus phenotype.

组织学研究链接这些选定 Allobates 名称：Allobates insperatus、Allobates femoralis、Allobates talamancae、Allobates tapajos、Allobates trilineatus。研究检查保存材料，没有新采集这些蛙。这里链接的表 2 成体雄性评分依特化黏液腺 I、II、III、IV 型顺序为：Allobates insperatus: I–IV 1/0/0/0；Allobates femoralis: I–IV 0/0/0/0；Allobates talamancae: I–IV 1/0/0/0；Allobates tapajos: I–IV 1/0/0/0；Allobates trilineatus: I–IV 1/0/0/0。1 表示所用证据中存在，0 表示缺失评分，不是种群频率，也不表示普通皮肤腺体不存在。选定条目不能确立全属统一表型。
methods
Sampling, nomenclature and missing specimen detail
取样、名称与缺失的标本细节

The study describes 77 dendrobatoid specimens representing 36 source labels, four hylodid specimens and two literature-derived Melanophryniscus outgroups. Figures were reviewed only as captions; Appendix S1 and Tables S1–S2 were not retrieved, so per-species specimen counts, sex/maturity composition and localities remain unconfirmed here. Unassigned source labels for this genus include Allobates sp. Caxiuanã, Allobates olfersioides. Source Allobates sp. Caxiuanã has all-zero Table2 scores despite swelling/type-I statements elsewhere; that unresolved label is not allocated to accepted species. Current links follow exact frozen names or the explicitly documented olfersioides nomenclatural bridge, without independent specimen identity authentication. Finger numbering II–V follows a tetrapod homology convention.

研究描述了代表 36 个来源标签的 77 个箭毒蛙总科标本、四个溪蟾科标本及两个文献导入的 Melanophryniscus 外群。图只核读图注；附录 S1 和表 S1–S2 未取得，因此这里未确认逐种标本数、性别及成熟度构成和地点。此属未分配来源标签包括 Allobates sp. Caxiuanã、Allobates olfersioides。Allobates sp. Caxiuanã 在表 2 全为零，而其他段落描述膨胀及 I 型腺体；这一未解决标签不分配给接受种。当前链接依据冻结精确名称或明确记录的 olfersioides 命名链接，没有独立认证标本身份。II–V 指序遵循四足动物同源惯例。
ecology
Reproductive function and ancestry remain hypotheses
繁殖功能与祖先状态仍属假说

Protein-reactive hand glands motivated hypotheses about chemical courtship signals, but the study did not identify a pheromone, characterize secretion composition, test female responses or demonstrate olfactory versus transdermal delivery. It did not establish an adhesive function or a causal effect on ovulation or oviposition in these genus members. Inferences of origins and losses use a fixed, pruned earlier tree and a limited ingroup sample; alternative optimizations remain possible. Type II–IV similarities also leave questions about developmental relationships and gland homology open. These interpretations should not be converted into experimentally verified genus-wide biology.
含蛋白反应物的手部腺体促使作者提出化学求偶信号假说，但研究没有鉴定信息素、表征分泌组成、测试雌性反应，或证明嗅觉与经皮传递途径。它没有确立这些属成员的黏附功能或对排卵、产卵的因果效应。起源与丢失推断依赖先前固定并裁剪的树及有限内群样本，替代优化仍可能成立。II–IV 型相似性也留下发育关系与腺体同源问题。这些解释不能改写为实验验证的全属生物学结论。

methods
Sampling, nomenclature and missing specimen detail
取样、名称与缺失的标本细节

The study describes 77 dendrobatoid specimens representing 36 source labels, four hylodid specimens and two literature-derived Melanophryniscus outgroups. Figures were reviewed only as captions; Appendix S1 and Tables S1–S2 were not retrieved, so per-species specimen counts, sex/maturity composition and localities remain unconfirmed here. ecology
Reproductive function and ancestry remain hypotheses
繁殖功能与祖先状态仍属假说

Protein-reactive hand glands motivated hypotheses about chemical courtship signals, but the study did not identify a pheromone, characterize secretion composition, test female responses or demonstrate olfactory versus transdermal delivery. It did not establish an adhesive function or a causal effect on ovulation or oviposition in these genus members. Inferences of origins and losses use a fixed, pruned earlier tree and a limited ingroup sample; alternative optimizations remain possible. Type II–IV similarities also leave questions about developmental relationships and gland homology open. These interpretations should not be converted into experimentally verified genus-wide biology.

methods

The linked pages retain Table1 localities, dates, male counts, archived FNJV identifiers and recording equipment, as well as separate call/note denominators for each metric. sections: evolution
Selected reference assemblies and their scope
选定参考组装及其范围

The comparative anuran genome study lists the following assemblies for the selected Discoglossus pages: Discoglossus pictus: GCA_033576555.1, 3.87 Gbp, contigN50 3,043.6 Kbp. These are assembly-bounded values from the study's NCBI snapshot of29October2024, not direct cellular DNA measurements or an invariant genome size throughout the genus. Exact current names and explicit frozen nomenclatural links select the pages; original specimens and genome identities have not been independently authenticated here.

无尾目比较基因组研究为所选 Discoglossus 页面列出：Discoglossus pictus: GCA_033576555.1, 3.87 Gbp, contigN50 3,043.6 Kbp。这些值受具体组装及研究在2024年10月29日的 NCBI 快照范围限制，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量或全属不变的基因组大小。页面选择依据当前精确名称与明确冻结命名链接；这里没有独立认证原标本及基因组身份。
methods
Repeat-data identifiers require reconciliation
重复数据编号需要澄清

Main Table1 and supplementary TableS1 have no exact species-name plus accession concordance across the61 rows: all59 exactly matching names carry different accessions, and two other names use different spellings or combinations. Each linked species page preserves its specific conflict. Consequently, supplementary TE counts/proportions and accession-linked clutch/larval records are not assigned here as verified genus-member traits. The comparative anuran genome study lists the following assemblies for the selected Dendrobates pages: Dendrobates tinctorius: GCA_041080635.1, 6.36 Gbp, contigN50 32,538.6 Kbp. These are assembly-bounded values from the study's NCBI snapshot of29October2024, not direct cellular DNA measurements or an invariant genome size throughout the genus. Exact current names and explicit frozen nomenclatural links select the pages; original specimens and genome identities have not been independently authenticated here.

无尾目比较基因组研究为所选 Dendrobates 页面列出：Dendrobates tinctorius: GCA_041080635.1, 6.36 Gbp, contigN50 32,538.6 Kbp。这些值受具体组装及研究在2024年10月29日的 NCBI 快照范围限制，不是细胞 DNA 含量的直接测量或全属不变的基因组大小。页面选择依据当前精确名称与明确冻结命名链接；这里没有独立认证原标本及基因组身份。
methods
Repeat-data identifiers require reconciliation
重复数据编号需要澄清

Main Table1 and supplementary TableS1 have no exact species-name plus accession concordance across the61 rows: all59 exactly matching names carry different accessions, and two other names use different spellings or combinations. Each linked species page preserves its specific conflict. Consequently, supplementary TE counts/proportions and accession-linked clutch/larval records are not assigned here as verified genus-member traits. The five-percentage BUSCO vectors lack component labels in the inspected main table; contigN50 is a continuity statistic, not completeness certification. Sequence-processing pipelines, raw assemblies and repeat libraries have not been independently rerun.
主文表1与补充S1的61行没有“精确物种名＋编号”同时一致的对应：59个精确匹配名称均携不同编号，另两名使用不同拼写或组合。链接的物种页逐一保留具体冲突。因此，这里不把补充 TE 数量、比例及按编号列出的窝卵、幼体记录分配为已核实属成员性状。已核读主表没有给五百分比 BUSCO 向量标分量名称；contigN50 是连续性统计，不是完整性认证。这里没有重跑序列处理流程、原组装和重复库。
evolution
Comparative models and proposed mechanisms
比较模型及提出的机制

The authors compare61 assemblies with phylogenetic models, contigN50 covariates and multiple-testing correction. RepeatMasker hits, occupied length and proportions are distinct metrics, and divergence from a repeat consensus is an age/activity proxy rather than observation of current transposition. Putatively full-length Ty3 ORF similarity does not demonstrate active protein expression. Developmental constraints and TE proliferation are interpretations of across-species associations, not manipulative evidence for each selected genus member.   Source conflicts in TE percentages, ORF totals and GC-association statements remain unresolved.
作者用系统模型、contigN50 协变量及多重检验校正比较61个组装。RepeatMasker 命中、占据长度和比例是不同指标；与重复共识的分歧是年龄或活跃程度代理，不是当前转座观察。暂定全长 Ty3 的 ORF 相似性不能证明蛋白质正在表达。发育限制和 TE 扩增是对跨物种关联的解释，不是每个选定属成员的操纵实验依据。来源中的 TE 比例、ORF 总数及 GC 关联陈述冲突保持未解决。

methods
Repeat-data identifiers require reconciliation
重复数据编号需要澄清

Main Table1 and supplementary TableS1 have no exact species-name plus accession concordance across the61 rows: all59 exactly matching names carry different accessions, and two other names use different spellings or combinations. Each linked species page preserves its specific conflict. Consequently, supplementary TE counts/proportions and accession-linked clutch/larval records are not assigned here as verified genus-member traits. The five-percentage BUSCO vectors lack component labels in the inspected main table; contigN50 is a continuity statistic, not completeness certification. evolution
Comparative models and proposed mechanisms
比较模型及提出的机制

The authors compare61 assemblies with phylogenetic models, contigN50 covariates and multiple-testing correction. RepeatMasker hits, occupied length and proportions are distinct metrics, and divergence from a repeat consensus is an age/activity proxy rather than observation of current transposition. Putatively full-length Ty3 ORF similarity does not demonstrate active protein expression. Developmental constraints and TE proliferation are interpretations of across-species associations, not manipulative evidence for each selected genus member.   Source conflicts in TE percentages, ORF totals and GC-association statements remain unresolved.

Comparative models and proposed mechanisms

The authors compare61 assemblies with phylogenetic models, contigN50 covariates and multiple-testing correction. methods
Collective elicitation and scope of correspondence
集体词汇采集与对应范围

Thirteen native isiZulu-speaking volunteers from five Zululand areas participated in two2016 workshop groups. Photograph-assisted discussions yielded six broad folk categories; later species naming combined those categories, published names and guidelines with assistance from Bongani Mkhize. Additional broad terms in the paper came from earlier publication or borrowing. Folk categories sometimes cross several scientific genera or families, so one name does not necessarily identify one scientific genus or species. These selected Arthroleptis entries do not establish community-wide name frequencies, independent recognition accuracy, current local occupancy, or ancestral genus-level habitat/call traits. The study's linguistic and naming evidence is kept separate from measured biological evidence.

sections: taxonomy
Selected isiZulu names in the regional compilation
地区汇编中的选定 isiZulu 名称

The2019 study assigns these selected Chiromantis entries in its Zululand compilation: Chiromantis xerampelina: Usomagwebu waseningizimu. Each linked page retains whether its name was newly formulated or modified from Tarrant2016. Species-specific phrases were assigned after the workshop, rather than all being elicited as pre-existing individual species names. This is a regional vernacular-name compilation, not a current global naming authority or a biological diagnosis of the genus.
2019 年研究在祖鲁兰汇编中为这些选定 Chiromantis 条目赋名：Chiromantis xerampelina: Usomagwebu waseningizimu。各链接页面保留该名称属于新拟定还是修改自 Tarrant2016。物种级短语是在工作坊后赋予，不是全部以已存在的独立物种名称从参与者处获得。这是地区俗名汇编，不是当前全球命名权威或全属生物学鉴别。
methods
Collective elicitation and scope of correspondence
集体词汇采集与对应范围

Thirteen native isiZulu-speaking volunteers from five Zululand areas participated in two2016 workshop groups. Photograph-assisted discussions yielded six broad folk categories; later species naming combined those categories, published names and guidelines with assistance from Bongani Mkhize. Additional broad terms in the paper came from earlier publication or borrowing. Folk categories sometimes cross several scientific genera or families, so one name does not necessarily identify one scientific genus or species. These selected Chiromantis entries do not establish community-wide name frequencies, independent recognition accuracy, current local occupancy, or ancestral genus-level habitat/call traits. The study's linguistic and naming evidence is kept separate from measured biological evidence.

来自祖鲁兰五个地区的 13 位 isiZulu 母语志愿者参加了2016年的两组工作坊。看图后的集体讨论获得六个宽泛民间类别；后续物种命名在 Bongani Mkhize 协助下结合这些类别、已发表名称及指南完成。文中额外宽泛词汇来自先前出版物或借用。民间类别有时跨越若干科学属或科，一个名称不必对应一个科学属或种。这些选定 Chiromantis 条目不能确立全社区名称频率、独立识别准确率、当前地方占据或祖先全属的栖境/鸣声性状。研究的语言与命名证据和实测生物学证据分别保留。

sections: range
Selected members in the Rwanda detection compilation
卢旺达检出汇编中的选定成员

TableA2 andA3 report these selected Arthroleptis members: Arthroleptis adolfifriederici: 8 sites, EZ1/EZ2; Arthroleptis nyungwensis: 4 sites, EZ1/EZ2; Arthroleptis schubotzi: 3 sites, EZ1/EZ2. Counts are detections across51 repeatedly sampled2010–2023 sites assembled from earlier research, not abundance or present occupancy. Ecozone memberships describe this sampled Rwanda compilation, not complete species ranges or a uniform genus distribution. Qualified cf./sp. entries are kept outside accepted-species assignments; blank cells are not proof of ecological absence.

表A2及A3报告这些选定 Arthroleptis 成员：Arthroleptis adolfifriederici：8站，EZ1/EZ2；Arthroleptis nyungwensis：4站，EZ1/EZ2；Arthroleptis schubotzi：3站，EZ1/EZ2。计数是从先前研究汇总的51个站点在2010–2023年重复采样中的检出，不是丰度或当前占据。生态区成员关系针对这份卢旺达采样汇编，不是完整物种分布或统一全属分布。cf./sp.限定条目不归属到接受种；空白格不证明生态不存在。
ecology
Species scores preserve different conservation inputs
物种评分保留不同保护输入

TableA4 gives Arthroleptis adolfifriederici: DBS2/TBS0/SBS4, SI6; Arthroleptis nyungwensis: DBS2/TBS1/SBS4, SI7; Arthroleptis schubotzi: DBS2/TBS0/SBS1, SI3. DBS reflects represented Rwanda ecozones and national endemism; TBS uses previous national red-list proposals, and SBS is a categorical habitat-disturbance sensitivity input. SI sums those three inputs for a species. It is not a genus score, extinction probability or an experimentally measured tolerance. A site's RABI sums all detected species SI values without dividing by richness. Doubled category weights encode the authors' prioritization choices rather than measured doubling of biological risk. Threat scores are historical study inputs; the combined VU/DD score cannot by itself distinguish Vulnerable from Data Deficient.

表A4给出 Arthroleptis adolfifriederici: DBS2/TBS0/SBS4, SI6; Arthroleptis nyungwensis: DBS2/TBS1/SBS4, SI7; Arthroleptis schubotzi: DBS2/TBS0/SBS1, SI3。DBS反映已记录卢旺达生态区及国家特有性；TBS采用先前国家红色名录建议，SBS是分类的栖境干扰敏感性输入。SI对一个物种累加这三类输入，不是属级评分、灭绝概率或实验测得的耐受度。站点RABI累加全部已检出物种的SI，不除以丰富度。倍增类别权重表达作者优先排序选择，不是测得生物风险翻倍。威胁分值是历史研究输入；合并VU/DD分值本身无法区分易危与数据缺乏。
methods
Incomplete sampling and unresolved source differences
不完整采样与未解决来源差异

Ecozones had6/21/8/2/14 sites and the species accumulation curve remained unsaturated, so comparisons depend on unequal sampling and incomplete detection. The source gives54 taxa in Results but55 in Table4's total, and an EZ3 maximum RABI of38 in Results/TableA1 versus33 in Table7. No correction of source-wide totals is inferred from these selected members. No original field data, vouchers, plotted pixels or R pipeline were independently reviewed. Transfer to another region requires local ecozones, inventory, threat inputs and adjusted categories, not automatic reuse of Rwanda scores.
生态区分别有6/21/8/2/14站，物种累积曲线仍未饱和，因此比较受到不均采样和不完整检出的影响。来源结果给出54个类群，表4合计却写55；EZ3最大RABI在结果/表A1为38，表7却为33。不从这些选定成员推断对整体来源合计的更正。这里未独立核读原野外数据、凭证、图像像素或R流程。迁移到其他地区需地方生态区、清单、威胁输入及调整后类别，不能自动复用卢旺达分值。

sections: taxonomy

The2016 description links these selected Blythophryne species: Blythophryne beryet. Their pages distinguish Appendix1 comparative vouchers, Table3 molecular rows, earlier literature contrasts and newly examined focal-toad evidence. A listed voucher is not automatically the donor of a listed accession; a GenBank location field is not a current range survey. Generic morphological contrasts cannot be copied as a measured trait for every selected member. methods
Mitochondrial and specimen scope
线粒体与标本范围

The molecular component concatenates partial12S and16S mitochondrial regions, with a broad36-species tree and selected Asian subtrees drawn from43source species labels. Inference depends on taxon sampling and reported support; the low-supported closest-to-focal Bufoides placement is not a certified sister relationship. Those two regions do not supply independent nuclear ancestry or reproductive-isolation evidence. Cleared-and-stained and radiographed specimens retain their explicit examination labels without extending them to unannotated material. The source's “uncorrected k2p” wording and historical accession strings are not silently corrected. No original voucher, alignment, raw sequence, call recording or figure pixel was independently reviewed here.

分子部分拼接线粒体12S及16S部分区段，从43个来源物种标签中构建36种宽泛树及选定亚洲子树。推断依赖类群采样及报告支持度；Bufoides 与焦点最近但支持较低的位置不是已认证姐妹关系。这两个区段不提供独立核基因祖先关系或生殖隔离证据。透明染色与放射影像标本保留明确检查标签，不扩展到无标注材料。来源“uncorrected k2p”措辞及历史登录号不静默更正。这里未独立核读原凭证、比对、原序列、鸣声录音或图像像素。
morphology
A monotypic description with specimen-level limits
单型属描述及标本级限制

Blythophryne was described with the single species beryet in2016. Its diagnosis combines small adult size, webbing and expanded digit tips with six presacral vertebrae and an arciferal girdle. Osteology was based on one named paratype, not a genus-wide variation sample. The holotype is a27.4mm female; different mean summaries, a22.7mm female in the table versus a25.2mm minimum in text, and internal/external vocal-sac wording remain unresolved on the species page. An exceptional six-toed referred adult is not the usual genus digit condition.
Blythophryne 于2016年以单种 beryet 描述。其鉴别组合为小成体体型、蹼和扩展指趾端，以及六枚荐前椎与弧胸型肩带。骨骼依据一件具名副模，不是全属变异样本。正模是27.4mm雌性；不同均值摘要、表中22.7mm雌性与文字25.2mm最低值、内/外声囊措辞差异均在物种页保留未解决。异常六趾参照成体不是属的通常趾数。
ecology
Phytotelm development and historical island ecology
植物积水穴发育与历史岛屿生态

The linked species account retains a single monitored May2011 Rutland tree-hole cohort, stage-specific larval morphology and historical records from five Andaman islands. June breeding-onset wording is kept alongside that May cohort. Loss of observed larvae after rain is a washout hypothesis, not tracked mortality. One archived male call has conflicting pulse duration/gap/count values; secretion-associated deaths are uncontrolled observations. Neither is converted into a verified genus-wide acoustic or chemical-defense mechanism. Island-origin routes and the authors’2016 conservation proposal remain hypotheses or historical assessments rather than current certified conclusions.
链接物种条目保留2011年5月 Rutland 单个被监测树穴群体、分期幼体形态及五个安达曼岛历史记录。“六月开始繁殖”措辞与五月群体并存。雨后观察到幼体减少是冲走假说，不是逐个追踪的死亡。一个档案雄性鸣声存在脉冲时长/间隔/计数冲突；与分泌物相关的死亡是无对照观察。两者不转换成已验证全属鸣声或化学防御机制。岛屿起源途径及作者2016年保护建议保留为假说或历史评估，不是当前认证结论。

sections: taxonomy
Selected comparison records retain their roles
选定比较记录保留各自角色

The2016 description links these selected Sclerophrys species: Sclerophrys brauni, Sclerophrys gracilipes, Sclerophrys gutturalis, Sclerophrys poweri, Sclerophrys steindachneri. Their pages distinguish Appendix1 comparative vouchers, Table3 molecular rows, earlier literature contrasts and newly examined focal-toad evidence. A listed voucher is not automatically the donor of a listed accession; a GenBank location field is not a current range survey. Generic morphological contrasts cannot be copied as a measured trait for every selected member. The source's2016 genus species counts and boundaries are historical context, and accepted navigation follows exact frozen names or explicit nomenclatural links.

2016年描述链接这些选定 Sclerophrys 物种：Sclerophrys brauni、Sclerophrys gracilipes、Sclerophrys gutturalis、Sclerophrys poweri、Sclerophrys steindachneri。各页区分附录1比较凭证、表3分子记录、先前文献对比及新检查焦点蟾蜍的证据。所列凭证不自动等于所列登录号供体；GenBank地点字段不是当前分布调查。属级形态对比不能复制成每个选定成员的测量性状。来源中的2016年属物种数与界限属于历史背景，接受名导航采用精确冻结名称或明确命名对应。
methods
Mitochondrial and specimen scope
线粒体与标本范围

The molecular component concatenates partial12S and16S mitochondrial regions, with a broad36-species tree and selected Asian subtrees drawn from43source species labels. Inference depends on taxon sampling and reported support; the low-supported closest-to-focal Bufoides placement is not a certified sister relationship. Those two regions do not supply independent nuclear ancestry or reproductive-isolation evidence. Cleared-and-stained and radiographed specimens retain their explicit examination labels without extending them to unannotated material. The source's “uncorrected k2p” wording and historical accession strings are not silently corrected. No original voucher, alignment, raw sequence, call recording or figure pixel was independently reviewed here.

分子部分拼接线粒体12S及16S部分区段，从43个来源物种标签中构建36种宽泛树及选定亚洲子树。推断依赖类群采样及报告支持度；Bufoides 与焦点最近但支持较低的位置不是已认证姐妹关系。这两个区段不提供独立核基因祖先关系或生殖隔离证据。透明染色与放射影像标本保留明确检查标签，不扩展到无标注材料。来源“uncorrected k2p”措辞及历史登录号不静默更正。这里未独立核读原凭证、比对、原序列、鸣声录音或图像像素。
taxonomy
Frozen nomenclatural correspondence retains the source label
冻结命名对应保留来源标签

Frozen COL26.8 dataset316115 usage66C6V links source Amietophrynus brauni to accepted Sclerophrys brauni (4VQ87). This supports navigation under a nomenclatural correspondence, not independent re-identification of the2016 comparison's specimens or sequence donors. Where several source labels link to one accepted species, their distinct sequence rows and provenance remain separate rather than being counted as independent accepted species.

methods
Mitochondrial and specimen scope
线粒体与标本范围

The molecular component concatenates partial12S and16S mitochondrial regions, with a broad36-species tree and selected Asian subtrees drawn from43source species labels. Inference depends on taxon sampling and reported support; the low-supported closest-to-focal Bufoides placement is not a certified sister relationship. Those two regions do not supply independent nuclear ancestry or reproductive-isolation evidence. Cleared-and-stained and radiographed specimens retain their explicit examination labels without extending them to unannotated material. The source's “uncorrected k2p” wording and historical accession strings are not silently corrected. No original voucher, alignment, raw sequence, call recording or figure pixel was independently reviewed here.

分子部分拼接线粒体12S及16S部分区段，从43个来源物种标签中构建36种宽泛树及选定亚洲子树。推断依赖类群采样及报告支持度；Bufoides 与焦点最近但支持较低的位置不是已认证姐妹关系。这两个区段不提供独立核基因祖先关系或生殖隔离证据。透明染色与放射影像标本保留明确检查标签，不扩展到无标注材料。来源“uncorrected k2p”措辞及历史登录号不静默更正。这里未独立核读原凭证、比对、原序列、鸣声录音或图像像素。

The2016 description links these selected Pelophryne species: Pelophryne api, Pelophryne linanitensis, Pelophryne misera, Pelophryne murudensis, Pelophryne signata. Their pages distinguish Appendix1 comparative vouchers, Table3 molecular rows, earlier literature contrasts and newly examined focal-toad evidence. A listed voucher is not automatically the donor of a listed accession; a GenBank location field is not a current range survey. Generic morphological contrasts cannot be copied as a measured trait for every selected member. The source's2016 genus species counts and boundaries are historical context, and accepted navigation follows exact frozen names or explicit nomenclatural links.

2016年描述链接这些选定 Pelophryne 物种：Pelophryne api、Pelophryne linanitensis、Pelophryne misera、Pelophryne murudensis、Pelophryne signata。各页区分附录1比较凭证、表3分子记录、先前文献对比及新检查焦点蟾蜍的证据。所列凭证不自动等于所列登录号供体；GenBank地点字段不是当前分布调查。属级形态对比不能复制成每个选定成员的测量性状。来源中的2016年属物种数与界限属于历史背景，接受名导航采用精确冻结名称或明确命名对应。
methods
Mitochondrial and specimen scope
线粒体与标本范围

The molecular component concatenates partial12S and16S mitochondrial regions, with a broad36-species tree and selected Asian subtrees drawn from43source species labels. Inference depends on taxon sampling and reported support; the low-supported closest-to-focal Bufoides placement is not a certified sister relationship. Those two regions do not supply independent nuclear ancestry or reproductive-isolation evidence. Cleared-and-stained and radiographed specimens retain their explicit examination labels without extending them to unannotated material. The source's “uncorrected k2p” wording and historical accession strings are not silently corrected. No original voucher, alignment, raw sequence, call recording or figure pixel was independently reviewed here.

分子部分拼接线粒体12S及16S部分区段，从43个来源物种标签中构建36种宽泛树及选定亚洲子树。推断依赖类群采样及报告支持度；Bufoides 与焦点最近但支持较低的位置不是已认证姐妹关系。这两个区段不提供独立核基因祖先关系或生殖隔离证据。透明染色与放射影像标本保留明确检查标签，不扩展到无标注材料。来源“uncorrected k2p”措辞及历史登录号不静默更正。这里未独立核读原凭证、比对、原序列、鸣声录音或图像像素。

Selected comparison records retain their roles
选定比较记录保留各自角色

The2016 description links these selected Rhaebo species: Rhaebo guttatus. Their pages distinguish Appendix1 comparative vouchers, Table3 molecular rows, earlier literature contrasts and newly examined focal-toad evidence. A listed voucher is not automatically the donor of a listed accession; a GenBank location field is not a current range survey. Generic morphological contrasts cannot be copied as a measured trait for every selected member. The source's2016 genus species counts and boundaries are historical context, and accepted navigation follows exact frozen names or explicit nomenclatural links.
2016年描述链接这些选定 Rhaebo 物种：Rhaebo guttatus。各页区分附录1比较凭证、表3分子记录、先前文献对比及新检查焦点蟾蜍的证据。所列凭证不自动等于所列登录号供体；GenBank地点字段不是当前分布调查。属级形态对比不能复制成每个选定成员的测量性状。来源中的2016年属物种数与界限属于历史背景，接受名导航采用精确冻结名称或明确命名对应。
methods
Mitochondrial and specimen scope
线粒体与标本范围

The molecular component concatenates partial12S and16S mitochondrial regions, with a broad36-species tree and selected Asian subtrees drawn from43source species labels. Inference depends on taxon sampling and reported support; the low-supported closest-to-focal Bufoides placement is not a certified sister relationship. Those two regions do not supply independent nuclear ancestry or reproductive-isolation evidence. Cleared-and-stained and radiographed specimens retain their explicit examination labels without extending them to unannotated material. The source's “uncorrected k2p” wording and historical accession strings are not silently corrected. No original voucher, alignment, raw sequence, call recording or figure pixel was independently reviewed here.

分子部分拼接线粒体12S及16S部分区段，从43个来源物种标签中构建36种宽泛树及选定亚洲子树。推断依赖类群采样及报告支持度；Bufoides 与焦点最近但支持较低的位置不是已认证姐妹关系。这两个区段不提供独立核基因祖先关系或生殖隔离证据。透明染色与放射影像标本保留明确检查标签，不扩展到无标注材料。来源“uncorrected k2p”措辞及历史登录号不静默更正。这里未独立核读原凭证、比对、原序列、鸣声录音或图像像素。

sections: taxonomy
A restricted myersi group within Pristimantis
Pristimantis 内范围缩小的 myersi 群组

The2023 study retains these16 named members in its revised myersi group: Pristimantis festae, Pristimantis floridus, Pristimantis gladiator, Pristimantis gralarias, Pristimantis hectus, Pristimantis leoni, Pristimantis lucidosignatus, Pristimantis munozi, Pristimantis myersi, Pristimantis ocreatus, Pristimantis onorei, Pristimantis pyrrhomerus, Pristimantis repens, Pristimantis scopaeus, Pristimantis sirnigeli, Pristimantis xeniolum. It proposes Trachyphrynus as a formal subgenus name for that restricted clade. Albujai, bicantus, nelsongalloi andsambalan are excluded by the inferred relationships; jubatus andthe verecundus/celator/mutabilis clade are also outside its narrower definition. Those decisions concern this study's supraspecific hypothesis, not a revised diagnosis of all Pristimantis or an independently authenticated current catalogue. Floridus, repens, scopaeus andxeniolum were retained without sampled phylogenetic placement.

2023年研究将这些16个具名成员保留在修订的 myersi 群组中：Pristimantis festae、Pristimantis floridus、Pristimantis gladiator、Pristimantis gralarias、Pristimantis hectus、Pristimantis leoni、Pristimantis lucidosignatus、Pristimantis munozi、Pristimantis myersi、Pristimantis ocreatus、Pristimantis onorei、Pristimantis pyrrhomerus、Pristimantis repens、Pristimantis scopaeus、Pristimantis sirnigeli、Pristimantis xeniolum。它提出以 Trachyphrynus 作为此范围缩小分支的正式亚属名。Albujai、bicantus、nelsongalloi及sambalan根据推断关系被排除；jubatus和verecundus/celator/mutabilis分支也位于较窄定义之外。这些决定针对本研究种上级假说，不是全部 Pristimantis 的修订鉴别或独立认证的当前目录。Floridus、repens、scopaeus及xeniolum虽保留，但无采样系统位置。
evolution
Candidate lineages and one-marker inference
候选谱系与单标记推断

The analysis uses mitochondrial16S, model-based trees and uncorrected p-distance, with2% as a candidate-screening heuristic. The authors distinguish confirmed candidates, unconfirmed candidates and deep conspecific lineages; these are research categories rather than automatically accepted scientific species. Some candidate comparisons overlap below2%, and sp.13 is UCC in Results butCCS in Discussion. Mitochondrial divergence and reciprocal monophyly do not alone demonstrate nuclear independence or reproductive isolation. Methods760/219 versusanalysis742/215terminal counts remain separate; ultrafast bootstrap and Bayesian posterior support are different statistics.
分析使用线粒体16S、基于模型的系统树及未校正p距离，以2%作候选筛查经验阈值。作者区分确认候选、未确认候选及深分歧同种谱系，这是研究类别，不自动成为接受科学物种。一些候选比较包含低于2%的值；sp.13在结果称UCC、讨论却称CCS。线粒体分歧及互惠单系本身不能证明核基因独立或生殖隔离。方法760/219与分析742/215终端数分别保留；超快速自举和贝叶斯后验支持是不同统计。
morphology
Group character ranges and exceptions
群组性状范围与例外

The restricted group definition includes short snouts, robust bodies, FingerI shorter thanII, ToeV longer thanIII and no cranial crests. Female15.8–34.6mm andmale12.6–20.5mm SVL are pooled group-level ranges, not fresh measurements for every linked species. Generally narrow discs have a floridus exception, and that species remains unsampled. The paper acknowledges no unambiguous phenotypic synapomorphy; resemblance alone cannot assign all superficially similar frogs to this clade. The morphology and low-perching/ground-use statements apply to the source’s defined group, not the entire genus.
较窄群组定义包括短吻、粗壮体躯、第一指短于第二指、第五趾长于第三趾及无头脊。雌性15.8–34.6mm、雄性12.6–20.5mm SVL是群组汇总范围，不是每个链接物种的新测量。通常较窄的指盘具有floridus例外，且该种仍未采样。文章承认没有无歧义表型共有衍征，仅凭相似不能把所有外观类似蛙都归入此支。形态及低位停栖/地面利用陈述针对来源定义群组，不是整个属。
range
Re-identified records and geographic hypotheses
重鉴定记录与地理假说

Sixteen GenBank sequence labels are revised in Table1. Those are sequence-specific decisions, not formal synonymy for every original species or blanket transfer of all historic localities. Table2 keeps previous distributions and Thisstudy restrictions separate. Hectus lacks type-locality DNA and its sampling distance is reported as100km in Results versus45km in Discussion. Suggested valley or river-basin barriers and cryptic-trait retention are hypotheses, without a direct gene-flow or selection experiment. The linked pages keep those limits and distinct geographic comparisons visible.
表1修订16条GenBank序列标签，这是序列特定决定，不是全部原物种的正式异名化或所有历史地点的整体转移。表2分别保留先前分布与Thisstudy限制。Hectus缺少模式地点DNA，采样距离在结果写100km、讨论却写45km。谷地或河流盆地屏障及隐蔽性状保留解释属于假说，没有直接基因流或选择实验。链接页面保留这些限制及不同地理比较。
methods
Counts, historical assessments and unreviewed supplements
计数、历史评估及未核读补充数据

The paper says16recognized species plus8candidates would become23; that arithmetic is not silently repaired or accepted as a certified total. It also labels a western-montane list nine species while enumerating ten. Table2 historical IUCN andEcuador2021 labels are distinct from current assessments, and reassessment requests do not measure population decline. Earlier recorded downloads failed; both DOCX files have now been retrieved through the official PMC cloud. All Appendix row cells were read, while remaining distance values, raw aligned sequences, plotted pixels and original specimens remain independently unreviewed. The genus reading route explains this selected group study, not complete biology for the genus.
文章说16个承认物种加8个候选将变为23；这里不静默修正算术或接受为认证总数。它还把西部山地清单称为九种，但枚举十种。表2历史IUCN及厄瓜多尔2021年标签不同于当前评估；重评请求也未测量种群下降。先前记录的下载失败；现已通过官方PMC云端取得两份DOCX并核读附录全部行单元格，其余距离值、原比对序列、图像像素及原标本仍未独立核读。属阅读路径解释这个选定群组研究，不代表完整全属生物学。
evolution
Additional excluded branches and named comparisons
另附被排除分支与具名比较

The linked comparisons add Pristimantis albujai, Pristimantis bicantus, Pristimantis nelsongalloi, Pristimantis sambalan, Pristimantis caprifer, Pristimantis acuminatus, Pristimantis eriphus, Pristimantis celator, Pristimantis mutabilis, Pristimantis verecundus, Pristimantis jubatus. Albujai has alternative group placements; bicantus, nelsongalloi, sambalan andcaprifer occur in a branch outside the restricted myersi definition, near the acuminatus/eriphus branch. The verecundus/celator/mutabilis andjubatus branches are also outside that narrower definition. Sampled bicantus paraphyly and proposed euphronides allocation are source-specific hypotheses, not completed synonymization or evidence of a particular hybridization history.

链接比较另加 Pristimantis albujai、Pristimantis bicantus、Pristimantis nelsongalloi、Pristimantis sambalan、Pristimantis caprifer、Pristimantis acuminatus、Pristimantis eriphus、Pristimantis celator、Pristimantis mutabilis、Pristimantis verecundus、Pristimantis jubatus。Albujai具有备选群组归属；bicantus、nelsongalloi、sambalan及caprifer位于较窄myersi定义之外的分支，邻近acuminatus/eriphus分支。Verecundus/celator/mutabilis及jubatus分支也在较窄定义之外。采样bicantus并系及所提euphronides归属属于来源特定假说，不是已完成异名化或特定杂交历史的证据。
morphology
Expanded-group contrasts have restricted evidence roles
较广群组对比具有有限证据角色

The Discussion contrasts expanded discs and a discoidal fold in formerly included verecundus/jubatus branches with the narrower myersi definition. It separately notes absent vocal slits in celator andjubatus. These are literature-informed contrasts, not new measurements of every specimen; absent vocal slits are not proof of absent calling. The referenced arboreal versus low-perching comparison is not a climbing-performance experiment or a habitat census for the entire genus.
讨论以先前纳入verecundus/jubatus分支的扩展指盘及腹褶与较窄myersi定义对比，另指出celator及jubatus缺乏声裂。这是文献支持的对比，不是每件标本的新测量；缺少声裂不证明不鸣叫。引用的树栖/低位停栖对比不是攀爬性能实验或全属栖境普查。
methods
Named specimens and unnamed candidates stay separate
具名标本与未命名候选分别保留

The wider verecundus clade includes nine unconfirmed candidates alongside three named members; old verecundus labels relabelled sp.2/sp.10 are not transferred back to accepted verecundus. The jubatus sister candidate sp.1 includes old hectus-labelled Colombian specimens, whose locality is not automatically a new jubatus locality. Carchi andPichincha named-sample contexts remain separate from candidate localities and complete native ranges. Additional morphology/bioacoustics is requested by the authors, and Appendix vouchers/distances remain independently unreviewed.
较大verecundus分支含三个具名成员及九条未确认候选；旧verecundus标签改为sp.2/sp.10的记录不移回接受种verecundus。Jubatus的姐妹候选sp.1包括旧标hectus的哥伦比亚标本，其地点不自动成为新jubatus地点。Carchi及Pichincha具名样本背景与候选地点、完整本土分布分别保留。作者要求更多形态/声学证据，附录凭证/距离仍未独立核读。
evolution
Appendix donors distinguish source categories
附录供体区分来源类别

The retrieved Appendix has231rows,of which155match43exact accepted-name labels after expanding the explicit P.abbreviation. The remaining76rows retain sp./cf./unresolved-name labels rather than become accepted species. “Our study” and “Genbank” remain printed provenance categories. Floridus has four specimen/locality rows butno GenBank accessions,so it remains unsampled for molecular placement in this study. Matching a donor/accession does not certify reproductive isolation, current classification ororiginal museum identity.
取回附录有231行，其中155行在展开明确P.缩写后匹配43个精确接受名。其余76行保留sp./cf./未解决名称标签，不变为接受种。“Our study”及“Genbank”保持所印溯源类别。Floridus有四标本/地点行但无GenBank登录号，因此在此研究分子位置上仍未采样。供体/登录号匹配不认证生殖隔离、当前分类或原博物馆身份。
occurrence
Original coordinate strings are not corrected points
原坐标字符串不是修正地理点

Each donor retains locality,latitude,longitude andelevation fields with row-level locators. Onorei Toisán rows174–176 print N in longitude fields;mutabilis row19 prints12O2 with letterO; decimal commas andsigned/hemisphere notation vary. These strings are preserved as reported,without inventing W,1202m orreplacementcoordinates. A country/province entry orblank/dash does not supply a new map point orcomplete current range. Coordinate reconciliation remains separate from reading a printed row.
每供体保留地点、纬度、经度和海拔字段及逐行定位。Onorei Toisán第174–176行在经度字段印N，mutabilis第19行印含字母O的12O2；十进制逗号及符号/半球记法不同。按所报保留字符串，不虚构W、1202m或替代坐标。国家/省条目或空白/横杠不提供新地图点或完整当前分布。坐标协调与核读所印行分别处理。
taxonomy
Reused accessions and unresolved names
重复登录号与未解决名称

Appendix devillei KU217991 atPapallacta andpichincha QCAZ11673 atMojanda both useEF493688.1. That record conflict does not enact synonymy orsettle the original specimen identity. Row219 prints brevifros; the recorded dataset316115 exact-name query found no resolved frozen accepted bridge,so its donor is not silently reassigned to brevifrons oranother name. Qualified bicantus andnumbered candidates retain their own source labels.
附录Papallacta的devillei KU217991与Mojanda的pichincha QCAZ11673均用EF493688.1。该记录冲突不实施异名，也不解决原标本身份。第219行印brevifros，已记录dataset316115精确名查询没有已解决冻结接受桥接，因此供体不静默重归brevifrons或别名。带限定bicantus及编号候选保留各自来源标签。
methods
Source retrieval and the remaining distance review
来源获取与余下距离核读

Both DOCX supplements were retrieved from the official PMC cloud with matching DOI, license and MD5 values. All 231 Appendix donor rows, all nine distance-table terminal-label columns and 67 selected numerical cells have now been read. Remaining numerical cells, raw alignments, original sequences, museum vouchers and figure pixels remain unreviewed. Selected routes expose source evidence without certifying complete biology for every Pristimantis.
两份 DOCX 补充文件均通过官方 PMC 云端获取，DOI、许可及 MD5 相符。现已核读全部 231 个附录供体行、九张距离表末端标签列及 67 个选定数值单元格。其余数值单元格、原比对、原序列、博物馆凭证及图像像素仍未读。选定路径呈现来源证据，不认证每个 Pristimantis 的完整生物学。
evolution
Selected cells show limits of a distance threshold
选定单元格说明距离阈值的边界

The nine supplementary tables report uncorrected 16S percent p-distances. The 67 selected cells read here include leoni–sp. 13 values of 1.3%, 1.5% and 2.1%, and gladiator–festae values of 1.9%, 2.1%, 2.2% and 2.5%. Mutabilis-labelled pairs include 2.4% and 2.5%. Thus both cross-label and within-label comparisons can fall on different sides of the study’s 2% heuristic. These selected cells are neither exhaustive ranges nor independent tests of reproductive isolation; raw alignment and original sequence identity remain unverified.

九张补充表报告未校正 16S 百分 p 距离。此处核读的 67 个选定单元格包含 leoni–sp. 13 的 1.3%、1.5% 和 2.1%，gladiator–festae 的 1.9%、2.1%、2.2% 和 2.5%；mutabilis 标签内配对含 2.4% 和 2.5%。因此跨标签及标签内比较都可能位于研究 2% 启发阈值的不同侧。选定单元格既不是穷尽范围，也不是独立生殖隔离测试；原比对及原序列身份仍未核实。
evolution
The sp. 12 locality comparisons stay within a candidate label
sp. 12 地点比较保持候选标签

Table S4 labels all ten terminals sp. 12. Selected values are 0.5% for Morán DBR406/DHMECN13339, 1.5% and 1.7% for Tufiño–Maldonado DBR264 and DBR263 against Virgen Negra DHMECN13354, 0.4% for DBR263 against Morán DHMECN13339, and 0.4% for DBR263/DBR264. These particular cells are not a complete within-lineage range or evidence assigning sp. 12 to an accepted species. DBR and Appendix ZSFQ codes are not automatically equivalent.

taxonomy

Table S8 terminal 5 prints “sp. 18_floridus” with DHMECN13336, while retaining the numbered candidate label. taxonomy

sections: ecology
Read the local accounts in their separate roles

These initial routes cover three supplementary local accounts, while the revision’s focal descriptions and redescriptions remain to be read in detail. Atratus is reported from eastern-slope upper montane forest and placed in a supported phoxocephalus subgroup; galdi is a lower montane encounter and a phylogenetic outgroup; lymani is a western-slope and pastureland encounter characterized locally as terrestrial. Their evidence roles and local intervals are not interchangeable.

methods
Encounter categories are not population estimates
