evolution
Keep support and taxonomic hypotheses distinct
区分支持度与分类假说

The concatenated analyses use mitochondrial12S/16S and nuclearRAG-1 with maximum-likelihood and Bayesian inference. The source places atratus with percultus, chomskyi, andinogigas and multicolor, while discussing unresolved boundaries between chomskyi andandinogigas. Approximate genetic similarity and personal field observations motivate further revision; they do not enact a synonymy here. A printed moderate-support Bayesian upper value9.95 is retained as a source inconsistency rather than accepted as a possible probability.
串联分析使用线粒体12S/16S与核RAG-1，以最大似然及贝叶斯推断。来源把atratus置于percultus、chomskyi、andinogigas及multicolor一起，同时讨论chomskyi与andinogigas之间未解决界限。近似遗传相似及个人野外观察促成进一步修订，不在这里实施异名化。中等支持的贝叶斯上界印为9.95，保留为来源不一致，不当作可能概率。
taxonomy
The local andinognomus label remains qualified
当地andinognomus标签仍有限定

The revision explicitly suspects that Abra de Zamora andinognomus differs from its Tapichalaca type-locality population, despite frequent local calls and historical paratype citations. Vidua’s historical all-female hypothesis is revised by observed males, while encounter differences could reflect sex-specific detectability. Neither a catalogue-name match nor etymology resolves population identity or reproductive mode.
修订明确怀疑Abra de Zamora的andinognomus不同于Tapichalaca模式地点种群，虽有频繁当地鸣声及历史副模引用。Vidua历史全雌假说由观察到雄性修订，但遇见差异可能反映分性别检出率。目录同名匹配和语源均不解决种群身份或生殖方式。
evolution
Three subgroups and unresolved internal relationships
三个亚组与未解决内部关系

The source recovers the orestes group with bootstrap100% and posterior1, distinguishing orestes, simonbolivari and bromeliad-associated colodactylus subgroups. Vidua belongs to the first, samaniegoi to the second, and colodactylus/matildae to the third. Strong broad subgroup support does not make every internal placement resolved: vidua’s exact position and samaniegoi’s closest relationships remain uncertain. Candidate lineages remain unnamed and unassigned.
来源恢复orestes群，自举100%、后验1，区分orestes、simonbolivari及凤梨科相关colodactylus三个亚组。Vidua属第一，samaniegoi属第二，colodactylus/matildae属第三。较广亚组强支持不使每个内部位置解决：vidua精确位置及samaniegoi最近关系仍不确定。候选谱系保持未命名且不赋值。
ecology
Measured calls and bromeliad observations are different evidence
测量鸣声与凤梨科观察是不同证据

Vidua and samaniegoi have measured clicking calls from three and five males respectively. Call duration, frequency measurements and numbers of males are separate sampling units. Colodactylus and matildae are associated with terrestrial and arboreal bromeliads and show water-retreat behavior; their advertisement calls are unknown. Short-digit adaptation is a hypothesis rather than a measured adhesion experiment, and absence of heard calling is not inability to vocalize.
Vidua及samaniegoi分别有来自三及五只雄性的测量点击鸣声。鸣叫时长、频率测量及雄性数是不同采样单位。Colodactylus与matildae关联地生及树生凤梨科植物，表现退至积水行为；求偶鸣声未知。短指趾适应是假说而非附着测量实验；未听到鸣叫不等于不能发声。
range
Revised ranges and2020 conservation proposals
修订分布与2020年保护提议

The authors retain Endangered for vidua, propose Critically Endangered for the restricted colodactylus concept, and propose Near Threatened for samaniegoi and matildae. Each interpretation combines its own reported range and habitat context. Localities, area estimates and categories are not interchangeable, independently reconstructed here or verified as current assessments. Matildae’s summarized3360m limit and a3361m paratype elevation remain separately recorded.
作者为vidua保留濒危、为较窄colodactylus概念提议极危，为samaniegoi及matildae提议近危。各解释结合自身报告分布与栖境背景。地点、面积估计及等级不能互换，这里也未独立重建或验证为当前评估。Matildae概括3360米上界与3361米副模海拔分别记录。
morphology
Four Huicundomantis focal treatments
四个Huicundomantis重点条目

The revision distinguishes cryptomelas concealed black surfaces with pale/orange margins, percultus pustulate dorsal/flank skin, balionotus dorsal flecking, and highly variable versicolor colors. Table3 keeps sex-specific samples and marks some percultus/balionotus measurements as taken from original descriptions. Female body mass includes eggs. Size ranges and coloration belong to their named samples and do not become genus-wide thresholds or independently measured mechanisms.
修订区分cryptomelas隐蔽黑表面及浅色/橙边、percultus背/侧疱疣皮、balionotus背斑点及versicolor高度多变颜色。表3保留分性别样本，并标明percultus/balionotus部分测量来自原描述。雌性体重包括卵。体长及颜色属于具名样本，不转为全属阈值或独立测量机制。
ecology
Calling is not inferred from vocal-sac presence
不从声囊存在与否推断鸣叫

Balionotus whistles usually contain one or two notes, occasionally up to eight; its short-call summary and double-note duration are kept distinct. Versicolor has observed and measured chirp-like calling despite males lacking vocal sac/slits, with one to five notes. Cryptomelas and percultus advertisement calls remain unknown in the revision. Per-male sample sizes, counts of calls and frequency measurements are separate units; proposed social triggers are not controlled experiments.
Balionotus哨鸣通常一或二音，有时多至八音；短鸣概括与双音时长分别保留。Versicolor雄性虽无声囊/声裂，仍有已观察测量唧声，一至五音。修订中cryptomelas及percultus求偶鸣声仍未知。雄性样本数、鸣叫次数及频率测量为不同单位；所提社交触发不是受控实验。
evolution
Support varies by method and phylogenetic level
支持随方法与系统层级不同

Huicundomantis is strongly supported broadly, but cryptomelas-group ML support is moderate and the cryptomelas/spinosus relation weak or moderate depending on method. Percultus and balionotus internal relationships remain unresolved. Southern versicolor populations about2%16S different from northern/type-area samples require further revision. No unnamed candidate or geographically distant uncertain record is automatically assigned to a current accepted species; dated conservation proposals remain source interpretations.
Huicundomantis较广层级获强支持，但cryptomelas群ML支持中等，cryptomelas/spinosus关系按方法为弱或中等。Percultus及balionotus内部关系仍未解决。南方versicolor种群与北方/模式地区样本约2%16S差异，需进一步修订。不把未命名候选或远方不确定记录自动赋给当前接受种；有日期保护提议仍为来源解释。

Original vouchers and historical records remain unreviewed here, and the dated interpretation is not presented as a current global extinction assessment.

sections: taxonomy
A newly described glassfrog outside the frozen catalogue
冻结目录之外的新描述玻璃蛙

The2026 study describes Nymphargus dajomesae from El Quimi, Ecuador, under ZooBank act ECC9AD28-F16A-4B58-8E13-CD6DA3A82A9E. The frozen COL26.8 accepted-species list has no exact entry for that name. Its source account is therefore presented here at genus level, separately from the accepted-species routes; no identifier or complete catalogue concept is invented. The epithet honors Ecuadorian Olympic weightlifter Neisi Dajomes. The proposed common names are Dajomes Glassfrog and Rana de cristal de Dajomes.

2026年研究描述厄瓜多尔El Quimi的Nymphargus dajomesae，ZooBank命名行为ECC9AD28-F16A-4B58-8E13-CD6DA3A82A9E。冻结COL26.8接受种清单没有此名精确条目。因此在属页呈现来源条目，与接受种阅读路径分开；不虚构标识或完整目录概念。种加词纪念厄瓜多尔奥运举重选手Neisi Dajomes。建议俗名Dajomes Glassfrog及Rana de cristal de Dajomes。
occurrence
Type specimens and locality records
模式标本与地点记录

The holotype is adult male QCAZ-A68586, collected on7July2017 in the ElQuimi reserve buffer zone, MoronaSantiago, at3.5192°S,78.3837°W,2070m. The paratype paragraph lists six adult males: QCAZ-A68522–26 with the holotype collection data, and QCAZ-A72521 collected13April2018 at3.51926°S,78.37752°W,2111m. Together with the holotype this is the seven-male type series used for the reported male size range. These coordinates preserve the paper’s voucher-linked records rather than certifying all individuals in the region or the current geographic range.

正模为成年雄性QCAZ-A68586，2017年7月7日采于MoronaSantiago的ElQuimi保护区缓冲带，3.5192°S、78.3837°W、2070m。副模段列六只成年雄性：QCAZ-A68522–26与正模采集数据相同，QCAZ-A72521于2018年4月13日采于3.51926°S、78.37752°W、2111m。加正模为报告雄性体型范围所用七只模式系列。坐标保留论文凭证相连记录，不认证区域全部个体或当前地理分布。
morphology
The focal character combination
焦点种的性状组合

The diagnosis combines an unmarked green dorsum, yellow digits, green bones, white heart/esophageal/stomach/renal peritonea, a largely white parietal peritoneum and a clear hepatic peritoneum. Adult males lack humeral spines and vomerine teeth; the dorsum is shagreen, the venter granular, hand webbing reduced, and two subcloacal warts are reported. The iris is tan to greyish tan with fine dark reticulations/punctuations and a pale-yellow circumpupillary ring. In preservative, lavender dorsal skin and cream digits replace the live colors. These are the source’s character observations, not an independent histological or pigment-function experiment.
鉴别组合为无斑绿背、黄指趾、绿骨、白色心包/食道/胃/肾腹膜、大部分白色壁腹膜及透明肝腹膜。成年雄性无肱刺和犁骨齿；背皮细粒状、腹皮颗粒状、手蹼减少，并报告一对泄殖腔下疣。虹膜黄褐至灰黄褐，具细暗网纹/点纹和浅黄色瞳周环。保存后背皮淡紫、指趾乳白，与活体彩色不同。这是来源性状观察，不是独立组织学或色素功能实验。
morphology
Seven adult males, with measurement conflicts retained
七只成年雄性及保留的测量冲突

The reported seven-male SVL range is20.8–27.2mm, mean22.4±2.2mm; females are unknown. Table2 gives HW7.2–10.2mm (8.1±1.0), HL5.7–8.3(6.3±1.0), ED2.6–2.9(2.8±0.1), IOD3.4–4.2(3.6±0.3), EN1.4–2.3(1.8±0.3), IND1.8–2.4(1.9±0.2), TL11.5–15.6(12.5±1.5), FL8.4–12.8(9.4±1.6), and third-finger disc width1.1–2.1(1.5±0.3), all inmm. TD is defined in the caption but has no measurement row. Holotype text and measurements give SVL21.3mm, while Fig3’s caption gives23.3mm. Neither value is silently replaced. The text says the eye is larger than its third-finger disc yet prints ED/Fin3DW=0.55 alongside ED2.58mm anddisc1.42mm; that inconsistency is retained.
morphology
Variation and the dorsal-snout disagreement
变异与背视吻形的分歧

The source describes variation from tan to greyish-tan irises and denser punctuations in QCAZ-A68522. Paratypes68523/68524 have rounder subcloacal warts,68523/68525 darker limbs,68524 a low ulnar fold, and68526 lighter skin. The definition and diagnosis call the snout truncate in dorsal view, while the holotype description calls it rounded dorsally and truncate in profile. The record is kept as a conflict in the focal account, rather than selecting one wording as the universal state for every individual. No figure pixels were independently measured here.
来源描述虹膜黄褐至灰黄褐变异，QCAZ-A68522点纹更密。副模68523/68524泄殖腔下疣更圆、68523/68525肢体较暗、68524有低尺侧褶、68526皮肤较浅。定义及鉴别称背视吻截形，正模描述却称背视圆、侧视截形。在焦点条目保留为冲突，不选择一种表述作为每个个体普遍状态。这里未独立测量图像像素。
ecology
A call account with unresolved replication
重复单位尚未解决的鸣声条目

The call account refers to male QCAZ-A68524 at the type locality on8July2017,20:30. It reports a single pulsed click-like note,33.6calls/minute (0.56/s), duration0.049±0.003s (0.0453–0.052), dominant frequency4154.3±11Hz (4142.6–4166.0),90%bandwidth243.7±15.27Hz (222–246) andpeak time0.0105±0.0031s (0.0061–0.0139). Up to four harmonics are described. Methods say only one call was associated with this male, yet the Results give ranges/SD and Fig8 shows two consecutive calls; the sampling unit/count is unresolved here. Ambient temperature is unavailable, so these values are not temperature-standardized comparisons. Sister-species calls, tadpoles, egg clutches, parental care and fighting behavior remain unknown in the source; unknown is not biological absence.

鸣声条目对应2017年7月8日20:30在模式地点的雄性QCAZ-A68524。报告单一有脉冲点击状音，33.6次/分钟（0.56/s）、时长0.049±0.003s（0.0453–0.052）、主频4154.3±11Hz（4142.6–4166.0）、90%带宽243.7±15.27Hz（222–246）及峰值时间0.0105±0.0031s（0.0061–0.0139），描述最多四谐波。方法说仅一鸣声与该雄性关联，结果却给范围/标准差，图8显示两个连续鸣声；此处采样单位/计数未解决。环境温度未给，数值不是温度标准化比较。来源中的姐妹种鸣声、蝌蚪、卵块、亲代照护及争斗行为仍未知；未知不等于生物学不存在。
range
One regional locality and competing elevation statements
一个地区地点与不同海拔陈述

The distribution paragraph restricts known records to ElQuimi on Cordillera del Cóndor and gives1992–2090m. The paratype paragraph independently reports QCAZ-A72521 at2111m, outside that summary. The plateau itself is described as part of the sandstone Hollin Formation at2000–2200m; geological plateau elevation is not another observed species range. These printed values are kept separately. Two local coordinate points within the reported locality do not prove that no other populations exist or a complete current range.
分布段把已知记录限定于Cóndor山脉ElQuimi，给1992–2090m；副模段独立报告QCAZ-A72521在2111m，超出该汇总。台地本身描述为Hollin组砂岩一部分、海拔2000–2200m；地质台地高度不是另一实测物种范围。分别保留所印数值。所报地点内两个坐标点不证明别处无种群或完整当前分布。
ecology
Night activity beside sandstone-plateau streams
砂岩台地溪流旁的夜间活动

At the ElQuimi site, low/open canopy,10–15m scattered trees, shrubs, mosses, roots and terrestrial bromeliads characterize the reported montane forest. Most sampled individuals were active at night on leaves60–180cm above ground near streams; QCAZ-A68523 was on bromeliads and68522/68524/68586 were calling. Figure9’s caption describes a slow blackwater stream rich in tannins. These are field observations and caption descriptions at this site, not an experimental habitat-preference test, population density or a newly established bromeliad specialization.
ElQuimi地点所报山地林具有低而开放冠层、散生10–15m树木、灌木、苔藓、根及地生凤梨。多数采样个体夜间活动，位于溪旁离地60–180cm叶片；QCAZ-A68523在凤梨上，68522/68524/68586鸣叫。图9图注描述富单宁、流缓黑水溪。这是该地点野外观察及图注描述，不是栖境偏好实验、种群密度或新确立凤梨专化。
ecology
A Data Deficient proposal and prospective threats
数据缺乏建议与未来威胁

The authors propose DataDeficient under IUCN criteria because surveys were scant/sporadic and population status unknown. They do not present a verified current IUCN listing. The reported type locality is5km from agricultural areas and7km from large-scale mining; mining is discussed as a possible future threat to this species, not a measured causal decline in this sampled population. The possibility of additional populations remains open. Protected-area context therefore does not certify freedom from threats or recovery.
作者依IUCN标准建议数据缺乏，因为调查少且零散、种群状态未知；并未提供核实的当前IUCN名录评估。所报模式地点距农业区5km、距大型矿业开采7km；采矿被讨论为该种可能未来威胁，不是采样种群实测因果下降。仍可能发现其他种群。因此保护区背景不认证无威胁或恢复。
evolution
Concatenated and nuclear-only relationships differ
拼接与核基因单独关系不同

The combined10-locus tree places the new ElQuimi lineage sister to unnamed SanJuanBosco DHMECN2249 (tissueQCAZ-A59068), previously misidentified as cariticommatus, with a secondary-calibrated split around4.4Ma. The nuclear-only tree instead places it sister to lasgralarias across the Andes; nuclear support is generally weak. A45km airline separation and650–800m Zamora-valley barrier are proposed geographic explanations, not direct gene-flow measurements. Genus origin near17Ma and focal separation from the closest named griffithsi/lasgralarias near6Ma are model estimates, not direct fossil dates or universal taxonomic cutoffs.

联合10位点树把新ElQuimi谱系与未命名SanJuanBosco DHMECN2249（组织QCAZ-A59068）恢复为姐妹；后者曾误鉴cariticommatus，二级校准分离约4.4Ma。核基因单独树却把新种与安第斯对侧lasgralarias恢复为姐妹，核支持通常较弱。直线45km间距及650–800m的Zamora谷地屏障为所提地理解释，不是直接基因流测量。属起源约17Ma、焦点与最近具名griffithsi/lasgralarias分离约6Ma，是模型估计，不是直接化石年代或普适分类阈值。
taxonomy
Disputed donor identities remain separate
有争议供体身份分别保留

Cochranae-labelled QCAZ-A31340 from southern Ecuador is not close to central cochranae22196/31113/59074; the authors tentatively reserve it as an undescribed lineage. Methods call57095 posadae while Table1 calls it aff.pluvialis. Methods andTable1 donor lists also differ for buenaventura, cochranae andsiren. An earlier KU202801 duplication andKU202796 aff.griffithsi/garciae labels are reported provenance issues. These qualified or conflicted records do not create accepted-species routes, new synonyms, replacement specimen codes or invented coordinates.

厄瓜多尔南部标为cochranae的QCAZ-A31340与中部cochranae22196/31113/59074不近，作者暂保留为未描述谱系。方法称57095为posadae，表1却称aff.pluvialis。Buenaventura、cochranae及siren的供体清单在方法与表1也不同。先前KU202801重复及KU202796的aff.griffithsi/garciae标签为所报溯源问题。这些限定或冲突记录不创建接受种路径、新异名、替代标本编号或虚构坐标。
methods
Analysis scope and remaining primary evidence
分析范围及尚待核读原证据

The dataset combines102individuals,6613aligned sites and10loci; new-sequence Table1 has13donor rows andfivegene columns, including focal and unnamed labels. A dash is unreported table data, not an absent gene. Dates use secondary calibrations40.8,23.1,12.5Ma. Main XML paragraphs, both tables and captions were read; original Zenodo alignment, GenBank records, audio and museum specimens remain independently unreviewed. Twenty-nine accepted-species routes below expose only selected diagnosis, donor and phylogeny accounts. They do not certify full genus/species biology or current conservation.
数据集联合102个体、6613比对位点及10位点；新序列表1有13供体行和五基因列，包含焦点及未命名标签。横杠是表数据未给，不是基因不存在。年代用40.8、23.1、12.5Ma二级校准。主XML段落、两表及图注已核读；原Zenodo比对、GenBank记录、录音及博物馆标本仍未独立核读。下方29接受种路径只呈现选定鉴别、供体及系统关系条目，不认证完整属/种生物学或当前保护状况。
methods
Primer rows and unresolved reference numbering
引物行及未解决参考编号

The visually read S1Table lists12S primers tPhe-frog/tVal-frog [65]; ND-1 three pairs ND1-210F/WL384 [66], WL379b/tMet-frog [65,67], andND1-F1/WL384 [66]; C-MYC cmyc1U/cmyc-ex2 R [65,68]. The ND-1 gene cell spans three rows, rather than representing three additional genes. These are primer names, not newly supplied nucleotide sequences or validated amplification performance. The printed reference numbers65–68 correspond in the main bibliography to a glassfrog-distribution article, a Magnolia paper, a land-cover map and IUCN criteria; no corrected citation is invented. The table does not provide a complete per-donor10-locus amplification protocol.

视觉核读S1Table列12S引物tPhe-frog/tVal-frog [65]；ND-1三对ND1-210F/WL384 [66]、WL379b/tMet-frog [65,67]及ND1-F1/WL384 [66]；C-MYC为cmyc1U/cmyc-ex2 R [65,68]。ND-1基因单元格跨三行，不表示增加三个基因。这些是引物名，不是新给核苷酸序列或已验证扩增性能。所印编号65–68在主书目对应玻璃蛙分布文章、木兰论文、土地覆盖地图及IUCN标准；不虚构修正引用。该表不提供每供体完整10位点扩增方案。
occurrence
An appendix of examined comparative specimens
所检比较标本附录

S1Appendix has13exact named entries andone unnamed Nymphargus sp.entry across two pages. Named entries cover anomalus, cariticommatus, chami, cochranae, colomai, cristinae, griffithsi, laurae, mariae, posadae, prasinus, sucre andwileyi. The linked pages preserve voucher series and country/province labels, including holotype/paratype annotations as printed. The appendix supplies reported examined specimens, not newly collected2026records or complete occurrence inventories. Mariae retains the historic C.mariae/C.puyoensis type labels without a new formal synonymization here. The laurae entry USNM288453 is an evidence lead, not permission to copy the new species’ morphology or calls.

S1Appendix两页有13个精确具名条目及一个未命名Nymphargus sp.条目。具名条目含anomalus、cariticommatus、chami、cochranae、colomai、cristinae、griffithsi、laurae、mariae、posadae、prasinus、sucre及wileyi。链接页保留凭证系列及国家/省标签，包括按所印正模/副模注记。附录提供报告的所检标本，不是2026新采记录或完整出现清单。Mariae保留历史C.mariae/C.puyoensis模式标签，不在此新增正式异名化。Laurae的USNM288453条目是证据线索，不授权复制新种形态或鸣声。
taxonomy
New conflicts from the original specimen appendix
原标本附录中的新增冲突

Figure2’s caption labels DHMECN1974 cariticommatus, but S1Appendix line26 places1974 with2249 under Nymphargus sp. in Zamora-Chinchipe. The main text instead locates2249 at SanJuanBosco, MoronaSantiago. Those species/locality disagreements remain unresolved at record level. Neither matching codes nor the focal-description context certifies which label or province is correct. The qualified entry does not create an accepted species route or a revised cariticommatus range.

图2图注把DHMECN1974标为cariticommatus，但S1Appendix第26行在Zamora-Chinchipe将1974与2249置于Nymphargus sp.。主文却将2249置于SanJuanBosco、MoronaSantiago。这些物种/地点分歧在记录层级保持未解决。匹配编号或焦点描述背景不能认证哪标签或省正确。限定条目不创建接受物种路径或修订cariticommatus分布。
evolution
Nuclear figure support does not settle every relationship
核图支持并不解决每个关系

The visually read S1Figure has26printed donor tips,3536aligned sites andseven nuclear loci. Its support order is SH-aLRT/UFB. Selected pairs satisfy both study criteria for bejaranoi90.6/99, central cochranae95.2/100 andthe siren group88.8/97. Grandisonae/aff.grandisonae98.6/94 andocellatus/pluvialis78.6/95 each fail one criterion. Wileyi/unnamed2249 is76/82; lasgralarias/focaldajomesae is78.1/72; the focal three-donor group74.6/91—all below both thresholds. The recovered nuclear placement therefore retains weak support and differs from the concatenated focal sister relation. A single marker set and sampled grouping do not certify all-population monophyly, reproductive isolation or original voucher identity.

视觉核读S1Figure有26所印供体末端、3536比对位点及七核位点，支持次序为SH-aLRT/UFB。选定对中bejaranoi90.6/99、中部cochranae95.2/100及siren群88.8/97满足两项研究条件。Grandisonae/aff.grandisonae98.6/94及ocellatus/pluvialis78.6/95各未满足一项。Wileyi/未命名2249为76/82，lasgralarias/焦点dajomesae为78.1/72，焦点三供体群74.6/91，均低于两阈值。因此保留恢复核位置的弱支持及其与拼接焦点姐妹关系的差异。一个标记集及采样群不认证全部种群单系、生殖隔离或原凭证身份。
taxonomy
Unmapped and qualified tree labels remain visible
未映射及限定树标签保留可见

The tree prints aff.grandisonae QCAZ58032/58030, unnamed QCAZ-A31340/DHMECN2249 andthree dajomesae donors separately from exact accepted-name routes. Rosadus MHUA4308 has no resolved exact frozen-catalogue bridge in the recorded dataset316115 query; it is not silently rewritten as rosada or treated as an independently reconciled synonym. The tree’s0.008 scale is branch length, not a Ma age axis. Selected twelve exact accepted-name tree labels have donor-scoped prose; new routes for mixomaculatus, bejaranoi andmegacheirus do not imply newly authenticated ranges or complete dossiers.

树把aff.grandisonae QCAZ58032/58030、未命名QCAZ-A31340/DHMECN2249及三个dajomesae供体与精确接受名路径分别保留。Rosadus MHUA4308在已记录dataset316115查询中没有解决的精确冻结目录桥接，不静默改写为rosada或作独立协调异名。树的0.008标尺为分支长度，不是Ma年龄轴。十二个选定精确接受名树标签有供体限定正文；新增mixomaculatus、bejaranoi及megacheirus路径不表示新认证分布或完整档案。

sections: taxonomy
A2019 description and sampled genus placement
2019描述与采样属归属

The study describes manduriacu and supports its Nymphargus placement with morphology and mitochondrial evidence. It formally transfers the older Centrolenella balionota combination into Nymphargus and includes balionotus,cariticommatus,lasgralarias,spilotus andsucre in its expanded phylogeny. Generic lack of inner-finger webbing andusual lack of male humeral spines retain grandisonae’s spine exception andarmatus/somegriffithsi crest qualifications. These selected observations are not a revision of every current genus member or independently resolved catalogue concept.

研究描述manduriacu，并以形态和线粒体证据支持归Nymphargus；正式把旧Centrolenella balionota组合转入此属，并把balionotus、cariticommatus、lasgralarias、spilotus及sucre纳入扩展系统树。属内内侧指无蹼、雄性通常无肱刺的性状保留grandisonae肱刺例外及armatus/部分griffithsi嵴限定。这些选定观察不是每个当前属成员修订或独立解决目录概念。
morphology
A type series and comparative morphology
模式系列与比较形态

Manduriacu’s adult type series is three males24.0–25.7mm SVL andone female28.8mm. Table1 separately gives comparator male ranges/samples for buenaventura,ignotus,luminosus andspilotus; luminosus spot-count n=16 differs from male-size n=15. The focal false-ocellus coloration is not transferred to every comparator. DefinitionFingerI>II conflicts with the holotypeII>I andallfourTable2measurements. The paper’s spine/crest qualifications andlive/preserved colors retain individual/population scope.
Manduriacu成年模式系列为三雄性吻肛长24.0–25.7mm及一雌性28.8mm。表1另给buenaventura、ignotus、luminosus及spilotus雄性范围/样本；luminosus斑点数n=16不同于雄性体型n=15。焦点假眼斑颜色不转移给每个比较对象。定义FingerI>II与正模II>I及表2全部四测量冲突。肱刺/嵴限定及活体/保存后颜色保留个体/种群范围。
ecology
Wet-season encounters and reproduction records
湿季相遇与繁殖记录

Manduriacu was regularly encountered only during heavy-rain February2018surveys after sparse earlier detections. Reported perches andstream widths vary; this is not standardized abundance or experimental habitat preference. The definition reports fourclutches15–32eggs, while natural history reports26–32embryos andmean25.75±7.5883; the mean falls below that stated minimum. A nearby male15–30cm fromclutches does not demonstrate care, andthe source’s no-attendance statement does not test every reproductive stage. Tadpoles remain undescribed.
Manduriacu只在强雨2018年2月调查中规律检出，早前检出稀少。所报停栖高度及溪宽不同，不是标准化丰度或栖境偏好实验。定义报告四卵块15–32卵，自然史却报26–32胚胎及均值25.75±7.5883，均值低于该最小值。距卵块15–30cm雄性邻近不证明照护，来源无照料陈述也未测试每繁殖阶段。蝌蚪仍未描述。
ecology
Calls keep dates and replication units
鸣声保留日期及重复单位

The focal call account uses two males andten calls,not ten independent animals. Single pulsed chirps have4052–4447Hz dominant frequency and0.093–0.118s duration. The grandisonae3100–4048Hz comparison is from cited literature rather than a new controlled experiment. The recording paragraph says5February2018 buttype/naturalhistory collection accounts say7February; frequencySD1,18.3 in thedefinition differs from118.3 in thecallparagraph. Neither inconsistency is silently corrected. Original audio/temperature conditions remain unauthenticated.
焦点鸣声条目用两雄性及十鸣声，不是十独立动物。单脉冲啁啾主频4052–4447Hz、时长0.093–0.118s。Grandisonae3100–4048Hz对比来自所引文献，不是新控制实验。录音段说2018年2月5日，模式/自然史采集段却说7日；定义频率标准差1,18.3不同于鸣声段118.3。不静默修正任一不一致。原音频/温度条件未认证。
evolution
Mitochondrial sampling and geographic hypotheses
线粒体采样与地理假说

The study generates31new sequences andanalyzes12S+16S as one maternally inherited unit using maximum likelihood/TIM2+F+R5 and1000ultrafast-bootstrap replicates. Manduriacu/balionotus are sampled sisters with6.4–6.7% concatenated uncorrected distance; this is not a16S-only universal species threshold. The60%-described-diversity sampling suggests neighboring/sometimes sympatric sister lineages andallopatric Amazonian comparisons. Dry valleys andAndean linearity are proposed barriers; the paper explicitly notes no designed tests of those valleys’ diversification effects. Qualified aff.chancas andunnamed/rosadus labels remain separate from exact accepted routes.

研究生成31新序列，将12S+16S作一个母系遗传单位，以最大似然/TIM2+F+R5及1000次超快速自举分析。Manduriacu/balionotus为采样姐妹，拼接未校正距离6.4–6.7%，不是16S单独普适种阈值。已描述多样性60%采样提出地理邻居/有时同域姐妹及亚马孙异域比较。干谷及安第斯线性格局为所提屏障；论文明确指出没有设计测试这些谷地分化作用。带限定aff.chancas及未命名/rosadus标签与精确接受路径分开。
range
Local records and source disagreements
当地记录与来源分歧

Focal Table1 gives1215–1238m versusdistribution1215–1242m; reserve1200–2000m is a site range,not observed species bounds. LuminosusTable1 gives1140–1430m versusAppendixI1000–1430m. Spilotus holotypeICN35255 inFig6 differs fromAppendixICN35155, andTable1Fig6D differs fromcaptionA–C. Referredmetamorph0464 differs fromFig4caption618. Examined-specimen reports andcaption coordinates retain their own scope without new voucher equivalences, corrected ranges or inferred coordinates.
焦点表1给1215–1238m、分布1215–1242m；保护区1200–2000m为地点范围，不是所观物种界限。Luminosus表1给1140–1430m、附录I1000–1430m。Spilotus图6正模ICN35255不同于附录ICN35155，表1图6D不同于图注A–C。归入变态个体0464不同于图4图注618。所检标本报告及图注坐标保留各自范围，不新建凭证等价、修正范围或推断坐标。
ecology
Historical conservation evidence at Manduriacu
Manduriacu的历史保护证据

Authors recommendCriticallyEndangered for manduriacu underB2a/B2biii andreport an extant reproducing balionotus population from2016–2018personal observations after a long sighting gap. These source statements are not verified currentIUCN listings or measured recovery trajectories. Agriculture/cattle/logging/mining are reported threats; no species-specific waterchemistry/toxicology experiment is supplied. Historical legal/companyclaims andreserve purchases/plans are not asserted as current rulings, ownership or completed conservation outcomes.
作者依B2a/B2biii为manduriacu建议极危，并依2016–2018个人观察报告长期目击间隔后balionotus现存繁殖种群。这些来源陈述不是核实当前IUCN名录或实测恢复轨迹。农业/畜牧/伐木/采矿为所报威胁，没有物种特定水化学/毒理实验。历史法律/公司主张及保护区购地/计划不作为当前裁决、所有权或已完成保护结果断言。
methods
Read scope and independent evidence still needed
核读范围及仍需独立证据

Mainsec1–8paragraphs,allcells ofTables1–2 andAppendixI were read;figure/supplementcaptions were read without original pixels orrawaudio. evolution
Supplementary donors and distinct count units
补充供体与不同计数单位

The cloud-retrieved S1DOCX contains35donor rows:26rows under11exact namedlabels and9qualified/unnamed rows kept unassigned. It has65non-NA12S/16S cells and63distinct accession strings. NA means no table entry,not no biological gene. Original sequences,alignments andvoucher identities remain unauthenticated.
云端取得S1DOCX有35供体行：26行属于11精确具名标签，9限定/未命名行保持未赋值。共有65个非NA的12S/16S单元格、63个不同登录号字符串。主文说31新序列；供体行、单元格、字符串及主文计数不可互换，所指新序列计数单位仍未解决。NA是表无条目，不是无生物基因。原序列、比对及凭证身份仍未认证。
taxonomy
Cross-code and qualified-name conflicts
跨编号及限定名称冲突

Methods’ focalZSFQ462/463/466 differ fromsupplementJMG0615/0616/0622,without an independently confirmed per-row bridge. Supplementary locality strings and remaining conflicts
补充地点字符串及余下冲突

FocalJMG0622 is1242m inS1,matching thedistributionparagraph upper boundbutnotTable1’s1238m summary. Balionotusdonors are1285,1254 and1240m inS1,distinct fromAppendixI’s1215–1238m specimen series. scope.zh: 2020快速鸣唱研究、采样近缘及比较边界

sections: evolution
A sampled multilocus tree and its unequal supports
采样多位点树及不同支持度

The2020 study combines79 terminals and5915 bp from four mitochondrial and six nuclear genes where available. Allobates monophyly has reported ML support94%, olfersioides sister to the remainder100%, insperatus–juami100%, and crombiei–grillisimilis76%. Velocicantus plus two Cruzeiro do Sul sequence records has100%, but its recovered carajas sister relation only24%. These nodes have different evidence strengths; shared trill structure is not a universal close-kinship marker. No whole-genus genome, calibrated time tree or every-species revision follows from this dataset.

2020年研究合并79末端、5915 bp，按可得数据含四线粒体及六核基因。Allobates 单系所报 ML支持94%，olfersioides 与其余姐妹100%，insperatus–juami100%，crombiei–grillisimilis76%。Velocicantus 与两条 Cruzeiro do Sul 序列记录支系100%，但恢复的 carajas 姐妹关系仅24%。这些节点证据强度不同，共享颤鸣结构不是普遍近亲标志。该数据集不导出全属基因组、有校准时间树或每种修订。
evolution
Distance metrics and unresolved clade labels
距离指标与未解决分支标签

Table2 separates uncorrected p-distance from K2P percent across a678-bp16S fragment. Qualified aff.tinae A/B/C, gasconi A/B/C and trilineatus A/B/C entries remain source clade labels rather than separate accepted species. Results calls6.6% the trilineatus A minimum, but Table2 places6.6% in B, with A and C6.8%. The conflict is preserved without silently renaming tips. Table1 also skips printed partition7 and uses SAI where Methods/Fig2 use SIA; original alignments/model files must reconcile those strings.
表2分开678-bp16S片段的未校正 p 距离与K2P百分数。限定 aff.tinae A/B/C、gasconi A/B/C及trilineatus A/B/C条目保留来源分支标签，不是分别接受种。结果把6.6%最小值称为trilineatus A，表2却放在B，A及C为6.8%。保留冲突，不静默重命名末端。表1另缺所印分区7，使用SAI而方法/图2用SIA，需原比对/模型文件协调字符串。
morphology
Comparative adult and larval traits keep their scopes
比较成体及幼体性状保留范围

The description compares selected dorsal marks, male throat colours, finger/toe structures and larval papillae across named congeners. They combine examined museum material and attributed prior descriptions; they are not new species-wide measurements for every comparator. AppendixI retains adult/tadpole lots, original locality strings and type/topotype labels. A qualified aff.tinae entry is not mapped into accepted tinae. The focal five stage34 larvae remain separate from the14 stage27–37 measurement table and from other species’ reported larvae.
描述跨具名同属种比较选定背斑、雄性喉色、指趾结构及幼体乳突，结合检查博物馆材料及归属早期描述，不是每比较种的新全种测量。附录I保留成体/蝌蚪批次、原地点字符串及模式/地模标签。限定aff.tinae条目不映入接受tinae。焦点五只34期幼体与表中14只27–37期测量及其他种所报幼体分开。
ecology
Call comparisons use different source samples
鸣声比较使用不同来源样本

Velocicantus acoustic summaries come from eight males and24 analysed calls; individual table means and pooled extrema use different units. Prior-species comparisons cite single-note arrangements, unpulsed trills and duration/note-count/interval summaries from different earlier studies. These are attributed comparisons, not reanalysed recordings under a common temperature protocol. The2020 highest-note-count claim is dated to documented calls available then; it is not a refreshed universal ranking or playback-tested reproductive isolation.
Velocicantus声学汇总来自八雄及24个分析鸣声，个体表均值与合并极值使用不同单位。早期种比较引用不同研究的单音节排列、无脉冲颤鸣及时长/音节数/间隔汇总，是有归属比较，不是按共同温度方案重新分析录音。2020年最高音节数主张限于当时已记录鸣声，不是更新的普遍排名或回放测试生殖隔离。
ecology
Leaf-side and egg-pigment observations need physiological tests
叶面与卵色观察需要生理测试

Discussion compares velocicantus dark animal poles/cloudy jelly on upper green-leaf surfaces with white animal poles and translucent jelly reported for subfolionidificans and carajas. It attributes lower-leaf surfaces to subfolionidificans and upper surfaces under denser canopy to carajas. The latter canopy statement includes a personal communication. These observations motivate sunlight-protection hypotheses, but no controlled radiation treatment, embryo-survival comparison or selection test is reported here. One observed focal courtship and tadpole loading event cannot define a universal genus breeding programme.

scope.en: The2023Ailao study and its named source comparisons
scope.zh: 2023哀牢研究及具名来源比较

sections: taxonomy
A new description within a historically defined group
历史定义群内的新描述

The2023 study describes ailao fromsevenAilao specimens andassigns it to themantzorum group using morphology andmitochondrial evidence. Historical group counts, xinduqiao’s treatmentassubspecies andquoted/unresolvedTable1 labels remain source concepts,not automatic changes to everyfrozen accepted species. True dorsolateral folds differ from interrupted glandular folds. Introductory first-finger-groove wording andlaterfocalabsence conflict,so neither is silently turned into an unqualified currentgenus diagnosis.
2023年研究用七哀牢标本描述ailao，以形态及线粒体证据归mantzorum群。历史群计数、xinduqiao作为亚种处理及带引号/未解决表1标签保留来源概念，不自动改变每冻结接受种。真正背侧褶不同于间断腺体褶，引言第一指沟措辞与后来焦点不存在冲突，不静默转成无限定当前属鉴别。
morphology
Comparative characters have species and sex boundaries
比较性状有物种及性别边界

Focalmeasurements cover sixmales33.0–35.1mm SVL andonefemale41.3mm. Namedcomparators retain their ownsex-specific size ranges,teeth,fold,groove,vocal-sac andnuptial-spine descriptions attributed toearlier studies. Exceptions suchassiju’s vocal-sac comparison remainexplicit. The paper’s smaller-size wording doesnot guarantee separation ofindividual males whereailao/shuichengicus ranges overlap. Focalcolour variesbrown/green amongtypes,whiletoe-webbing diagnosis/prose andcomplete/incomplete glandseries statements require reconciliation.
焦点测量含六雄吻肛长33.0–35.1毫米及一雌41.3毫米。具名比较种保留各自性别特定体型范围及归属早期研究的齿、褶、沟、声囊、婚刺描述，siju声囊比较等例外明确保留。较小体型措辞不保证ailao/shuichengicus范围重叠处个体雄性分离。焦点模式颜色褐/绿变异，趾蹼鉴别/正文及完整/间断腺体系列陈述需协调。
ecology
Stream observations do not fill every life-history facet
溪流观察不填满每个生活史方面

Ailao adults wereobserved atnight onleaves/smallbranches less than2m high along thetypelocality stream. May–Julybreeding isproposed fromnuptial pads andone egg-bearingfemale,not a fullyearsurvey. No tadpoles werecollected,andvocal-sac absence doesnot prove acoustic silence. Tuberodepressus co-occurs there,butdiet,microhabitat preference,hybridization,populationtrend andcurrentconservationstatus are notmeasured bythat co-occurrence.
Ailao成体夜间在模式产地溪旁不足2米叶/小枝观察，依婚垫及一携卵雌提出五月—七月繁殖，不是全年调查。未采幼体，无声囊不证明声学沉默。Tuberodepressus当地同域出现，但该出现不测量食性、微栖境偏好、杂交、种群趋势或当前保护状态。
evolution
Three genes and a secondary clock retain uncertainty
三基因及二级时钟保留不确定性

The combined16S/COI/cytb analysis hasgenealignments884/676/998bp withuneven species coverage. Ailao–ottorum isreportedstrongly supported,butmany internalmantzorum-group branches remainpoorlyresolved andminutus isunsampled. BEAST’s25.01±2.2Ma genus-crown calibration issecondary;theailao–ottorum split2.2Ma has95%HPD1.1–3.37Ma. Shortbranches/datedcoincidencewithuplift motivate rapid-speciation hypotheses,not measuredcausaldrainage orselection experiments.
组合16S/COI/cytb分析基因比对884/676/998bp，物种覆盖不均。作者报告ailao–ottorum强支持，但mantzorum群许多内部分支仍差、minutus未采样。BEAST属冠25.01±2.2Ma为二级校准，ailao–ottorum分离2.2Ma有95%HPD1.1–3.37Ma。短枝/与抬升年代相合提出快速成种假说，不是实测因果水系或选择实验。
biogeography
Regional counts describe the2023 source compilation
区域计数描述2023来源汇编

TheDiscussion reports20Yunnan Amolops species,within220amphibians and51genera,andcompares regions andriverbasins. These aredatedsource-compilation counts,not current standardized survey richness orindividualabundance. Itsmonticola list labelled“eight” namesnine species;some regionallistspellings arekaubacki,bellus ortuberdepressus. Thefigurecaption’s exactnames canbe readassource labels,but do notsilently reconcile historical specimen identities oreveryoldermantzorumrecord. Additional sampling isexplicitlyrequested forspecies boundaries.
讨论报告云南20Amolops、总两栖220种及51属，比较区域/流域。这是有年代来源汇编计数，不是当前标准化调查丰富度或个体丰度。称“八”的monticola清单列九名，部分区域清单拼kaubacki、bellus或tuberdepressus。图注精确名可作为来源标签读，不静默协调历史标本身份或每旧mantzorum记录，作者明确要求增加采样解决物种边界。
methods
Donor labels and evidence locators remain explicit
供体标签及证据定位保持明确

sections: occurrence
Named records in a community-conserved cloud forest
社区保育云雾林中的具名记录

The 2021 Santa Cruz Tepetotutla checklist includes Incilius spiculatus, Incilius valliceps. These selected Incilius records come from the 2018–2019 survey in the Chinantla region of Oaxaca. Four observers made eleven five-day trips across wet and dry seasons, in pristine and managed sites, and photographed and released encountered animals. The recorded elevations and CNAR photographic catalogue numbers remain species-specific. They establish source-reported presence, not an exhaustive genus inventory, authenticated museum vouchers, global range limits or population trends.

2021年Santa Cruz Tepetotutla清单包括Incilius spiculatus、Incilius valliceps。这些选定Incilius记录来自Oaxaca的Chinantla地区2018–2019年调查。四名观察者于旱雨季开展十一次、每次五天野外工作，覆盖原生及经营地点，遇见动物摄影后放归。所报海拔及CNAR照片目录号保持物种特定；它们确立来源所报出现，不是完整属清单、已认证博物馆凭证、全球分布限度或种群趋势。
ecology
Conservation evidence has temporal and sampling limits
保护证据有时间及采样边界

The paper links local occurrence records with community conservation: it reports9,670ha of conserved cloud forest since2004 and discusses a territory of approximately11,000ha. These are different area descriptions, not interchangeable estimates. The nineteen amphibian species and2,640effective survey hours refer to the overall checklist, not this genus alone. Historical IUCN, EVS and NOM-059 entries retain their distinct frameworks and are not current rechecked assessments. The accumulation curve did not reach an asymptote, and presence data do not quantify a causal management benefit, detection probability or absence outside sampled sites. The linked occurrence supplement uses ODbL, separately from the article’s CC BY4.0; it has not been independently read or reproduced.

sections: occurrence
Named records in a community-conserved cloud forest
社区保育云雾林中的具名记录

The 2021 Santa Cruz Tepetotutla checklist includes Duellmanohyla ignicolor. These selected Duellmanohyla records come from the 2018–2019 survey in the Chinantla region of Oaxaca. Four observers made eleven five-day trips across wet and dry seasons, in pristine and managed sites, and photographed and released encountered animals. The recorded elevations and CNAR photographic catalogue numbers remain species-specific. They establish source-reported presence, not an exhaustive genus inventory, authenticated museum vouchers, global range limits or population trends.

2021年Santa Cruz Tepetotutla清单包括Duellmanohyla ignicolor。这些选定Duellmanohyla记录来自Oaxaca的Chinantla地区2018–2019年调查。四名观察者于旱雨季开展十一次、每次五天野外工作，覆盖原生及经营地点，遇见动物摄影后放归。所报海拔及CNAR照片目录号保持物种特定；它们确立来源所报出现，不是完整属清单、已认证博物馆凭证、全球分布限度或种群趋势。
ecology
Conservation evidence has temporal and sampling limits
保护证据有时间及采样边界

The paper links local occurrence records with community conservation: it reports9,670ha of conserved cloud forest since2004 and discusses a territory of approximately11,000ha. These are different area descriptions, not interchangeable estimates. The nineteen amphibian species and2,640effective survey hours refer to the overall checklist, not this genus alone. Historical IUCN, EVS and NOM-059 entries retain their distinct frameworks and are not current rechecked assessments. The accumulation curve did not reach an asymptote, and presence data do not quantify a causal management benefit, detection probability or absence outside sampled sites. The linked occurrence supplement uses ODbL, separately from the article’s CC BY4.0; it has not been independently read or reproduced.

Streamside observations and two printed elevation summaries
溪旁观察及两套所印海拔摘要

The treatment reports WGS84 latitude17.7334°N and longitude printed as -96.5557°W, at1079m, with a31.85km northwest extension from the type locality and25.26km from other known localities. Keep both attributed ranges and the coordinate as printed; do not silently reconcile them or interpret common observations as a quantified abundance estimate. The source coordinate string combines a negative sign with W, so it is not automatically converted into a normalized point.

The treatment gives a new locality at2210m, WGS84 latitude17.67255°N and longitude printed as -96.55913°W,18.64km northwest of the type locality. scope.en: The2021 korekore study andits explicit named roles
scope.zh: 2021年korekore研究及明确具名角色

sections: taxonomy
A new species within unresolved historical groups
历史群仍未解决时的新种描述

The2021 study describes korekore using morphology, advertisement calls and16S evidence. It says historical morphological groupings lack consistent phylogenetic support and calls for multilocus and coalescent approaches. Earlier concavitympanum usage is cited only in part, not converted into a blanket synonym or a genus-wide reassignment. The Tocantins aff. ararype population retains a qualified identity pending further study.
2021年研究用形态、广告鸣声及16S证据描述korekore，称历史形态分群缺一致系统支持，要求多位点及溯祖方法。早期concavitympanum用法仅部分引用，不转成全异名或全属重新归属；Tocantins的aff.ararype种群保持限定身份、待研究。
morphology
Named anatomical comparisons require combinations
具名解剖比较需性状组合

The description compares eyelid and rostral appendages,postocular swellings,forearm tubercle rows,eye ratios andocular-dorsal ridges among named species. Rondonae is explicitly exceptional in the palpebral-appendage comparison. These contrasts are not an invariant genus diagnosis. Korekore itself varies in colour and ridge completeness,and its diagnosis/Table1 adult size ranges disagree. The printed holotype head-length claim70%ofSVL also differs from15.67/43.35mm,approximately36.1%. Original specimens remain unauthenticated.
描述在具名种间比较眼睑/吻端附器、眼后膨大、前臂疣列、眼比例及眼背疣脊，rondonae在眼睑比较明确例外。这不是恒定属鉴别。Korekore自身颜色及脊完整度变异，鉴别/表1成年体长范围不一致。正模头长吻肛长70%陈述也不同于15.67/43.35毫米、约36.1%。原标本未认证。
ecology
Calls retain locality, sample and source boundaries
鸣声保留地点、样本及来源边界

Korekore acoustic measurements use eight calls from one male. Table2 compares separately sourced ararype,concavitympanum andmoratoi recordings,including multiple localities;these are not pooled independent genus samples. Diagnosis gives18–31pulses/call whileResults/Table2 gives18–32. A sentence calls96.4–111.1pulses/s lower than69–86,whilelaterResults correctly saysgreater. Table2’sJacareacanga,MT differs fromtheParátype locality. The source explicitly says strussmannae’s advertisement call is not described there,not thatthefrog is silent.
Korekore声学测量用一雄八次鸣声。表2分别引用ararype、concavitympanum及moratoi录音、含多个地点，不合并成独立属样本。鉴别给每声18–31脉冲，结果/表2却18–32；一句称96.4–111.1脉冲/秒低于69–86，后来结果正确说较大。表2的Jacareacanga,MT不同于Pará模式地点。来源明确称strussmannae广告鸣声当时未描述，不是蛙沉默。
evolution
A mitochondrial tree and qualified distance labels
线粒体树及带限定距离标签

The421bp16S analysis places korekore sister toconcavitympanum but hasweak deepernodes. Table3 retainsboieiN1/N2/S at7.0/8.3/7.1%fromkorekore;aff.ararype3.0%,aff.melanopogon6.8%andcf.salvatori6.5%remain qualifiedlabels. The misspelledcriticeps label9.8%isnot silently assigned tocristiceps. These source distinctions are not whole-species distances or universal delimitation thresholds. No sharedhaplotypes amongseven sampledlineages does not independently establish reproductive isolation.

421bp16S分析把korekore置concavitympanum姐妹，但较深节点弱。表3保留boieiN1/N2/S与korekore距离7.0/8.3/7.1%；aff.ararype3.0%、aff.melanopogon6.8%、cf.salvatori6.5%保持限定标签。拼criticeps的9.8%不静默归cristiceps。来源区分不是全种距离或普遍划界阈值，七采样谱系不共享单倍型不独立确立生殖隔离。
range
Specimen lists and local habitat remain species-specific
标本清单及当地栖境保持物种特定

Appendix identifiers and localities document the authors’ examined material,butare not authenticated global range records. Korekore type/Appendix placements differ forZUEC14950 andZUFMS08100;concavitympanum includes theunresolvedMZUFV9554–95556range. SAD69andWGS84 are not normalized. TheTelesPiresforest observations,October–Junecalling andlogging/mining/dam threats belong to thelocalkorekore account,not everyProceratophrys species.
附录标识及地点记录作者检查材料，不是已认证全球分布记录。Korekore模式/附录对ZUEC14950及ZUFMS08100地点不同，concavitympanum含未解决MZUFV9554–95556范围；SAD69及WGS84未标准化。TelesPires森林观察、十月至六月鸣叫及伐木/采矿/坝威胁属于当地korekore账号，不属于每Proceratophrys种。
methods
Read scopes distinguish observations from unreviewed records
阅读范围区分观察与未核记录

Main biological sections,three tables,eightcaptions andthe31-paragraph Appendix were read. Figurepixels,rawsound,originalsequences,alignment,DocumentS1/S2 andmuseumobjects remain unreviewed. Selected routes retainexact accepted-name matches;qualified,mismatched andmisspelled labels remain explicit ratherthan repaired. ArticleCCBY4 licensing does not certify thebiological claims or acomplete genus account.
主要生物学章节、三表、八图注及31段附录已核读。图像像素、原声音、原序列、比对、DocumentS1/S2及博物馆实物未核读。选定路径保留精确接受名匹配，有限定、未匹配及拼写差异标签保持明确而非修正。论文CCBY4许可不认证生物学主张或完整属记录。
methods
Deposited donor strings are not all accession numbers
存放供体字符串并非全为登录号

Document S1 has77donor rows. Its Genbank Acession column includes three local korekore voucher strings and four local strussmannae identifiers. These are preserved as source strings rather than certified accession numbers. Qualified boiei N1/N2/S and aff. ararype labels are not silently collapsed into whole accepted species. Original sequence records and specimen identities remain unverified.
Document S1有77供体行，其Genbank Acession列含三个当地korekore凭证字符串及四个当地strussmannae标识。保留为来源字符串，不认证为登录号。有限定boiei N1/N2/S及aff.ararype标签不静默合并成全接受种；原序列记录及标本身份未核实。
evolution
Selected worksheet distances preserve stored units
选定工作表距离保留存储单位
